fdroid:com.materializr.app.name: Materializr
fdroid:com.materializr.app.summary: Maker 3D CAD - the middle ground between Tinkercad and FreeCAD
fdroid:com.materializr.app.description:
Materializr is open-source 3D CAD for makers - the middle ground between dead-simple tools like Tinkercad and full professional suites like FreeCAD. Enough genuine solid modeling to make real parts, without a steep learning curve, a subscription, or an account.
Sketch on a plane, pull it into a solid (extrude, revolve, loft, sweep), fillet and chamfer, run boolean operations, cut threads, and edit any step of the history later - even after closing and reopening the project.
Sketches export to SVG at 1:1 millimeters for laser cutters and 2.5D CNC. It also imports STEP and IGES, and exports STEP, STL, IGES and glTF.
The geometry kernel is OpenCASCADE - real B-rep solids, not meshes. The interface is touch-capable on Android, designed for tablets and larger screens (on a small phone the panels and toolbars are cramped). File open/save use the system document picker (Storage Access Framework); no broad storage permission is requested.
Young software built quickly, so expect rough edges. Operations validate their results and refuse rather than silently produce garbage, so a failed action leaves your model untouched - but save often, and please report bugs.

fdroid:com.ndev.moodyroutine.name: MoodyRoutine
fdroid:com.ndev.moodyroutine.summary: Samsung One UI-style Modes and Routines automation engine for Android.
fdroid:com.ndev.moodyroutine.description:
MoodyRoutine brings contextual automation, situational profiles, and event-driven workflows to any Android device running Android 8.0 (API 26) or higher. It reproduces the design philosophy, ergonomics, and automation capabilities of Samsung's One UI Modes & Routines without requiring root privileges or manufacturer-locked frameworks.
 Modes (Situational Profiles) 
Bundle device settings into situational profiles:
 Sleep Mode: Enables Do Not Disturb, reduces screen brightness, activates dark mode, and silences notifications.
 Work Mode: Switches ringer to vibrate, mutes media, and restricts distracting applications.
 Driving Mode: Enables auto-rotate, adjusts media volume, and launches navigation.
 Exercise Mode: Configures media volume and launches workout tracking.
 Relax Mode: Reduces screen brightness, silences alerts, and starts music or ambient audio.
 Custom Modes: Define arbitrary modes with custom naming, color schemes, and 30+ categorized icons.
 Stay Focused (App Blocker): Restricts selected applications while a mode is active, with options to close, snooze for 5 minutes, or turn off the mode.
 State Reversion: Automatically snapshots prior volume, ringer, and display settings before mode activation, restoring them upon deactivation.
 Status Bar Notifications: Ongoing foreground notification displaying active mode state with an instant "Turn off" action.
 Routines (IF → THEN Automation) 
Automate actions based on environmental triggers:
 Conditions (IF): Schedule (time ranges, recurrence), Battery & Charging thresholds, Wi-Fi connected/disconnected (with SSID targeting), Bluetooth devices, App open/close, Headphones connected/disconnected, and Location geofencing via OpenStreetMap.
 Actions (THEN): Audio sliders (Ring, media, alarm, notification), Ringer modes (Normal, vibrate, silent), Do Not Disturb states, Brightness adjustment, Auto-rotate toggle, Dark mode toggle, Home/Lock screen wallpapers, App launcher, and App shortcuts.
 Privacy & Libre Software 
 100% Free & Open Source (GPL-3.0)
 Zero trackers, zero analytics, zero ads
 Fully offline operation with no account or registration required

fdroid:grmpl.mk.stepandheightcounter.name: Step and Height Counter
fdroid:grmpl.mk.stepandheightcounter.description:
This app counts footsteps and elevation gain if step sensor and barometric sensor is available. 
All data is kept locally only, there is no connection to any server. For statistics you can save your data locally on SD-Card.
Please note: Pressure sensor is mandatory. Steps will not be counted during walking, if there is a step sensor but no pressure sensor. 
Elevation gain should only be counted if footsteps are detected, so only stairs and hill climbing will count, but not elevators or lifts. Don’t expect high accuracy - due to the concept of the sensors the accuracy is limited. And: avoid walking in trains or subways with active measurement, as the pressure (and therefore height) can change significantly during driving. 
You can save regular and daily statistics automatically on SD-Card and save current values with the floating action button. Starting with Android 10 files are not saved to root-folder of SD-card anymore, but in app-directory. There isn’t much on graphical display of statistic data besides two progress bars. Just use any program which can read csv-values. 
 Permissions: 
* Access to physical activity: Access to step sensor needs permission to access physical activity since Android 10+. The app will not work without this permission on devices with Android 10 and higher.
* Keep device awake: Device will not be kept awake all time. It will be woken up regulary and kept awake if necessary for short time to ensure proper counting of steps and elevation gain.
* Write to external storage: App will work without this permission, but you cannot save statistical values or markers.

fdroid:org.emunix.unipatcher.name: UniPatcher
fdroid:org.emunix.unipatcher.summary: Utility to apply patches to ROMs
fdroid:org.emunix.unipatcher.description:
UniPatcher allows you to apply patches to game ROMs.
What is a patch?
A file with the modified data of the game. For example, a game translated from Japanese to English. You download the patch containing the translation. It must be applied to the Japanese version to make an English version of it.
This program will not help you hack native Android games, it was created for the old console games (SNES, PS1, GBA, N64, SMD\Genesis etc.)
Features:
* Supported formats of patches: IPS, IPS32, UPS, BPS, APS (GBA), APS (N64), PPF, DPS, EBP, XDelta
* Create XDelta patches
* Fix the checksum in SMD\Genesis ROMs
* Remove the SMC header from SNES ROMs
How to use?
You have to select a ROM file, a patch and choose which file to save, then click on the button in the bottom. Files are selected through the standard Files application (or through one of the file managers you have installed). The application will show a message when the file is patched. Do not close the application until the file is patched.
Very important:
If the game and patch is compressed (ZIP, RAR, 7z or other), they first need to be unzipped.

Automatically create calendar events from notifications received from work and social apps by parsing Chinese time expressions.
Features:
• Automatically recognizes Chinese time expressions in notifications (e.g., "明天下午3点" = tomorrow 3pm, "周五晚上8点" = Friday 8pm)
• Supports rich Chinese relative time parsing ("3天后" = in 3 days, "1个半小时后" = in 1.5 hours)
• Supports fuzzy time expressions ("今晚" = tonight, "下午" = afternoon, "周末" = weekend)
• Customizable keyword filters and app whitelist
• Multiple calendar selection support
• Fully offline, no internet permission required
• Privacy-respecting, data never leaves your device
Use Cases (Chinese social/work apps):
• WeChat/QQ group notifications: "明天下午3点开会" (meeting tomorrow 3pm)
• Work notifications: "周五晚上8点项目汇报" (project report Friday 8pm)
• Social plans: "下周二一起吃饭" (dinner together next Tuesday)
Permissions:
• Calendar access: Read and create calendar events
• Notification access: Read system notifications to extract time information
• Foreground service: Keep service running in background
• Exact alarm: Used for crash recovery mechanism
• Query packages: Used for app picker to display installed apps
This app contains no ads, tracking, or data collection.
Target audience: Chinese-speaking users who use Chinese messaging and social apps.
Note: Github Release version uses private signing, although both are built automatically by Actions, the signatures of the two packages are different.

2. Press play to listen to episodes from your Queue in order. Queued episodes are downloaded automatically. 
3. Re-order your QUEUE to plan your next few hours of listening at any time. Browse your LIBRARY to review the back catalogue, quickly access starred shows, and see your listening history.

• Apple Watch App: control playback and select another episode from your Queue

REVIEWS ARE IN – Castro is Better Than Ever 
“Castro has truly come into its own: it’s become an app that serves nearly any podcast fan’s needs.”— MacStories 
“Castro Is a Great Modern Podcast App” — Beautiful Pixels 
“Unlike other podcatchers, Castro's primary virtue is its simplicity and ease of use. The app combines sleek visual design with crystal clear audio.” — Tom’s Guide 
“Castro is an incredible app.” — The Sweet Setup

apple-macos:984596109.name: The Vault - Security Made Easy
apple-macos:984596109.description:
◆◆◆ NO ads, NO tracking, NO subscriptions ◆◆◆
=[ Want to give The Vault a try for free? The Vault for iOS is a free download! ]=
▸ Hear what other users have to say: bit.ly/TheVaultReviews

Do you…

… sometimes wish you had a photo of a creditcard, passport or other document handy?
… want to securely store lots of other confidential information, photos, animated GIFs, office documents, you name it?
… want all this to be secure, but still very simple to use?
Then ◆The Vault◆ is for you!
The Vault provides straightforward, easy to use, secure storage for all your documents and other data, such as passwords, login credentials and any other confidential information. It can securely store any number of documents, screenshots or photos along with your confidential information.
* 256-bit AES encryption *
While storage and access is simple, The Vault uses rock-solid, industry standard encryption.
[technical details below]
◆ ◆ ◆ WHY IS IT BETTER ? ◆ ◆ ◆ 
▸ See all features: bit.ly/TheVault-Features
▸ The Vault is very simple to use, yet it employs industry-standard encryption to keep your data safe.
(Some other payed apps do too, but some apps advertised as "secure" really do not, and for example save your data using a simple base-64 encoding: your information looks scrambled, but is as readable as plain text when you know how).
▸ The Vault can securely store photos and pictures; for example a scan of your passport, a photo of your credit card, or just the serial numbers of some equipment you own. Anything.
▸ The Vault can securely store *any* office or other document.
▸ The Vault can securely store - and play - animated GIFs.
▸ Securely storing photos and documents is as easy as drag-and-dropping them on an open Note.
▸ Proper random password generation
▸ Auto-shields sensitive information
▸ Securely synchronizes with The Vault for iOS! Please note that you need to have the SecureSync feature installed on your iOS devices for them to be able to SecureSync with The Vault for Mac.
▸ Supports Mojave Dark Mode
◆ ◆ ◆ TECHNICAL DETAILS ◆ ◆ ◆
This is the part that matters.
This is the part that is hard to get right.
This is the part that makes the difference between actual security and insecurity.
Claiming “military-grade” or “industry standard” encryption is meaningless.
Even claiming “256-bit AES encryption”, in itself is not very meaningful.
Example:
Claiming “military-grade” encryption and subsequently simply hashing a master passcode - e.g. using SHA, MD5 - is NOT good. 
What ís good is to use a proper key derivation algorithm such as PBKDF2, scrypt or bcrypt.
Another example: 
AES is better than older algorithms such as Blowfish, Twofish or 3DES. 
But even for AES: an app that does not combine encryption with authentication... is doing it wrong. Currently there is some consensus that the best construct is to first encrypt a message and then calculate a message-authentication code, instead of the other way around.
These things matter.
◆ ◆ ◆
The Vault uses PBKDF2 key derivation with an HMAC-SHA512 PRF, and HMAC-SHA256 Encrypt-then-MAC authenticated 256-bit AES encryption, using CommonCrypto functionality only. All cipher and MAC worker keys, as well as all salts and IVs, are purely random data. Keys and IVs are never reused. Each singular piece of data is encrypted with a unique random encryption key, and authenticated with a unique random HMAC key.
Your Master Passcode is never stored; and neither are the derived cipher keys.
◆ ◆ ◆
THE ONLY THING ●YOU● HAVE TO DO?
Choose a long master passcode. Make it long, and make it random!

apple-macos:1521553621.name: Physical Scanner Connect
apple-macos:1521553621.description:
Scan paper to your iPhone or iPad with the scanner in your printer. No printer app. No account.
Put your pages in the printer and tap Scan. You get flat, sharp pages from a real scanner, as a PDF you can save or send. The app finds scanners on your Wi-Fi by itself.
Scanning is free, so you can check that it works with your printer first. Saving and sharing need a one-time purchase. No subscription.
WHAT DO YOU NEED TO DO?
Need to send a letter, a contract or a form?
Scan it, then tap Send to email it as a PDF. Or tap Save to keep it in Files. All the pages go into one PDF.
Have a stack printed on both sides?
Put it in the feeder, the tray on top of your printer, and tap Scan. You get the pages in order, and blank back sides are left out. If your feeder scans one side only, the app asks you for the back sides and puts the pages in order.
Want your old family photos on your iPhone or iPad?
Tap Document and choose Photos. Lay several photos face down and straight on the glass, a finger's width apart, and put a sheet of dark paper over them. It helps the app cut each photo out. Tap Scan. When the app can see where each photo ends, each one becomes its own picture. Tap Save to add them to Photos.
Need a copy of a receipt or an ID card?
Put it on the glass and tap Scan. The app crops it to its edges when it can see them.
Need to find a word in a scan, or copy text from it?
Open your saved PDF. Printed text inside is searchable, and you can copy it.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Connect your iPhone or iPad to the same Wi-Fi as your printer.
2. Open the app and tap Continue. Your iPhone or iPad asks if the app may find devices on your Wi-Fi. Allow it. That is how the app reaches your scanner.
3. Put your pages in the feeder or on the glass, and tap Scan. Keep the app open until the scan is done.
4. Tap Save to keep the PDF in Files, or Send to share it by Mail, Messages, AirDrop and more. Saving and sharing need the one-time purchase.
Your scanner is remembered. Next time, just tap Scan. To use another scanner, tap its name near the Scan button.
GOOD TO KNOW
- Color, paper size and quality are chosen for you. Tap Options to change them.
- No feeder? Scan one page at a time on the glass. Tap Scan More for the next page.
- Pages of text scanned upside down or sideways are turned the right way up.
- Rotate, reorder or delete pages, and rename your scan, before you save.
- PDFs are kept small, so most scans are easy to email.
- Need pictures instead of a PDF? Tap the title at the top, then Save as Images.
- Paper jam? The app tells you which sheet to put back and keeps the pages already scanned.
- Closed the app before saving or sending? Your pages are still there when you come back.
- The app keeps no list of old scans. Once saved, you find them in Files or Photos.
WILL IT WORK WITH MY PRINTER?
You need a printer with a scanner, or a scanner, that can scan over Wi-Fi without its maker's app. Many Wi-Fi printers can. Some need network scanning turned on in their own settings.
The quickest way to know is to scan a page. It is free.
The app does not scan with the camera. A scanner connected only by a USB cable can't be used with iPhone or iPad.
Can't find your scanner? Tap Get Help in the app. It shows what to check, and you can add your scanner by its address.
ONE-TIME PURCHASE
One purchase unlocks saving and sharing on your iPhone, iPad and Mac with the same Apple Account. No subscription.
Bought it on your Mac? You won't pay again. If saving is still locked, tap Restore Purchase in the app's Settings.
YOUR PRIVACY
Your scans stay on your iPhone or iPad until you save or send them. No account, no ads, no analytics.
Questions? support@futuraapp.com

flathub:org.guitarix.Guitarix.description: guitarix is a virtual guitar amplifier for Linux running on Jack Audio Connection Kit. guitarix takes the signal from your guitar as any real amp would do: as a mono-signal from your sound card. The input is processed by a main amp and a rack-section. Both can be routed separately and deliver a processed stereo-signal via Jack. You may fill the rack with effects from more than 25 built-in modules including stuff from a simple noise gate to brain-slashing modulation f/x like flanger, phaser or auto-wah.

flathub:org.kde.kbibtex.name: KBibTeX
flathub:org.kde.kbibtex.summary: BibTeX editor by KDE to edit bibliographies used with LaTeX
flathub:org.kde.kbibtex.description:
KBibTeX is a reference management application which can be used to collect TeX/LaTeX bibliographies
 and export them in various formats.
 KBibTeX can do the following things:
 Preview bibliography entries in various formats (Source (BibTeX), Source (RIS), Wikipedia,
 standard (XML/XSLT), fancy (XML/XSLT), and abstract-only (XML/XSLT)). Additional preview styles
 become available when bibtex2html is installed.
 Import data in various bibliography file formats such as BibTeX, RIS and ISI (requires bibutils)
 and export data to PDF (requires pdflatex), PostScript (requires latex), RTF (requires latex2rtf),
 and HTML.
 Search for the bibliography entries data in online databases (e.g. Google Scholar, ACM, IEEE,
 arXiv, etc.)
 Preview local or remote (online) resources, e.g. PDF files, linked in the BibTEX entry.
 Find and merge duplicate entries in bibliography.
 Integrate your bibliographies with LaTeX editors such as Kile and LyX.
 Import your Zotero library.

fedora-packages:gap-pkg-guava/gap-pkg-gu.name: gap-pkg-guava
fedora-packages:gap-pkg-guava/gap-pkg-gu.description: GUAVA is a package that implements coding theory algorithms in GAP. Codes can be created and manipulated and information about codes can be calculated. GUAVA consists of various files written in the GAP language, and an external program from J. S. Leon for dealing with automorphism groups of codes and isomorphism testing functions. Several algorithms that need the speed are integrated in the GAP kernel. The functions within GUAVA can be divided into four categories: - Construction of codes. GUAVA can construct non-linear, linear and cyclic codes over an arbitrary finite field. Examples are HadamardCode, ReedMullerCode, BestKnownLinearCode, QRCode and GoppaCode. - Manipulation of codes. These functions allow the user to transform one code into another or to construct a new code from two codes. Examples are PuncturedCode, DualCode, DirectProductCode and UUVCode. - Computation of information about codes. This information is stored in the code record. Examples are MinimumDistance, OuterDistribution, IsSelfDualCode and AutomorphismGroup. - Generation of bounds on linear codes. The table by Brouwer and Verhoeff (as it existed in the mid-1990s) is incorporated into GUAVA. For example, BoundsMinimumDistance.

fedora-packages:mpv/mpv.description: Mpv is a movie player based on MPlayer and mplayer2. It supports a wide variety of video file formats, audio and video codecs, and subtitle types. Special input URL types are available to read input from a variety of sources other than disk files. Depending on platform, a variety of different video and audio output methods are supported. Mpv has an OpenGL, Vulkan, and D3D11 based video output that is capable of many features loved by videophiles, such as video scaling with popular high quality algorithms, color management, frame timing, interpolation, HDR, and more. While mpv strives for minimalism and provides no real GUI, it has a small controller on top of the video for basic control. Mpv can leverage most hardware decoding APIs on all platforms. Hardware decoding can be enabled at runtime on demand. Powerful scripting capabilities can make the player do almost anything. There is a large selection of user scripts on the wiki. A straightforward C API was designed from the ground up to make mpv usable as a library and facilitate easy integration into other applications.

firefox-addons:3049422.name: Screen Share Privacy & Blur - Privacy Lens
firefox-addons:3049422.summary: Blur or hide media, redact sensitive text and form fields, protect tab titles, and restore pages after screen shares or recordings.
firefox-addons:3049422.description:
Privacy Lens adds a compact, draggable privacy controller to ordinary webpages. Use it before a screen share, recording, public presentation, or shoulder-surf risk to blur or hide images and video, apply adjustable page blur, protect selected or all tab titles, and conceal emails, phone numbers, payment cards, crypto addresses and keys, API tokens, credential values, or chosen terms.
Sensitive text can use a document-style black redaction or a blur. Built-in categories are individually selectable, custom words stay literal, and advanced users can add bounded custom regex rules. Every control is reversible, and dynamic page content is handled automatically.
Core controls run locally. Optional NSFW image screening is disabled by default. If enabled, the extension compresses images to at most 512 px and sends only those image bytes to the API selected by the user. No account, analytics, page-text upload, browsing-history sync, or remote scripts.
Watch the product demo: https://youtu.be/g2kbE6A6loA 
Learn more: https://labs.wiplash.ai/privacy-lens/ 
Source: https://github.com/Wiplash-ai/privacy-lens

firefox-addons:3026961.description:
Wary Security Companion is the browser half of Wary Security. As you browse it does two things:
 Warns you about fake and phishing sites. When a page is built to look like a real site (a lookalike of Steam, Discord, your bank and so on) it's blocked with a full screen warning before it loads, with the choice to go back or continue anyway.

You'll need the Wary Security desktop app installed and running with browser protection turned on, which is part of Wary Pro. The extension talks only to the app on your own machine over 127.0.0.1. Nothing about the pages you visit is sent to us or anyone else.

firefox-addons:3049387.name: Udemy Translator
firefox-addons:3049387.summary: A Firefox extension that translates subtitles of Udemy content and reads them out with a synthetic voice.
firefox-addons:3049387.description:
Udemy Translator
Udemy Translator is a browser extension that translates subtitles on Udemy video lectures in real time and reads them aloud using native Operating System Text-to-Speech (TTS) voices.
Key Features
Real-Time Subtitle Translation: Automatically translates captions into your preferred target language as you watch Udemy courses.
Native OS Text-to-Speech (TTS): Reads translated subtitles out loud using high-quality system TTS voices installed on your device.
Multiple Translation Providers: Supports MyMemory Translation API as default and Google Translate with automatic failover between services.
Adaptive Speed Synchronization: Dynamically adjusts speech speed (up to 3.0x) to ensure audio finishes reading before the next subtitle cue appears.
Instant Audio Control: Audio immediately stops when you pause or seek through a video.
Customizable Subtitle Overlay: Moveable caption box over the video player with adjustable font size and background transparency.
Full Volume Control: Comes with full volume output (100% by default) and configurable speech rate.
Multilingual Support: Supports over 30 languages including Arabic, English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, and more.
System Requirements
To enable text-to-speech reading in your target language, ensure that the corresponding TTS voice package is installed on your operating system:
Windows:
Open Settings > Time & Language > Speech.
Click Add voices and select your desired target language (e.g., Arabic, Spanish, French).
macOS:
Open System Settings > Accessibility > Spoken Content.
Click System Voice and download the voice pack for your target language.
Linux / Android:
Install standard speech synthesis engine packages (such as speech-dispatcher or Google Speech Services).
User Guide & How to Use
1. Installation
Install the extension in your browser (Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, or Mozilla Firefox).
Click on the extension icon in your browser toolbar to open the settings panel.
2. Basic Configuration
Translation: Turn ON to enable real-time subtitle translation.
Translate To: Select your desired target language.
Translation Provider: Choose between MyMemory (Free) or Google Translate.
Speak: Turn ON to enable voice reading of subtitles.
Voice Selection: Choose your preferred installed system voice engine.
Volume & Speed: Adjust volume level and base speech rate.
Font Size & Opacity: Customize subtitle text appearance on the screen.
3. Usage on Udemy
Open any course video on Udemy.
Turn ON captions/subtitles in the Udemy video player.
The extension will automatically translate the captions and read them aloud in sync with the video.
Pausing the video automatically stops the audio immediately.

firefox-addons:936501.name: Download with FlashGet
firefox-addons:936501.summary: when activated, interrupts the built-in download manager to direct links to FlashGet
firefox-addons:936501.description:
This extension offers integration with FlashGet download manager. By default the toolbar icon is disabled. In this mode, downloads are handled by the internal download manager. Once the extension is enabled from the toolbar button (when the icon is colorful), then an observer is installed. This observer monitors new downloads and sends requests to FlashGet and cancels the built-in downloads. It is also possible to use right-click over links option to send links to FlashGet without installing the download observer.
Notes:
1. For the extension to work you need to have FlashGet (version 1.7 or 1.9) installed; FlashGet 1.9.6.1073 https://filehippo.com/download_flashget/3229/ 
FlashGet 1.73 https://filehippo.com/download_flashget/1541/ 
2. FlashGet versions 3.x do not support command-line options and hence are not supported.
3. For the extension to be able to start FlashGet and communicate with it, a small native client is required. This native client can be found at https://github.com/belaviyo/native-client/releases . You will get the instruction on how to install this native client when extension tries to communicate for the first time.
For more info please visit:
 http://add0n.com/download-with.html?from=flashget

firefox-addons:2932951.name: TanStack Query DevTools
firefox-addons:2932951.summary: Real-time TanStack Query devtools in your browser. Inspect queries, mutations, and cache — with zero bundle impact.
firefox-addons:2932951.description:
Debug TanStack Query without shipping devtools to production. 
See every query and mutation the moment it changes — cache state, status
transitions, full data payloads — from your browser toolbar or right inside
DevTools. No package to install, no bundle to grow, nothing to strip before
release.
 WHAT YOU GET 
 Live inspection — queries and mutations update in real time as your app runs
 Deep dive — status, data, and metadata for any single query or mutation
 Interactive data tree — expand, collapse, and explore deeply nested payloads
 Inline editing — change cached data on the spot and watch your UI react
 One-click cache actions — invalidate, refetch, reset, or remove queries; clear the mutation cache
 Status at a glance — fresh, stale, fetching, paused, inactive, error
 Search & sort — find any query by key; sort by key, status, or last updated
 Two ways to work — toolbar popup for a quick peek, DevTools panel for a real session
 Stays connected — survives page navigation within the tab
 SETUP IS ONE LINE 
 window.__TANSTACK_QUERY_CLIENT__ = queryClient;
Reload your app. The toolbar icon lights up the moment a QueryClient is
detected. Click it for the popup, or open DevTools → TanStack Query for the
full panel.
 WHY NOT THE BUILT-IN DEVTOOLS? 
 Zero bundle impact — nothing ships to production, ever
 Framework-agnostic — React, Vue, Solid, Svelte, Angular: if it runs TanStack Query, it works
 Sits alongside your other DevTools panels instead of floating over your app
 No conditional imports, no tree-shaking tricks, no cleanup before release
Free and open source (MIT):
 github.com/DeeCode-inc/tanstack-query-chrome-devtools

bluejetty:00177497:ios.description:
The Trail will lead you to adventure and fortune!
Join our pioneers on a vast journey across country unknown. Set forth to reach the town of Eden Falls - explore, craft, collect, trade, discover, and eventually settle and build. 
The newest game from Peter Molyneux, legendary designer and creator of the God Game genre, brings the frontier to life on your mobile device. Peter Molyneux’s previous games include Theme Park, Dungeon Keeper, Fable, Populous, and Godus.
Features of The Trail include:
BEAUTIFUL
Take in the view as you walk The Trail through different landscapes and fantastic vistas.
RELAXING
Using only your thumb, swipe and drag to move delightfully along The Trail. Designed for everyone to pick up and enjoy.
MAKE YOUR FORTUNE
Travel to the new world to make your fortune! Learn to craft and trade.
BUILD A COMMUNITY
Join a town to unlock more features and work together to make your town the best in the new world!
COMPANION
Befriend an interactive pet dog to accompany you on your journey, and play together to unwind when at home.
UNIQUE
You've never played anything like The Trail!

• Digital collectibles and profile customization
• Merchandise and partner rewards
• Limited time drops tied to major events
Everything in the Marketplace is unlocked through engagement.
Built for Fans Who Play
Follow what you love, play along with the moments that matter, and turn fandom into progression, status, and rewards.
Your fandom deserves more.
Download Clout and start playing today.

bluejetty:00143285:ios.description:
Tone Studio: The All In One App For Creators
Tone Studio is your go-to app for creating beautifully curated photo and video content with ease. Whether you’re posting to Instagram, building a brand, or just refining your personal aesthetic, Tone Studio gives you the tools to create standout content.
What you can do:
Film Camera Filters
Get the look of analog film with 6 custom film cameras and 14 unique film stock filters.
130 Professional Presets
Choose from over 130 carefully designed filters—think film-inspired, vintage, minimal, moody, black & white, and much more!
Instagram Feed Planner
Use the built-in feed planner to preview your Instagram grid, manage multiple accounts, and design your layout before you post. Seamlessly switch between our editing studio and feed planner to adjust content inside the planner in seconds.
Templates
Photo and video templates ready to go in story and post format! Choose between our variety of categories such as Classic, Photo Booth, Creative, Camera Roll, and more.
Layered Effects & Frames
Add overlays like dust, light leaks, and timestamps. Use vintage-style frames to give your content the artistic film look.
Typography Tools
Add modern, stylish text with easy-to-use templates and a curated selection of fonts.
Detailed Adjustments
Fine-tune every edit with tools for HSL, blur, grain, shadows, and many other pro-level settings.
Subscriptions
Silver Plan: $3.99/month or $19.99/year
Gold Plan: $5.99/month or $39.99/year
Subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off in your iTunes settings at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period.
Contact Us
Questions or feedback? Contact us at hello@tonestudio.app or www.instagram.com/tonestudio
Your Tone subscription will automatically renew 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off your subscription at any time from your iTunes account settings. You will not receive refunds for the unused portion of your term. 
Read our terms of use at: http://tonestudio.app/terms/
Read our privacy policy at: http://tonestudio.app/privacy/

bluejetty:00157587:ios.description:
Halal Food Scanner & Checker for Muslims
◆ How It Works: ◆
1. Scan: Use your camera to scan a product's ingredient list.
2. Analyze: Our AI instantly identifies and analyzes each ingredient.
3. Verify: Get a clear, simple breakdown of the halal status for each item with explanations from Islamic scholars.
Taste Halal is one of the most advanced AI-powered app for Muslims to verify food, medicine, cosmetics and healthcare products. Whether you're at a grocery store, a restaurant, or traveling abroad, our app is your trusted companion, making it effortless to find out if a product is halal, haram, or mushbooh.
◆ Key Features: ◆
• AI Ingredient & Text Scanner: Unlike other halal checker apps that rely solely on a limited barcode database, our powerful AI can read and analyze ingredient lists directly from a photo.
• Comprehensive Halal Database: Get access to a massive database of over 9,500 ingredients, including E-numbers and food additives.
• Multilingual Support (18+ Languages): Our app can recognize and scan text in 18 of the most widely spoken languages, including English, Arabic, German, French, Italian, Spanish and much more... to give you accurate results.
• In-Depth Education & Awareness: Taste Halal provides detailed explanations for ingredients marked as non-halal, along with authentic scholarly fatwas and referenced articles. Learn about what you're eating and why.
• Barcode Scanning & Gallery Import: Use your device's camera to scan a product's barcode or select an image from your gallery for quick verification.
Barcode scanning often fails, leaving you unsure about what's in your food. Taste Halal solves this by using cutting-edge AI to directly scan ingredients from a product's label, providing instant and reliable results.
◆ Who is this app for? ◆
• Perfect for Muslims in the USA, UK, Europe, Australia, and other regions where halal options are not always obvious.
• Anyone traveling abroad who needs to quickly check if local products are suitable for their diet.
• For anyone seeking detailed information and peace of mind about what they consume, beyond just a halal label.
◆Disclaimer:◆
Taste Halal is designed as a guide to assist you in making informed choices. While we have invested significant effort into ensuring the accuracy of our data and AI analysis, the final determination of a product's Halal status rests with the individual consumer and their trusted religious authorities. We are continuously working to improve our services and welcome your feedback.
In'Sha'Allah, we hope this app serves as a valuable resource and provides a more comprehensive solution for the global Muslim community.
Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00015749:ios.name: Statistics Calculator--
bluejetty:00015749:ios.summary: Statistics Calculator-- is an introductory app for our flagship Statistics Calculator++, a calculator with great advanced scientific features as well as statistical, regression analysis, probability distributions, confidence intervals, and
bluejetty:00015749:ios.description:
Statistics Calculator-- is an introductory app for our flagship Statistics Calculator++, a calculator with great advanced scientific features as well as statistical, regression analysis, probability distributions, confidence intervals, and hypothesis tests capabilities. 
Statistics Calculator-- will have all the functionality of Statistics Calculator++ by purchasing a single In-App Purchase. 
The purchase will remove the limit on the size of the lists, unlocks the advanced scientific features, graphs the regression models, and unlocks probability distributions, confidence intervals, and hypothesis tests capabilities.
In designing the statistics functions of this app we had one thing in mind: The user should not need to read a single line of manual to perform the statistical analysis. 
Simply use Add X, Add Y, and Add f buttons to enter the elements of the lists and frequencies, if any. And you are done. All the statistics and regression models are only a few taps and swipes away. Tap the List button to see the lists entered. The elements of the lists are interpreted independently (as two separate lists) and jointly for regression analysis (if the size of the lists are equal). 
The sum, mean, population standard deviation, sample standard deviation, sample variance, sum of squares, min, max, quartiles, and sum of multiplications of two lists are presented in a table. Each statistics measure can be chosen from the table and used for further calculations. 
For regression analysis linear regression, logarithmic regression, exponential regression, power regression, and quadratic regression (through an additional In-App Purchase) are calculated. Statistics Calculator-- has an extremely simple and intuitive user interface to choose the regression model and calculate predictions for x and y values and view residuals and residual sum of squares. 
Other major features of Statistics Calculator-- are:
- The left pane scrolls to reveal more functionality without a need to switch modes. The digits and most common operations are always visible and the less common operations can be revealed by scrolling the left half of the screen.
- Shows the expression as you enter and keeps a history of your calculations (Swipe up on the screen to reveal the history)
- Backspace to delete last digit entered.
- Sinusoidal functions can be calculated for angles in units of degrees, radians, or gradians.
The following features are available through Advanced Scientific In-App Purchase. 
- Capability of performing fraction manipulations and converting between different formats (proper, improper, and mixed fractions) and seamless integration of fraction, integer, and decimal manipulations.
- Capability of inputting degrees, minutes, and seconds for angles and converting between degrees-minutes-seconds format and decimal format.
- Capability of calculating permutation, combination, Least Common Multiple (LCM), Greatest Common Divisor (GCD), and prime factorization.
- Quadratic and system of two linear equations solver
- Rectangular to polar and polar to rectangular coordinate conversion (extremely useful for phasor calculations for electrical engineers)
- Throws a set of dice (choice of 1 die to 4 dice)
You are going to love the simplicity of the user interface and yet have the powerful functionality with which Statistics Calculator-- is loaded.
Please do not hesitate to contact us for any questions, comments, to report any bugs, or to suggest additional functions you would like to see in the upcoming updates.

bluejetty:00044464:ios.name: NissanConnect® EV & Services
bluejetty:00044464:ios.summary: The NissanConnect® EV & Services** app is designed especially for owners and drivers of the Nissan LEAF® (Model Year 2018-2025). The NissanConnect EV & Services** app lets you manage the unique features of your LEAF like charging the batter
bluejetty:00044464:ios.description:
The NissanConnect® EV & Services** app is designed especially for owners and drivers of the Nissan LEAF® (Model Year 2018-2025). The NissanConnect EV & Services** app lets you manage the unique features of your LEAF like charging the battery, adjusting climate controls and checking the battery status, all from your mobile device. You can also personalize the app dashboard with the features that you use the most. 
LEAF drivers require an active subscription to access the features of NissanConnect EV**, but it is complimentary for the first three years of ownership. 
NissanConnect EV & Services is available for the following models and trim levels (Model Year 2018-2025):
- LEAF SV
- LEAF SV PLUS
- LEAF SL PLUS
Model year 2018-2025 LEAF owners require an active subscription to NissanConnect EV with Services** powered by SiriusXM®. If you have not yet enrolled in NissanConnect EV with Services** download the NissanConnect EV & Services app or visit www.owners.nissanusa.com.
For more information on set up and using the NissanConnect EV & Services** app visit www.owners.nissanusa.com or contact a NissanConnect EV Customer Support Specialist at (877) NO GAS EV , Monday through Saturday, 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time.
Have feedback? Open the main menu in the app and click "HELP & SUPPORT". From there, you'll find methods to reach a NissanConnect EV Customer Support Specialist, like by calling (877) NO GAS EV or by sending an email to Nissanownerservices@nissan-usa.com. Please make sure to mention your device type to ensure that we can properly address your feedback.
This app allows model year 2018-2025 LEAF owners to access these features**: 
•Remote Start Charge
•Remote Battery Status Check
•Remote Climate Control On/Off
•Remote Climate Control Timer
•Plug-in Reminder Notification
•Charge Complete Notification
•My Car Finder*
•Remote Door Lock/Unlock*
•Remote Horn & Lights*
•Curfew, Boundary and Speed alerts*
•and more
Please see important information below on 3G cellular network discontinuatio impacting MY11-17 LEAF vehicles***.
Please note that the Apple Watch app is a companion app and cannot be used without first downloading the iOS app and logging in.
* Feature availability is dependent on vehicle model, trim level, packaging and options.
** Available services/features may be shown. Use feature only when safe and legal. Compatible device and service required. Subject to third party service availability. For more information see http://www.nissanusa.com/connect/legal
***The NissanConnect Services telematics program is affected by AT&T’s decision to discontinue its 3G cellular network. As of February 22, 2022, all Nissan vehicles equipped with telematics hardware compatible for use with the 3G cellular network will be unable to connect to the 3G network and unable to access the NissanConnect Services features. Clients having purchased a Nissan vehicle with this type of hardware must have enrolled in NissanConnect Services prior to June 1, 2021 to activate the service to have received access through February 22, 2022 (access is subject to cellular network availability and coverage limitations). For more information, please visit http://www.nissanusa.com/connect/support.

bluejetty:00073704:ios.summary:
The most intuitive workout and exercise tracker for any fitness routine.
Strong is the simplest and most intuitive workout tracker, designed to help you get better results from your workouts. Whether you want to gain strength or just stay
bluejetty:00073704:ios.description:
The most intuitive workout and exercise tracker for any fitness routine.
Strong is the simplest and most intuitive workout tracker, designed to help you get better results from your workouts. Whether you want to gain strength or just stay healthy, join over 1.2 million people who have downloaded Strong to stay on track in the gym.
“I’d suggest downloading the “Strong” app before you return to the gym. It’s that good” - CNBC
“with apps like Strong, working out feels more like a game” - The Verge
“I have used nearly every logging app since the App Store launched. This is the best bar none”
“I use this every time I go to the gym and seriously couldn't train without it”
“Simple. Intuitive. Functional. Exactly what I was looking for.”
“This is bare bones and serious. Right on, and works perfectly... I wish I could give 10 stars.”
“It's by far the most intuitive and easy to use workout app I’ve used.”
Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced powerlifter, Strong provides everything you need to record your workouts as effortlessly and as quickly as possible. Unlike other fitness apps, Strong doesn’t bog you down with distractions and unnecessary gimmicks you’d never use.
Strong is optimized for a progressive barbell routine such as Starting Strength or StrongLifts 5x5, but it is easily adaptable to any other routine of your choosing!
FEATURES:
• The simplest interface of any fitness app in the App Store
• A comprehensive range of cardio and strength exercises - and add your own too!
• Fully-featured Apple Watch app to log workouts with or without your iPhone
• Add your own routines and easily choose between them
• Detailed exercise instructions with a growing library of animated videos
• Advanced Statistics show your personal records and progression and even calculate your one rep max and total weight lifted!
• Built in Auto Countdown Timer to help record rest breaks
• Support for multiple Exercise Types, including Assisted Bodyweight and Duration Exercises
• Tag sets as Warm Up, Failure or Drop Sets
• Supersets/Grouped Exercises
• Track your progress with graphs for Volume and 1RM Progression
• Automatically back up your data with Cloud Sync!
• Built in body measurements tracker to record your weight and other vitals, with support for Apple Health
• Warm Up Calculator tells you which weights to warm up with
• Plate Calculator for when the weights get high
• Support for Imperial (lbs) and Metric (kg) weights, or a combination of both
• Add notes and progress pictures to your workouts
• Share sheet makes sharing routines and workouts with friends easier than ever!
• Export all of your data to Notes or Email in CSV format
The free version of Strong can save unlimited workouts, but is limited to 3 custom routines. Upgrade to a Strong PRO subscription ($4.99/month or $29.99/year) for an unlimited number of routines and to unlock additional PRO features.
Strong will automatically charge your iTunes Account at the end of your subscription or free trial period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of your current period. Subscriptions renew at the original price. You can turn off auto-renew at any time and still receive full functionality until the end of your current period, but no refund can be provided for unused portions of the subscription. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
If you’ve previously purchased “Unlock Strong” or “Strong Combo Pack”, you’ll be able to use the Restore Purchases option in the app for access to all Strong PRO features.
These prices are for customers in the United States and may vary depending on your iTunes Account settings. In-app purchases and subscriptions cannot be shared using Family Sharing.
Strong Terms of Service - https://help.strongapp.io/article/179-strong-terms-of-service
Strong Privacy Policy - https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/7760215

Transform your body while dancing to music you love. Dance Workout makes losing weight enjoyable with fun, effective cardio routines you can do anywhere, anytime. No gym required, no boring exercises—just pure dancing energy that melts away calories and builds confidence.
WHY DANCE WORKOUT WORKS
Forgettable workout struggles? Dance Workout solves the motivation problem that stops most fitness journeys. Our guided dance routines disguise intense cardio as entertainment. Whether you're a complete beginner or experienced dancer, our adaptive choreography meets you exactly where you are.
KEY FEATURES THAT DELIVER RESULTS
Personalized Dance Programs: Choose from beginner-friendly to advanced choreography across multiple dance styles including hip hop, Latin, pop, and aerobic fusion. Each routine targets specific goals—weight loss, toning, or cardiovascular health.
Full-Body Transformation: Burn belly fat, shape your legs, tone your arms, and strengthen your core while improving coordination, flexibility, and stamina.
Flexible Scheduling: Sessions range from quick 10-minute energy boosters to comprehensive 45-minute fat-burning routines. Dance during lunch breaks, before breakfast, or whenever your schedule allows.
No Equipment Needed: Your living room becomes your dance studio. No weights, no machines, no expensive gear—just you, your phone, and space to move.
Every Level Welcome: Modifications ensure accessibility regardless of fitness level or dance experience.
HOW DANCE WORKOUT TRANSFORMS LIVES
Dance Workout app succeeds where others fail because it rewires your relationship with fitness. Exercise becomes something you want to do, not something you force yourself through.
The low-impact nature protects your joints while delivering high-intensity cardio benefits. Perfect for anyone recovering from injury, managing joint sensitivity, or simply preferring gentler movement that still produces serious results.
BUILT FOR REAL PEOPLE, REAL RESULTS
We understand that life is hectic. Kids, careers, responsibilities—finding time for yourself feels impossible. Dance Workout respects your reality with efficient, effective sessions that maximize calorie burn in minimal time. No commute to the gym, no class schedules to coordinate, no judgment from strangers. Just you, your goals, and a straightforward path forward.
Our approach combines cardiovascular exercise with strength training elements and flexibility work, creating comprehensive fitness in one enjoyable package. You'll improve balance, posture, and body awareness while sculpting a leaner, stronger physique.
START YOUR TRANSFORMATION TODAY
Download Dance Workout app now and experience why dancing is the most enjoyable path to your fitness goals. Your first session will show that losing weight doesn't require suffering—it requires the right approach. Let's dance our way to a healthier, happier you.

Whether you're booking a last-minute getaway or planning a dream vacation, our app streamlines the booking process for a stress-free experience.

Whether you prefer to book online or seek personalized assistance, our app has you covered. With just a tap, you can easily book your travel accommodations online or choose to speak with one of our customer service representatives for expert guidance and support. Whatever your booking preference, our app will give you the freedom to plan your travel your way!

Whether you're booking a flight, hotel, accomodation, or car rental, you can book with confidence knowing that your information is in good hands.

Whether you're looking for the best restaurants, attractions, or activities, our app has everything you need to plan the perfect itinerary. 
Endless Vacations and Getaways:

bluejetty:00024845:ios.description:
Number Puzzle
===========
Number Puzzle - Classic Slide Puzzle is a classic math game puzzle.
Tap on wood number tiles & move to empty space. You need to focus & challenge yourself to solve as soon as you can.
If you getting stuck show the tutorial.
6 Mods
--------
3 х 3, 4 х 4, 5 х 5, 6 х 6, 7 х 7, 8 х 8
Water Sort Puzzle
=============
Liquid water color pouring sorting puzzle game.
1500+ levels.
9+ skins.
Tap on any bottle to pour another one.
You can pour only with the same water color or an empty bottle.
Ball Sort Puzzle
============
1500+ levels.
Pick a ball & put it on an empty tube or tube which contains the same color ball on top of the stack.
The tube contains 3,4,5 or 6 balls.
Undo the ball whenever you want.
Tile Match
========
1900+ levels.
Match the double tiles.
In this game, you need to match 2 blocks.
Easy gameplay with lots of challenges.
Whenever you clear all the blocks level clear!!!
The matching tile contains numbers, alphabets, & many more.
As much as you play, Harder levels will come.
Getting stuck! Use a hint to search matching tile or Undo the tile from the panel & back to the board.
Wood Block Puzzle
===============
Drag and drop blocks into a 9×9 grid.
Shapes like: L, T, J, square, etc…
Fill blocks in a vertical or horizontal line to clear them.
Getting stuck! Use a hammer to remove adjacent blocks.
Block Move Puzzle / UnBlock Me Puzzle
=============================
1000+ levels.
Slide wood block vertically or horizontally.
Make a clear path for the red block.
It looks easy to play but hard to master.
Horizontal block move side by side while vertical blocks move up & down.
Getting stuck! Use block remover.
5 Mode 
--------
Beginner, Advanced, Master, Expert, Challenge
Sudoku
======
Solve sudoku puzzles, and expand your mathematical skill.
Keep your mind focused & solve the puzzle.
Challenge yourself & brake your own record.
Use a hint while stuck.
10,000+ levels.
Highlighting rows & columns for the selected cell.
The eraser will help you to remove your mistake.
9x9 grid.
3 Mode 
--------
Easy, Medium, Hard
Water Pipe Repair
=============
You need to rotate the pipe pieces & make a working pipeline.
Challenge yourself & finish the puzzle in minimum moves.
350+ levels.
4 Modes & Levels
------------------
Simple - 50
Normal - 100
Extra - 100
Hard - 100
Tic Tac Toe
========
5 different game levels for one & two players.
50 unique levels.
AI is too smart.
The more you play, the more you learn.
Mode
------
Single Player - You are playing with AI/Computer. Best AI you will see.
Multiplayer - You can play with your friends, family, or colleagues.
Single & Multi-Player 
---------------------
3 X 3, 5 X 5, 6 X 6, 8 X 8, 10 X 10
Levels
-------
50+ levels.
All levels are unique.
You can play with a single-player or multi-player.
As much as you play difficulty levels will increase.
How to play?
-------------
Put the ‘O’ or ‘X’ in the empty box.
make horizontal or vertical or cross puzzles & win the game.
Block your opponent from winning.
Play strategically.
Find Object
========
250+ levels.
Find the objects from given sets of objects.
All the objects are families because you used them in your day-to-day life.
Time limit, so you need to find the object as fast as you can.
Swap Puzzle
==========
Pick the puzzle piece & exchange it with the right one
Mode 
------
Classic & Time
Different Levels
---------------
4 х 4, 5 х 5
Color N Roll Puzzle
==============
New brainstorming puzzle for you.
Make the same puzzle as you have given.
You can move the box horizontally & vertically in both directions.
200+ levels.
You can Swap the puzzle pieces.
2 Mode 
-------
3 X 3 - 100 levels
4 X 4 - 100 levels
Game Features
============
Classic design.
Easy to play hard to master.
Improve your logical skills & test your brain power.
Realistic graphics & ambient sound.
Realistic stunning & amazing animations.
Real-time particles & effects
Smooth & simple controls.
User-friendly interface & interactive graphics.

bluejetty:00023458:ios.description:
Bible en français Louis Segond (Traduction King James Version - KJV) Ancien Testament et du Nouveau Testament.
Aussi je vous recommande "Concordance Biblique" - vous trouver dans mes applications.
Après la mort de Segond, la Société biblique britannique et étrangère révise la traduction, en 1910, en choisissant d'autres termes doctrinaux plus conformes à la pensée protestante orthodoxe (par exemple : « sacrificateurs » à la place de « prêtres », « foi » à la place de « fidélité »)6. Cette version 1910 deviendra la traduction protestante la plus lue au cours du xxe siècle.
Jusqu'au 19ème siècle, le protestantisme francophone a pour l'essentiel utilisé la traduction de la Bible réalisée par Olivétan, un cousin de Jean Calvin.
La Compagnie des pasteurs de Genève demande au docteur en théologie Louis Segond de réaliser une nouvelle traduction. Celui-ci traduit les textes à partir de l'hébreu, de l'araméen et du grec, langues "originelles", et non plus d'après la Vulgate latine, comme cela se faisait jusqu'alors. L'Ancien Testament ne comprend pas les textes appelés deutérocanoniques par la tradition catholique.
La version Segond paraît en 1880. Elle connaîtra une très grande diffusion et sera adoptée par l'ensemble du protestantisme francophone. En 1910 parait le texte de la 3ème édition, remanié et révisé. Il laisse mieux apparaître la divinité de Jésus Christ, selon les textes originaux.

bluejetty:00152949:ios.description:
Create professional-quality headshots, portraits, and creative images in seconds with HiShot, your all-in-one AI-powered studio!

bluejetty:00168331:ios.summary: Welcome to the "Good Sorting Game: Quick Match" where organization meets excitement! Immerse yourself in the thrilling world of sorting goods while solving engaging match-3 puzzles. Are you ready to become the ultimate warehouse sorting mas
bluejetty:00168331:ios.description:
Welcome to the "Good Sorting Game: Quick Match" where organization meets excitement! Immerse yourself in the thrilling world of sorting goods while solving engaging match-3 puzzles. Are you ready to become the ultimate warehouse sorting master?
How to Play:
-Sort Goods: Your primary objective is to organize goods on warehouse shelves efficiently. Different shelves will appear with items scattered across them.
-Match-3 Puzzles: But wait, there's a twist! To place the goods onto the shelves, you must solve exhilarating match-3 puzzles. Swap adjacent items to create rows or columns of three or more identical items and watch them disappear.
-Achieve Objectives: Each level will present you with specific goals to achieve within a limited number of moves or time. Strategize your moves carefully to meet these objectives and progress to the next level.
-Unlock Power-Ups: Need a little boost? Unlock and utilize powerful boosters and power-ups strategically to overcome challenging levels. From explosions to color blasts, these tools will help you clear the board with ease.
-Earn Rewards: Successfully completing levels will reward you with coins and stars. Use these rewards to unlock new shelves, power-ups, and other exciting features as you advance through the game.
-Daily Challenges: Keep your skills sharp by tackling daily challenges. Earn extra rewards and test your abilities in special, limited-time events.
-Upgrade Your Warehouse: Customize and upgrade your warehouse with various themes, shelves, and decorations. Make your warehouse truly yours as you progress through the game.
Game Features:
-Unique Gameplay Fusion: Experience the perfect blend of sorting simulation and match-3 puzzle challenges. Stay engaged as you master both aspects of the game.
-Hundreds of Levels: Dive into a vast array of levels, each with its own set of challenges and objectives. From easy to mind-bending, there's something for everyone.
-Colorful Graphics: Enjoy vibrant and eye-catching graphics that bring the warehouse and its contents to life. Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world as you sort goods with style.
-Intuitive Controls: Simple and intuitive touch controls make playing easy for players of all ages. Swipe, tap, and match your way to victory with seamless controls.
-Regular Updates: Stay tuned for regular updates, introducing new levels, challenges, and features to keep the gameplay fresh and exciting.
-Offline Play: No internet connection? No problem! Enjoy the game anytime, anywhere, even when you're offline.
Get ready to embark on an epic sorting adventure like no other in "Good Sorting Game: Quick Match"! Are you up for the challenge? Start sorting and matching now!

bluejetty:00089324:ios.description:
MAKE ROOM FOR MEMORIES: TIDY UP YOUR DEVICE WITH EASE!
Introducing ProCleaner, your fun, fast and secure way to reclaim your device's storage.
DECLUTTER YOUR DEVICE WITH SPEED
Eliminate duplicate photos or bulky files
Preserve cherished memories and important data
You'll be amazed at the amount of space you've been wasting on redundant content!
KEEP ONLY THE CREAM OF THE CROP
Among a sea of similar files, Pro Cleaner will suggest which one is worth keeping
ProCleaner looks for files where...
... you're engaged directly with the camera
... your smile is captured
... focus is on point
However, you have the ultimate control - we don't delete anything without your go-ahead.
SECRET FOLDER
Safely upload photos and videos to a Secret Folder.
Lock them and unlock only with a personal PIN for extra security.
COMPRESS VIDEOS
Utilize our lossless video compression to save up to 90% of video size without losing quality.
THE POWER IS IN YOUR HANDS
After you're done with the cleaning, ProCleaner offers you a chance to review;
ensuring no important file gets deleted inadvertently.
RECLAIM YOUR DEVICE, RECLAIM YOUR PEACE OF MIND
We firmly believe that our main competitors are adorable cats, satisfying videos, or your most-loved puzzle game.
However, ProCleaner provides a unique outcome: Spend time with our app, and you'll see a clutter-free, organized device - not a time-wasting distraction!
SAFEST ROUTE TO A TIDIER DEVICE
Unlike other apps, ProCleaner doesn't require an internet connection to function.
Pro Cleaner operates locally (offline) on your device, so your files can't be misused even if we wanted to :)
ORGANIZE VIDEOS BY SIZE - REMOVE THE BIGGEST FIRST
Start with that 2GB video that’s been occupying unnecessary space for too long.
Pricing & Subscription Terms:
Select from the subscription options for unlimited access to all features:
• Weekly Subscription
• Monthly Subscription
• Yearly Subscription
• Lifetime Subscription
FREE TRIAL FOR 3 DAYS - ENJOY UNLIMITED CLEANING FOR A LIMITED PERIOD
You can cancel your subscription anytime
ProCleaner’s free trial grants you unlimited access to all features for a duration of 3 days. Your account will automatically be charged for renewal, based on your chosen subscription plan, within 24 hours prior to the end of the 3 days free trial period.
You can cancel auto-renewal at any given time, provided that the cancellation is made at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing an auto-renewing subscription.
Manage your subscription directly from your iPhone.
Subscriptions can be managed by the user, and auto-renewal can be turned off by navigating to Account Settings:
Open the Settings app.
Tap your name.
Tap Subscriptions.
Tap the subscription you wish to manage.
Privacy policy: https://linesandgrids.com/procleaner/legal/privacy 
Terms of use: https://linesandgrids.com/procleaner/legal/terms

bluejetty:00039808:ios.description:
*ZWCAD Mobile is a free CAD viewing, drawing and sharing app developed by ZWSOFT. It integrates multiple functions including fast viewing and editing of DWG files, precise measurement, annotation, and printing. ZWCAD Mobile has been developed for nearly ten years. It enables you to view, edit and export drawings of multiple formats such as DWG, DWF, DXF and PDF. Plus, it has an abundant TTF font library, supports precise measurement (accuracy: 8 digits after the decimal point), and provides more than 100 functions, such as annotating, editing, snapping, layer layout and cloud drawing management.
*Trusted by 10 million users, including architects, engineers, construction professionals, field technicians and contractors. Whether it is mechanical drawing, electrical drawing, engineering construction, site survey or interior design, ZWCAD Mobile can handle all tasks easily.
--------View and Edit--------
ZWCAD Mobile supports editing DWG files and viewing DWF, DXF and PDF files.
Editing Tools:
Move, Copy, Rotate, Scale, Erase, Mirror, Align, Edit Text, Grip Edit, Block Attribute Edit.
Drawing Tools:
Circle, Polyline, Line, Rectangle, Arc, Text, Insert Block, Smartpen, Image.
Measuring Tools:
Aligned Dimension, Radial Dimension, Angular Dimension, Linear Dimension, Arc Length Dimension, Coordinate Dimension, Perimeter and Area, Distance, Coordinate Query.
View Mode:
2D and 3D views, Regen, Change Background Color.
Annotating Tools:
Revision Cloud, Brush, Text, Multi-image, SmartVoice.
Exporting Tools:
Export JPEG, PDF or DWF. 
Text Search:
Search for text to quickly find the location.
Modeling Tools:
Switch between the Model space and any other Layout space that are included in your drawing.
Layering Tools:
Create, Rename, Change, Turn On/Off, Delete.
Coloring Tools:
Change the color of the object in the drawing.
Contact us:
tech@zwsoft.com

bluejetty:00155009:ios.description:
Com sede em Uberlândia/MG, a Gosuen presta serviços para condomínios residenciais e comerciais,
Nossa organização é especializada em entender, processar e organizar o conjunto de atividades próprias da Gestão de Condomínios, desenvolvemos forte expertise para entender as particularidades de cada condomínio, resultando no atendimento exclusivo de acordo com as necessidades e objetivos de cada conta.
O resultado de nossa atuação reflete-se na transmissão de conhecimentos específicos, no desenvolvimento de novas habilidades, no aprendizado de novas atitudes que favorecem a convivência, contribuindo com a disseminação de melhores práticas de Gestão Condominial, fundamentada em princípios gerenciais, legais e profissionais, que inclusive passam a valorizar e consolidar o patrimônio.
Tanto pelo site quanto pelo aplicativo Gosuen Gestão Condominial os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com o APP Gosuen Gestão Condominial, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente.
Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para gosuenapp@winker.com.br

bluejetty:00086968:ios.summary: Salmon puts your savings, credit, and loans in one app — available across the Philippines. Whether you're buying something now and paying for it over time, growing your savings, or keeping credit ready for when you need it, it's all here.
bluejetty:00086968:ios.description:
Salmon puts your savings, credit, and loans in one app — available across the Philippines. Whether you're buying something now and paying for it over time, growing your savings, or keeping credit ready for when you need it, it's all here.
- Take home what you need today, pay for it monthly — borrow up to ₱60,000 from 0% down payment and 0% interest with Product Loan, available at over 10,000 partner stores nationwide
- Credit you'll actually use, with cashback to show for it — get a reusable credit line of up to ₱250,000 with 0% interest for up to 62 days, plus earn up to ₱1,250 cashback every month
- Put your money to work — start with as little as ₱5,000 on terms from 6 months to 5 years with Time Deposit
- Grow your savings, then withdraw whenever you need to — with Salmon Save, get a flat 4% p.a. on any balance and zero lock-in
For existing customers
Manage your Credit Line, Product Loan, Moto Loan, Time Deposit, and Salmon Save in one place. Track due dates, check balances, and make repayments, all without visiting a branch.
Find us online 
Facebook: https://facebook.com/salmonphilippines
Website: https://salmon.ph
Now the part our lawyers asked us to include
We handle real money, so there's some fine print.
Salmon app is operated by Salmon Group Ltd and functions as a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) provider. All financial products and services available through the app are issued exclusively by licensed subsidiaries of Salmon Group Ltd. in the Philippines. 
- Sunprime Finance Inc., a financing company registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) (SEC Reg. No. CS201916698, C.A. No. 1241), provides credit services through its Online Lending Platform, LoanOnline. 
- Salmon Bank (Rural Bank) Inc., licensed by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), provides deposit and basic electronic financial services (EPFS). 
Salmon Group Ltd does not issue financial products and acts solely as the technology platform provider. All services offered through the app are available only to users located in the Philippines and require a Philippine mobile number for registration and access.

bluejetty:00185565:ios.description:
Play the most-funded game in Kickstarter history anywhere with the Exploding Kittens® Official mobile game!
The mobile version of the game is available now, including the Party Pack, Betrayal, Streaking Kittens, and the all new Barking Kittens expansion! Play with friends or strangers in online play, challenge the AI, or play offline with friends face-to-face! 
In this highly-strategic, kitty-powered card game, players draw cards until someone draws an Exploding Kitten, at which point they are out of the game -- unless that player has a Defuse card, which can defuse the Kitten using things like laser pointers, belly rubs and catnip sandwiches. All of the other cards in the deck are used to move, mitigate or avoid the Exploding Kittens.
KEY FEATURES:
- Exploding Kittens is a multiplayer card game for people who are into kittens and explosions and laser beams and sometimes goats.
- Play with 2 to 5 players across multiple phones in the same room, or online with friends or strangers
- Featuring original art by The Oatmeal
- New cards exclusive to the digital version of Exploding Kittens
- Digital versions of the hit expansions, including Streaking and Barking Kittens, as well as digital exclusive Betrayal and Party decks
- The digital version of the most backed game in Kickstarter history
Created by Elan Lee (Xbox, ARGs), Matthew Inman (The Oatmeal), and Shane Small (Xbox, Marvel).

There is also an option to compete online against strangers and resulting data transfer charges may apply. Player usernames and expressions are their own. bluejetty:00069010:ios.name: Electrical Calculations
bluejetty:00069010:ios.summary: Electrical Calculations is the PROFESSIONAL app for those who work with electrical systems every day: design, size and verify in just seconds, from the job site or the office. Over 200 calculations, diagrams, formulas and tables in a single
bluejetty:00069010:ios.description:
Electrical Calculations is the PROFESSIONAL app for those who work with electrical systems every day: design, size and verify in just seconds, from the job site or the office. Over 200 calculations, diagrams, formulas and tables in a single app, with clear, printable PDF reports to attach to your documents.
Designed for electricians, installers, designers and surveyors, it saves you time and helps you avoid mistakes: from cable sizing to short circuit.
COMPLIANT WITH STANDARDS
Reliable results aligned with the main standards: IEC (International Electrotechnical Commission), CEI (Italian Electrotechnical Committee), NEC (National Electrical Code), CEC (Canadian Electrical Code).
WHY CHOOSE IT
SAVE TIME: the calculations you'd do by hand, instantly available here.
AVOID ERRORS: verified formulas and up-to-date regulatory parameters.
PROFESSIONAL REPORTS: PDF reports ready for printing and archiving.
ALWAYS WITH YOU: over 200 tools including calculations, converters, tables and pinouts.
THE MOST USED CALCULATIONS
Cable sizing and coordination with the protective device, voltage drop, operating current, current intensity, voltage and power (active, reactive, apparent). Power factor and power factor correction. Current capacity of conductors and busbars, sizing of conduits and trunking, maximum cable length.
SHORT CIRCUIT AND PROTECTION
Short-circuit current at a point on the line, earthing system and coordination with the residual current device, cable protection against short circuit (K²S²), power loss, cable temperature, neutral current.
ELECTRIC MOTOR
Motor current, power, voltage, efficiency and power factor, slip, speed, maximum torque and full-load current. Three-phase motor connection diagrams, terminal markings. Three-phase to single-phase.
ELECTRONICS
Color and alphanumeric codes for resistors, capacitors and inductors, SMD code, LED resistor, voltage and current divider, Zener diode, battery life, resonant frequency, fuses and transformers.
CONVERSIONS
Delta-star, AWG, SWG, cross-section, length, energy, temperature, pressure, Ah/kWh, var/µF, Gauss/Tesla, RPM and many more.
RESOURCES AND TABLES
Tripping curves, cable reactance and resistivity, cable dimensions and weight, distribution systems (TT, TN, IT), IP/IK/NEMA protection ratings, ATEX marking, insulation classes, electrical symbols, ANSI device codes, plugs and sockets, IEC 60309, NEMA and EV charging connectors, SI prefixes and units of measurement, thermistors and thermocouples.
PINOUTS
Ethernet RJ-45, Ethernet with PoE, USB, HDMI, VGA, DVI, RS-232, FireWire, SATA, DisplayPort, Apple Lightning, Raspberry Pi, OBD II, XLR audio/DMX, MIDI, Jack, RCA, Thunderbolt, SD Card, SIM Card and LED.
Stop searching everywhere for formulas and tables: PUT YOUR ENTIRE ELECTRICAL LAB IN YOUR SMARTPHONE. Download Electrical Calculations and work faster, with standards-compliant results.
Terms of service (EULA): https://www.egalnetsoftwares.com/terms_of_service_app/

bluejetty:00136207:ios.description:
Ever wanted to keep track of your friends and family who fly Alaska Airlines? Curious about the destinations, aircraft models or speed at which Alaska Airlines planes traverse the skies? Well, your wish just came true! Introducing the Alaska Airlines Flight Radar application - your gateway to the wonders of aviation.
With this application, you can immerse yourself in the world of aviation and even experience what it's like to be a Alaska Airlines pilot, all from the comfort of your smartphone. Think of your device as a handheld radar and each Alaska Airlines flight as an adventure waiting to be explored.
Let's explore some of the incredible features the Alaska Airlines Flight Radar application has to offer:
Global flight tracking: Gain access to a bird's eye view of Alaska Airlines flights worldwide. Whether it's soaring over the Arctic or descending over the Amazon, you can track them all.
Aircraft Insights: Dive deep into the details of Alaska Airlines aircraft. You can discover details such as aircraft model, flight path, current speed, cruising altitude, and origin and destination airports. It's like having an aviation encyclopedia in your pocket.
Real-time flight details: Stay up-to-date with estimated departure and arrival times for all Alaska Airlines flights. Curious about airport weather? You'll find all the information you need right in the app. No need to rush to the airport, it's all at your fingertips.
Tailored information: We know every traveler has a favorite Alaska Airlines aircraft. That's why we've made it easy for you to perform detailed searches. In real time, you can access and monitor the details of the Alaska Airlines aircraft that captures your imagination.
Doesn't it all sound intriguing? Download the Alaska Airlines Flight Radar application and embark on a journey through the skies, getting a glimpse into the world of aviation like you've never seen before.
Prepare to be mesmerized by the sheer scale of Alaska Airlines' global operations. As you watch planes crisscross the globe, you'll be amazed at the information you can access about each flight. It's not just an app, it's your passport to the world of aviation.
Join the thousands of aviation enthusiasts who've already embarked on this exciting journey. Whether you're a frequent flyer, an aviation buff, or just curious about Alaska Airlines, this app is your gateway to the wonders of aviation.
What are you waiting for? Download Alaska Airlines Flight Radar now and begin your aviation adventure. Your next travel experience will never be the same.

A START
The history of the restaurant dates back to September 16, 2016. The establishment was opened by businessman Yuri Levitas together with Timati, Pavel Kuryanov and Walter. The partners visited thousands of burger shops around the world, tried to take into account the mistakes and learn from the positive experience of each of them, and to translate all the accumulated experience into a restaurant, which resulted in a new wave of the burger revolution called Black Star Burger.
ABOUT BURGERS
The burger revolution in Russia took place a long time ago. It would seem that one would think that the train had left, but Black Star Burger managed to jump into the last car of the departing train, change its direction and become a locomotive. We cook burgers because, contrary to popular belief, burgers are not junk food, they are a complex sandwich that can be usefully satiated with fewer calories than, for example, a set meal.
