bluejetty:00075691:ios.summary: Looking for a brand new way to play jigsaw puzzles? Meet Block Puzzle Games, it’s a brand new way to play jigsaw puzzles by putting together blocks. It’s a fun hexa block game with a burst of color that’s both difficult and relaxing. The pe
bluejetty:00075691:ios.description:
Looking for a brand new way to play jigsaw puzzles? Meet Block Puzzle Games, it’s a brand new way to play jigsaw puzzles by putting together blocks. It’s a fun hexa block game with a burst of color that’s both difficult and relaxing. The perfect fun way to challenge your brain, and best of all, it’s free! 
Explore the new and addicting block puzzle experience that’s perfect for casual jigsaw puzzle players. The main goal is simple: drag and drop colorful hexagon blocks onto the geometric shaped board same as traditional jigsaw puzzle games. You cannot rotate these colorful blocks, only place them with very careful movements. Once you think it’s in the right spot, place it, take the next colored jigsaw piece, and keep solving all puzzles!
Block Puzzle Games is all about puzzle solving and spatial awareness, and filled with endless hours of fun. Use your jigsaw puzzle skills to solve the hexa levels one hexa block at a time, always using simple drag and drop motions. The perfect brain game to relax your mind, challenge your senses, and see how good you are at fitting block jigsaw puzzles!
Fun game modes:
• Arcade – Complete the level by arranging jigsaw pieces and get rewards
• Master – A more difficult challenge for experienced jigsaw puzzle solvers
• Multiplayer – Show off your puzzle skills by competing with online players 
If you're looking for a good challenge, want to relax your brain, or just need a fun hexa block game to sit down with, this game has you covered! 
Fun Game Features:
- Hexa puzzles to train your brain
- Bright & colorful hexa block pieces
- Multiple visual themes to choose from
- Online multiplayer with real-time puzzle solving
- 600 levels, with more on the way!
Don’t let boredom ruin your day. Get this fun and unique color-based hexa game today. Play it for free – you don’t even need an internet connection to enjoy it, you can play it offline. You’re just one tap away from a brand new jigsaw puzzle game experience! Download it today!

1、HD Real-Time Monitoring: Access high-definition real-time video streams whenever network conditions allow, giving you an easy way to keep an eye on your home.
2、Network Detection and Diagnosis: Built-in network detection tools help assess your home network environment, identify potential issues, and enhance camera connectivity and network performance.

6、WIFI Connection Log: Maintain a detailed log of WIFI connections, aiding in network troubleshooting and optimization.
7、Data Encryption and Privacy Protection: Ensure all video and data transmissions are encrypted, safeguarding your privacy and information security.

CRYPTO INVESTING MADE SIMPLE

PAY USING YOUR CRYPTO

• Zero fees for all payments, worldwide
• 300+ different currencies (government and crypto)
• Claim your unique @kraktag
SUBSCRIBE TO MORE TRADES, LESS FEES

• Kraken+ gives you zero trading fees, up to $10k/month
• Earn boosted, up to 4%+ APR on USDG
INTRODUCING STOCKS ON KRAKEN
• Buy, sell & trade 11,000+ US stocks & ETFs commission-free* directly in the app.
• Invest beyond just big-name US stocks and ETFs across NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX, and more, all with zero commissions*.
• Execute trades & reinvest seamlessly
*Other fees may apply
OVER 300 CRYPTOCURRENCIES AVAILABLE
We have one of the largest selections of assets to buy and sell, including:
Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Dogecoin (DOGE), Litecoin (LTC), Ripple (XRP), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Monero (XMR), EOS, Cardano (ADA), TRON (TRX), and more.

bluejetty:00091632:ios.summary:
PARKUPFRONT is The Social Network For The Car Community.
Network and connect with local like-minded car enthusiast on the fastest growing social network for the car community. Post automotive related videos/pictures, clubs, event, meets a
bluejetty:00091632:ios.description:
PARKUPFRONT is The Social Network For The Car Community.
Network and connect with local like-minded car enthusiast on the fastest growing social network for the car community. Post automotive related videos/pictures, clubs, event, meets and rallies without all of the outside clutter.
CREATE YOUR GARAGE
To get started, fill out your MY BIO section. Own multiple vehicles? No problem. Add them all to your garage. Show off your garage to your friends and other car enthusiasts by adding vehicle details to each ride!
BUILD YOUR NETWORK
The CRUISEFEED is like a big message board to allow users to connect and network with other automotive enthusiasts by posting videos, pictures, car clubs and events with their followers.This is also a great way to discover new friends to follow that have similar interests.
FIND LOCAL EVENTS AND CAR CLUBS
Register or purchase tickets for local car events and rallies and find car clubs to join. Search the thousands of enthusiasts clubs and events in our community to find the ones that interest you.
Want to grow your car club and events? Market your own car club or automotive events by creating your Club Page for free, and post all of your events on the app. Our fully customization event creation allows you to run payments directly through the app or direct attendees to a third party site.
PARKUPFRONT CLASSES
Each car in your garage is associated with a PARKUPFRONT Class based on the year, make and model of your car. Find events and groups that share the same interests and cater to your class.
LAST BUT NOT LEAST, HAVE FUN!
PARKUPFRONT was built by car enthusiasts for car enthusiasts just like you. We are a community driven by YOU! Let's tear down the walls, bridge the divide, and unite together under one common denominator: Our love for cars.
Happy Driving!
Team PUF

bluejetty:00186070:ios.description:
The best and simplest way to improve your English, as well as expand your knowledge about the world.
VOA Learning English is a special program of Voice of America to help English learners all over the world to develop their English skills every day. This program includes stories, lessons, together with up-to-date news reports which are written by simple vocabulary and spoken at a quite slow speed to help learners to understand them easily.
This app is designed to bring you the best experience to improve your English. You can read, listen and watch the lessons everywhere with your mobile devices. Even if you are already good at English, you can also learn more about American culture, history as well as the latest news in the world.
The contents are updated daily with transcribed audios and videos. The most popular contents include:
* World news
* Education, business, science, technology
* American history, culture, nature, and stories
* Everyday grammar and vocabulary
* And many more...
Top Features:
* Transcript tracking: the audio transcripts are highlighted and auto scrolled to help you focus on listening
* Adjust playing speed and auto repeat options
* Customize the reading experience: background color, text color and text size
* Save and sync favorite stories between different devices
* Search for published content
* Look up new words when reading stories
* Save lessons for offline learning
Download the app and enjoy learning English every day!

bluejetty:00047094:ios.summary: A social app for real people, and real thoughts. Create fun lists, easily share recommendations or manifestations, follow people similar to you and dump every unhinged thought on Ditto. No niches, no curated aesthetics or edits — just a pla
bluejetty:00047094:ios.description:
A social app for real people, and real thoughts. Create fun lists, easily share recommendations or manifestations, follow people similar to you and dump every unhinged thought on Ditto. No niches, no curated aesthetics or edits — just a place to be yourself. 
CREATE & CONNECT
Ditto was born out of a crashout. From red flags in dating, birthday bucket lists, extreme college hacks, and the hottest people on campus, nothing is off limits. All in the form of lists.
Don’t know what lists to make? Our community votes on Hot Topics each week, from Love Island debriefs, to travel diaries or monthly recaps – sometimes it’s just fun to see what others are talking about.
DISCOVER BETTER
Your experience is someone else’s inspiration. Find real people in your city, on campus, or across the country who share your interests and POVs. Planning a trip to Tokyo? Someone's mapped out the perfect ramen tour. Need workout motivation? Save routines from people who've been there. Get genuinely good recs (instead of internet slop).
IT’S NOT THAT DEEP
Unless you want it to be. Every girl knows it’s a jumpscare to scroll through your notes app. What are we going to find? A middle school crash out? Grandma’s recipe? Where the hottest men run in NYC? Things that got you through hard times? We’re here for it all.
YOU’RE ALREADY DOING IT
Your notes app shouldn’t know you better than your best friend or your boyfriend. Share publicly, follow friends, find people you relate to, and connect your online and offline worlds. Like instead of raging in your notes app about what you wish your man did for you, you can post it publicly for him to see or someone to send him. If not that, at least you could help another couple out. 
–
Join a social network of 50,000+ ex-notes app lovers now (over)sharing on Ditto.

YOU’RE ALREADY DOING IT
Your notes app shouldn’t know you better than your best friend or your boyfriend. Share publicly, follow friends, find people you relate to, and connect your online and offline worlds. bluejetty:00174919:ios.description:
Do you snore?
Do you talk in your sleep?
Do other sounds disturb your sleep?
SnoreClock records sleep sounds during user-initiated sleep sessions and detects snoring events. Because SnoreClock can record throughout the night, you can review snoring and other sleep sounds in context and better understand what happens while you sleep.
Check if you snore, if your partner snores, if you talk in your sleep, or if something disturbs your sleep.
Tip: Pinch to zoom and drag to move in the chart.
Features:
 • Records and analyzes sleep sounds during a user-started sleep session
 • Reliable snore detection
 • Highlights likely snoring events
 • Marks other sounds such as talking, whispering, or coughing
 • Compare recordings to observe changes in snoring over time
 • Displays volume levels across the entire recording
 • Recording time up to 11 hours
 • Automatically stops recording on low battery
 • Gesture-based zooming and scrolling in the graph
Privacy:
 • No registration required
 • No tracking
 • No advertising or data monetization
 • No cloud storage
 • All recordings are processed and stored locally on your device
How to use SnoreClock:
 1. Place the smartphone near the bed
 2. Plug in the phone if you need sufficient battery in the morning
 3. Press the red button to start recording
 4. Press the red button again in the morning to stop recording
 5. Tap anywhere in the chart to listen. Pinch to zoom and drag to move
If you need help, tap the help icon in SnoreClock to access documentation or contact support.
SnoreClock is not a medical device. This app is intended for informational purposes only and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. If you have concerns about snoring or possible sleep disorders, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.

bluejetty:00129143:ios.description:
Turn a photo into drawing practice, or start with a blank canvas. Sketch, doodle and trace on your iPhone or iPad, then save or share what you create.

bluejetty:00032383:ios.name: Rome News-Tribune
bluejetty:00032383:ios.summary: Stay connected to the heart of Rome and Floyd County with the official Rome News-Tribune app! As your most trusted and comprehensive local news source since 1843, we deliver the latest updates, award-winning in-depth reporting, and vital co
bluejetty:00032383:ios.description:
Stay connected to the heart of Rome and Floyd County with the official Rome News-Tribune app! As your most trusted and comprehensive local news source since 1843, we deliver the latest updates, award-winning in-depth reporting, and vital community information directly to your device, keeping you informed, engaged, and empowered.
What You'll Get:
• Unparalleled Local News Coverage: Receive real-time access to breaking news from Rome, Cave Spring, and every corner of Floyd County. Our dedicated team of experienced journalists provides thorough coverage of local government decisions (Rome City Commission, Floyd County Commission), education advancements (Rome City Schools, Floyd County Schools, Berry College, Shorter University, Georgia Northwestern Technical College), business developments, public safety alerts, healthcare news from institutions like Atrium Health Floyd, transportation updates, and the impactful human-interest stories that define our community in Northwest Georgia.
• Instant Breaking News Alerts: Be the first to know with customizable push notifications. Get alerted to major developing stories, urgent updates, and important local events as they happen. You control the types of alerts you receive, ensuring you get the news that matters most to you.
• Complete Sports Reporting: Your ultimate source for local sports! Follow your favorite Floyd County high school teams with extensive game coverage, up-to-the-minute scores, detailed stats, and exciting highlights. We also keep you updated on Berry College Vikings, Shorter University Hawks athletics, and other regional sports relevant to our community.
• Vibrant Community Connection: Discover what’s happening with our comprehensive local events calendar, explore arts and entertainment news, and read features on the people and organizations making a difference in Rome. Engage with insightful opinion pieces, thought-provoking editorials, and letters to the editor that foster vibrant community discussion. Access daily obituaries to honor and remember the lives of those in our community.
• Rich Multimedia Experience: Go beyond the headlines. Immerse yourself in local stories with our stunning photo galleries and compelling video reports, bringing the news and events of Rome and Floyd County to life.
• Optimized User Experience:
o Intuitive Navigation: Enjoy a clean, user-friendly interface designed for an effortless mobile reading experience. Easily browse sections, search for specific articles, and find what you need quickly.
o Customizable Reading: Adjust font sizes for maximum comfort.
o Offline Access: Save articles to read later, even when you're offline or have a poor internet connection. Perfect for your commute or when you're on the go.
o Seamless Sharing: Share important articles, captivating photos, and informative videos with friends, family, and colleagues via email, text message, or your favorite social media platforms with just a tap.
• E-Edition Access: Subscribers can enjoy the Rome News-Tribune e-edition – a digital replica of the printed newspaper – right within the app. Flip through the pages, read familiar layouts, and access archived editions. (A Rome News-Tribune subscription may be required for premium content and full e-edition access).
https://www.northwestgeorgianews.com/site/terms.html

Find rare artifacts, gold, and stat gems, and traverse the skill tree to become your choice of a mage, warrior, alchemist, or a mix of skills. Craft potions, enchant your equipment, and discover secret areas! But be careful because the cave has become quite dangerous lately with more explorers going missing every day…

---Gameplay---
The Enchanted Cave 2 is an RPG/roguelike with a heavy focus on risk vs reward. Strategically choosing your battles, building your character, enchanting your equipment and knowing when to escape the cave are crucial to succeed.

---Key Features---
- 9 playable characters 
- 100 randomly-generated floors of loot, monsters, and minibosses 
- Secret areas hidden in the walls 
- A thriving town of tourists and eager explorers to talk and trade their equipment 
- Over 300 items, equipment, spells, and crafting ingredients 
- Mid-cave shops to buy, sell, and enchant equipment 
- Sprawling skill tree featuring 3 unique play-styles, or any combination! 
- A beautiful soundtrack by Grant Kirkhope 
- Museum for the hardcore collectors 
- New Game+ mode to infinity

bluejetty:00143858:android.description:
Welcome to the official Flamengo app!
The Fla-APP brings together everything you need to know about Mengão in one place!
Here, the Flamengo team will have access to club news, information and the calendar of professional, under-20 and women's football teams, in addition to FlaBasquete and volleyball, Sesc RJ Flamengo.
For those who are fan members, the Fla-APP is yet another relationship channel with Programa Nação. Now, access to the supporter's portal can be done on the application's home screen. To access, just use the same login and password you registered on the Nação website!
Check below everything that the Flamengo fan can find on the Fla-APP:
• News: have all the first-hand information on your cell phone and stay on top of all the news from Mengão.
• Help center: a chat aimed at assisting Flamengo fans when it comes to Programa Nação, tickets, FlaTV+ and other Flamengo products and services.
• Statistics: stay on top of all the numbers of Flamengo's professional football matches and the details of our star players' profiles, such as number of games, wins, goals, assists, debut date for Mengão, titles, among others.
• Match schedule: in the club's official app, you can find out about the schedule of professional, under-20 and women's soccer teams, in addition to FlaBasquete and volleyball, Sesc RJ Flamengo.
• Challenges and rescues: participate in quizzes, vote for the game's star player and give your guesses in Mengão matches. Thus, you accumulate coins and, later, you can exchange them for assets and digital experiences that will be available in the app store.
• Official club store: guarantee your Manto and other licensed Mengão pieces and products.
🇧🇷
 If you are a Flamengo fan, this is the place for you!
 Download the application now and enjoy the Mais Querido in the palm of your hand.
Red-black greetings!

bluejetty:00130938:ios.description:
If you're a reseller you need to know two things about any item you find:
Its value and how fast it sells.
ThriftMagic will tell you both of these things instantly. By scanning millions of resale marketplace listings we give you the most accurate estimate of what your item is worth and all the relevant statistics on its daily, weekly, and 90-day sales volume. 
ThriftMagic makes it easy to find winning items from thrift stores, flea markets, garage sales, and anywhere else you find used goods. We even calculate eBay fees so you can instantly see what your profit will be after you sell your item.
BOOKSHELF SCANNER:
With just one photo, our bookshelf scanner can find the instant resale values of every book on a shelf, and we partner with book buyback companies so you can sell your books for cash instantly in one click.
We support many different markets including the UK and Germany!
The built-in barcode scanner gets you instant values of anything with a barcode: Books, Movies, CDs, etc!
Start treasure hunting today!
Who Is this app for?
For eBay sellers - Our app is perfect if you are an eBay seller who is looking to increase your eBay sales and quickly find out what items are worth. Compared to competing apps such as What's it worth on eBay, our app works faster, is more accurate, and provides you with sales volume stats you can't find anywhere else. If you have used What's it worth on eBay in the past and been disappointed with the results, you will find tremendous value in this app.
For students using Bookscouter - This app was inspired by our use of Bookscouter and seeing how easy it was to flip used textbooks for money. There is one problem with bookscouter though, It's only for books! Our app is highly useful for those who have used bookscouter in the past to find textbooks to sell. Unlike bookscouter our app can fetch the price of any item (but also books) so if you like money-making opportunities like selling thrifted books on bookscouter you will love this app.
For Terapeak Users - Since Terapeak insights are not available in App form, we also hope to provide a Terapeak-like experience for mobile with even more mobile-only integrated tools, (such as barcode scanners), to help you find winning eBay seller's products while you are out and about.
Anyone looking for a side hustle - If you want a fun and easy-to-start side hustle our app is for you, quickly find out what items are worth and become an eBay seller today!

Privacy policy: https://www.freeprivacypolicy.com/live/4f1c6c7f-94d9-45a9-a770-c519dee15868

bluejetty:00044618:ios.description:
What’s living on purpose? 
If you knew a kid down the street had holes in his shoes or a neighbor’s home burned down, chances are you’d help, right? But, it’s hard to know the needs of real people in your community. Until now. 
Reimagine doing good from the ground up. It should be fun, fast, easy, transparent, local and inspiring - all rolled into one. It should become a lifestyle. Purposity makes it simple. 
Here’s how it works. 
- Receive one weekly notification linking you to a local need from a verified school or nonprofit. 
- Be inspired by hand-crafted stories from someone working directly with the individual in need.
- Meet a local need in less than a minute.
- Get a thank you message directly from those you’ve impacted. 
- Know your impact since 100% of your donation goes to meeting the need. 
- Visit the stories tab for inspirational content and updates.
- Relive the stories of those you’ve helped. They live on your wall. 
- Choose where to help, whether it’s next door or across the country!
Grow yourself towards living on purpose. That’s Purposity. 
As seen in Forbes!

bluejetty:00035420:ios.description:
Bella Wants Blood is an offline strategy game fusing roguelike and tower defense elements and featuring a scary yet charming villain:
BELLA WANTS YOU TO PLAY! YOU PLAY WITH BELLA!
Trapping you in their world, the god-like Bella demands you play their game to feed them blood. Lay down gutters and destructive terrors to obliterate Bella’s friends and their grotesque minions. Just don’t let them reach the end of your maze or Bella will get upset. And if Bella gets upset, Bella might just keep you there forever.

DELICIOUS CHOICES
Monstrosities spawn that end of the line of gutters you lay down. Do you want to build a winding length of gutters with carefully placed terrors, or a short terror barrage gauntlet?
YUMMY TREATS!
Unlock powerful new monstrosities, terrors, and mementos as you defeat Bella’s monstrous friends.
Make the most of what you get to survive Bella’s game and maybe they’ll let you go. Maybe.

bluejetty:00123659:ios.name: iHorse™ Racing 2：Horse manager
bluejetty:00123659:ios.summary: Become the top horse racing stable manager and the best horse trainer in the world! Play the role of a thoroughbred horse owner, stable manager and horse trainer in iHorse™ Racing 2：Horse manager. Find your horses' best potentials, and stra
bluejetty:00123659:ios.description:
Become the top horse racing stable manager and the best horse trainer in the world! Play the role of a thoroughbred horse owner, stable manager and horse trainer in iHorse™ Racing 2：Horse manager. Find your horses' best potentials, and strategically enrol horses in the seasonal horse races and lead your stable to derby trophies and championship wins! iHorse™ Racing 2：Horse manager is the most realistic horse racing simulator game on the market! 
Updated regularly, you can recruit current and past thoroughbred champion horses from all over the world! You can also simulate from horse racing replays to form racing strategies against friends and rivals' races. Players can also bet on horse races that are running during the season. This star horse stable management and strategy game is definitely the most realistic horse racing simulator out there!
iHorse™ Racing 2：Horse manager is free to download and play. This game is intended for use by those 21 or older for amusement purposes only. Practice or success in this game does not imply future success at real money gambling. iHorse™ Racing 2：Horse manager does not manipulate or otherwise interfere with tournament outcomes in any way. Results are based entirely on luck and the choices made by players in the tournaments.
This game requires a network connection.
========== FEATURES==========
▶ Featuring over 1,200 horses and jockeys
Recruit legendary thoroughbred horses and hire star jockeys from Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, USA, UK, France, UAE and more.
▶ PvP Multiplayer Championships
Compete with friends and rivals alike for top titles in various horse racing competitions: Live seasonal fixtures and series, G1 Championships, a season’s Best Horse Trainers and Best Horses, and more.
▶ Bet big and win big
Wager on the big derby with multiple types of betting choices available: win, place/show, quinella/exacta, quinella place/swinger/duet, and trio/trifecta box.
▶ Single Player World Tour mode
Enrol to race your horses and raise their ratings in World Tour mode, and win great prizes and famed horses.
▶ Lead your race club to victory
Join or create a racing club with friends and players around the world, and compete for the Best Horse Racing Club title and Horse Racing Club Championships.
▶ Breed your own thoroughbred horses
Lineage and pedigree matters! Recruit breeding stallions and mares including Frankel, Black Caviar, Northern Dancer, Beholder; and simulate combinations and create the ultimate derby thoroughbred horse!
▶ Trade horses
Trade horses with friends and players globally to help you obtain your favorite horses, and allow for horse breeding and enhancing your stable.
Find us on Facebook at iHorse Racing ENG (@ihorseracingENG) for the latest news! http://www.facebook.com/iHorseRacingENG
Join our Official Group to meet new friends, and exchange tips and tricks!
http://www.facebook.com/groups/804060139708100/
Email: mkt@gamemiracle.com
Watch our tutorials and races on YouTube:
http://www.youtube.com/user/GamemiracleHK/videos

bluejetty:00000620:android.name: Medanta eCLINIC - Patient App
bluejetty:00000620:android.summary: Medanta eCLINIC app allows you to virtually consult a Medanta doctor (through video conference, phone call or by posting a query on the app), book a hospital appointment and access all your medical records. You can search for Medanta doctor
bluejetty:00000620:android.description:
Medanta eCLINIC app allows you to virtually consult a Medanta doctor (through video conference, phone call or by posting a query on the app), book a hospital appointment and access all your medical records. You can search for Medanta doctors by specialty, treatment or disease, or let the app recommend a relevant doctor to you based on your requirement.
The comprehensive app also allows you to view your previous health records – reports, prescriptions and discharge notes, and track your current lab and radiology reports. This also allows you to link your family members with your own account so that you can book an appointment for them or even access their health records.
If you are consulting a Medanta doctor for the first time, the app registers you and creates your Unique Hospital Identification Digit (UHID). This allows you to skip the registration queue when you visit the hospital for a consultation.

bluejetty:00070174:ios.summary:
A moving story about the diversity and prejudice, about the values of friendship and respect.
In simple language it describes the respect for diversity and the value of friendship, a unique tale written for children and their parents by Da
bluejetty:00070174:ios.description:
A moving story about the diversity and prejudice, about the values of friendship and respect.
In simple language it describes the respect for diversity and the value of friendship, a unique tale written for children and their parents by Danilo Giovanelli and translated into eleven languages.
A unique fairy tale, combining the voice of a narrator with an animated, interactive book.
Now you have to help the main characters find their lost objects. Help using your torch to look even in the darkest corners. Then you can join the party in the wood, creating a real music band, getting all the characters in the story to play, sing and dance together.
And when evening comes, you can put all the animals to bed, but take care to find the right den so that they will fall asleep! 
A host of activities, all waiting to be discovered.
A fussy goose that acts like a diva, a sailor duckling and an elegant fawn with an earring ... these are just a few of the wonderful characters who will accompany your journey through the story.
Let your children take the platypus on a walk through the woods and discover all of the animations in the amazing scenes!
 • An original, all-new story for kids
 • Scenery and characters filled with delightful detail
 • Find the objects in the wood with the help of your torch
 • Put the animals to bed and help them fall asleep
 • Create a music band, and get everyone to sing, play and dance
 • Animated story mode
 • Filled with fun animations and entertaining sounds
 • Designed for kids
 • Narration and text in eleven languages
 • Compatible with iPhone, iPad, iPod and Apple TV
 • Color in all the animals
 • Lots of tools for drawing
 • Use the “Magic Border” to make sure your edges are perfect
Like all of the MagisterApp apps, constantly updated and improved, including in response to your suggestions. Visit us at www.magisterapp.com !

bluejetty:00127636:ios.description:
EON-XR is an Augmented and Virtual Reality app packed with features for conducting remote learning and training in a hands-on, immersive environment.
Lessons and training sessions can be completed in AR or VR modes either independently or within groups, providing countless possibilities for students, educators, employers and employees. 
Through EON-XR, users can quickly create compelling content on their phones, tablets, computers and headsets using EON Reality’s expansive library of more than 1 million digital assets as well as importing or purchasing assets from other sources.
Key Features
- Create, publish, demonstrate, record and assess lessons and content all from a smartphone or tablet
- Gather students, employees or trainees to interact virtually with the lesson and the instructor in a safe virtual space
- Intuitive and code-free platform designed to encourage both students and instructors to create content for deeper learning and engagement
- Embed asynchronous videos alongside the 3D models and 360° environments to allow self-paced learning at any time
- Evaluate user performance through assessment and quizzes to effectively track progress

bluejetty:00175535:ios.description:
The ultimate side hustle: get paid to share your perspective
Enjoy making money online in your free time! Best-in-class companies rely on UserTesting to gain valuable insights into their products from people like you! New test opportunities are posted every day from companies around the world.
Apply 
Submit your email and take a quick practice test to join our global network of trusted contributors. As long as you’re at least 18 years old, you don’t need any special experience to get paid to test. UserTesting customers want to gather your unique perspective, so all you need to do is share your thoughts out loud using your mobile or desktop device, no prior experience required!
Browse
Answer screening questions to match with test opportunities. New tests are released all the time! To earn money online as a website tester (and apps and in-person experiences, too) you need a device with a microphone and an active PayPal account.
Test
Share your perspectives via tests you match with, and help best-in-class brands improve their products and services. UserTesting is one of the best ways to earn money online fast. On average, most contributors take one or two tests per week. You can receive a test at any time, on any day of the week. However, the number of opportunities is dependent on the needs of UserTesting customers, including your demographic profile and background. Keep in mind, the more complete your profile is, the more tests you’ll qualify for to make money online.
Make money online
Get rewarded for different types of tests! Your test feed will show you the amount you'll get paid for each test. All contributors receive payments in USD through PayPal (you can then convert to your local currency via PayPal if desired). You must have a confirmed PayPal account that’s in good standing to receive payments. We recommend using a verified personal PayPal account.

bluejetty:00026430:ios.description:
Introducing "My First Kiss" an engaging Otome BL (boys love) game that combines the excitement of yaoi and yuri in a dramatic visual novel format. Immerse yourself in a thrilling interactive story where your choices shape Akihiko's fate and personality, ultimately determining the outcome of his passionate and romantic journey.
In this episode-based game, experience Akihiko's first BL love after waking up to a stunning man who turns into a cat! Unravel the mystery, explore your feelings, and discover your true self. Dive into a world filled with unique characters like a hot and caring guy in a collar, a temperamental heterochromia guy, or a seductive tattooed professor.
Key Features:
- Multiple endings based on your choices
- Character customization with different outfits and hairstyles
- Inclusive love stories and characters
- Love triangle and polyamorous love options
- Special dreams section with lustful, slightly scary, and psychedelic dreams
This game is perfect for those who:
- Enjoy Otome, yaoi, and yuri games
- Love interactive stories with romance choices
- Appreciate visual novels with passion and drama
- Desire spicy episodes and intense love feelings
Supported languages: English, German, Japanese, Spanish, Ukrainian. More languages coming soon!

bluejetty:00073766:ios.description:
HotStock is the only app that tracks the stock and price of hard-to-get products in real-time!
Trying to get hold of must-have products? Be notified when they're back in stock. Products range from the new Pokemon, Playstation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X console bundles, Meta Quest, NVIDIA Geforce RTX 4080 / 4090 graphics cards, Ninja air fryer, LEGO, Magic Mixies, Gabby's Dollhouse, Barbie dolls, CoCoMelon through to other hard-to-get tech and toys. 
Just find the product you're interested in, then click the ALERT ME button and we'll instantly send you a notification when it's back in stock and available to buy. 
We track them so you don't have to. There's no need for you to keep checking when they're back in-stock, or stay logged in to every retailer's website. 
You'll never have to miss out on that must-have product again! When you get our notification, compare prices and quickly buy before it goes out of stock again.
SELLING OUT TOO FAST?
Enable AutoBuy for fast, automated purchasing within seconds. Unattended checkout while you sleep/work/play. AutoBuy puts the fans back in the game in the fight against bots!
ADD PRODUCTS - MAKE YOUR VERY OWN WATCH LIST
Looking for something that’s not on our Featured list? Just use the Search bar to add your own custom products to your list!
Please note: this app is totally free to use. You also have the option to unlock HotStock Premium/AutoBuy to get all the benefits of the Premium/AutoBuy tiers. These tiers allow you to add more of your own custom products, puts you first to receive alerts about new stock compared to free users, and the AutoBuy provides you with fast, unattended checkout.
The cost of these tier subscriptions will be displayed in the app, prior to your agreement. If you choose to upgrade your payment will be taken immediately and processed by Apple.
Premium/AutoBuy tier subscriptions automatically renew monthly unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and will identify the cost of the renewal. You may manage and turn off auto-renewal after purchase by going to your Apple Account Settings.
Terms of use
The HotStock app is copyright HotStock.io 2023. All rights reserved. Terms of use and privacy policy apply when using and accessing content in the HotStock app.
• Privacy policy: https://www.hotstock.io/privacy-policy
• Terms and conditions: https://www.hotstock.io/terms

bluejetty:00026837:ios.description:
Camp & RV is your gateway to adventure. It's time you enjoy the journey with the most popular camping app for RVers, adventurers, campers, hikers and more on phone and web!
We help you find and filter places and services with or without internet connection. Tents, RV resorts, parking lots, fuel, rest areas, repairs, tunnels, and even inclines. Get extensive filters and thousands of unique points you’ll only find on Camp & RV. 
Camp & RV has been featured on the App Stores’ Featured Picks for “Travel, “Summer”, “Sun Road Trip” & “Great Outdoors”, Starbucks’ “Featured App”, and rated Excellent by Wired Mag. Our data was also featured in Harvard Business Review. 
Your next outdoor adventure awaits you. Find campgrounds not available anywhere else & plan your next getaway right with Camp & RV. 
CAMP, RVs & BEYOND
• Discover 43,000 campgrounds around the US & Canada with popular, hike-in, boat-in & off road spots.
• Over 1500,000 total map pins across North America!
• Outdoor Guide: Find camping spots with showers, and get detailed information about amenities.
• Campgrounds: Find campgrounds in military famcamps, national parks, public or private land & more.
• Extras: Navigate grocery store locations, casinos, stores, rest areas, RV rentals, services & more.
FIND CAMPGROUNDS & OUTDOOR ADVENTURES
• Start out for free and view all camping icons, basic campground information, campgrounds around you
SUBSCRIBE FOR
• One touch to check availability & book at over 5,000 public campgrounds
• Add and view campground reviews
• See right on the map if a place takes RVs or tents, is hike-in or dispersed
• Filter the map by type and by over 30 amenities. Find hundreds of possibilities.
•Get offline maps and discover thousands more places than other sources.
NAVIGATION & FILTER TOOLS FOR YOUR PERFECT GETAWAY
• Filter the map by type and over 30 amenities – discover hundreds of options.
• Want to see only campgrounds or tenting and no extras? One touch does it.
• Find places with overnight parking, restaurants, truck stops, showers, & more. 
• Lookup data by type, state & city without service.
• Map adds points on the fly as you scroll.
INTUITIVE & HELPFUL APP – EVEN WITHOUT SERVICE
• Get Camp & RV for iPhone/iPad.
• No service? No problem, Camp & RV has the information you need, when you need it.
• Check NOAA Weather by GPS right from our app to get the latest forecasts.
• Photo and review searches that use the power of the entire web, not just one source. Add your reviews.
• Find useful extras like truck and rest stops, dump stations, supplies, RV service, bridges & road grades.
• Quick resources for road conditions, emergencies and various state laws.
SEE WHAT OTHERS HAVE SAID ABOUT CAMP & RV:
"Packed with comprehensive information. For those with more discerning tastes in campsites & RV spots”
– NY Times
"Whether you're looking for RV grounds with full amenities or far-flung campsites for a rough getaway, Camp & RV has you covered."
– MacNewsWorld
"The essential camping app - This is a must have app." 
 – appadvice.com
"Camp & RV app is a must."
 – Womans Day
"Best iPhone App for a Road Trip"
 – Techlicious
"By far the best of the camping apps"
 – Motorhome Forums
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Payment will be charged to your Apple account. Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. Automatic renewals will cost the same price you were originally charged for the subscription. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.

bluejetty:00120058:ios.description:
Driver Theory Test (DTT) Questions and Answers for Irish Driver Theory Tests categories B (Car) and A (Motorcycle). Driver Theory Test Ireland offers the most advanced App to your iPhone, iPod Touch or iPad offering practice +900 up to-date DTT questions.
With Driver Theory Test you will make progress more quickly than with any other traditional method, as you can take the tests wherever and whenever you want, without the need to be connected: at the bus stop, in a bar, in the classroom, at work or at the dentist’s waiting room…!
*** APPLICATION FEATURES ***
- Contains the Driver Theory Test (DTT) service catalogue of Ireland. +900 Questions with explanations.
- Intelligent learning system: The questions are selected using an algorithm taking into account your latest scores and the questions that you need to practice more.
- Modern and easy to use interface with features including:-
~ Test simulator
~ Practice by category
~ Statistics module to track and monitor your progress
The application is divided into the following sections:
* Mock Theory Test: Perform a simulation under the same conditions as the official test. When you finish the test you will see your score and review all the questions. View full explanations after each question to help you remember the correct answer for next time.
* Practice Theory Test: Test your knowledge by practicing by categories. You can select one or more categories to practice. You can also perform rapid tests for 10, 20 or 30 questions. In this section there is no time limit and you can see the official explanation before selecting the correct answer.
* Review All Questions: The entire question bank of questions presented to you by category.
* Progress Monitor: The application saves the result of each question answered and a history of failures and successes to offer the most advanced statistics system.

bluejetty:00166238:ios.description:
Find Your Loved Ones Easily with "Phone Tracker: Share Location"
With Phone Tracker: Share Location, you can quickly and effortlessly locate your loved ones and friends using their phone number. This powerful app provides real-time location tracking, putting an end to the worry of losing track of those who matter most.
Features:
Instant Location Tracking: Simply enter a phone number and instantly see the real-time location.
Safe Family and Friend Tracking: Always know where your loved ones are and ensure their safety.
Group Tracking: Track multiple people simultaneously, making it the perfect solution for family members and friends.
User-Friendly Interface: Offers a simple and effective design that ensures an easy experience for everyone.
Privacy-Focused: Share your location only with the people you choose and keep your data secure.
Create Groups: Create as many groups as you like. Share the group code with anyone you want, so they can follow you, and if they wish, share their location with you too.
Real-Time Information: Monitor your battery status, current activity (in a car, walking, stationary, etc.), and the last time your location was updated, all visible on the map.
Easy Account Management: You can delete your account anytime you wish. The security of you and your family is our top priority.
With all these features and more, Phone Tracker: Share Location ensures your family and friends are always safe. Track locations using GPS data and display them on the map—our app does the job perfectly.
Stay connected and safe with Phone Tracker. Enjoy real-time GPS tracking, location status, and smart geo-fencing notifications for your ultimate peace of mind!
Phone Tracker is a robust and dependable GPS phone tracking app that helps you keep an eye on your loved ones in real-time. bluejetty:00064928:ios.description:
FSB of Blakely is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with FSB of Blakely:
 -Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.

 - Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
 -Transfer money between your accounts

 -Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
 -View and save your monthly statements
 -Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the FSB of Blakely app, you must be enrolled as a First State Bank of Blakely Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00131521:ios.description:
Start growing your own fresh produce at home with GrowIt, your ultimate gardening app designed to simplify the gardening experience! Whether you're planting as beginner, enthusiast or professional, GrowIt offers personalized guidance and expert tips to ensure your success throughout the growing season.
Designed by plant experts and supported by years of in-depth research in cultivation, GrowIt provides all the essential information for growing healthy vegetables, fruits, and herbs, from garden layout, to watering, fertilizing, soil condition, and companion planting. With customized planting calendar based on your location and climate, you'll find it easy to figure out when to start seeds, transplant, harvest and more.
Key Features: 
◆ Discover things to grow: Search for easy-to-grow seasonal plants and get personalized planting schedule tailored to your specific zone.
◆ Plan your garden in minutes: Organize your raised beds or patch with companion and combative plant information. Use square foot gardening layout grid for easy spacing of 80+ plants, and over 1,000 varieties. 
◆ Learn how to grow, step by step: Build your garden with proper soil, fertilizer, and sunlight. Turn yourself into a green thumb with a library of growing information. 
◆ Get seasonal plant care tips: Stay ahead of freezes, heat waves and other extreme weather conditions to protect your garden. 
◆ Stay informed with reminders: Say goodbye to guesswork with auto-calculated sprouting and harvest dates for your specific plant and location. Know exactly when to water and fertilize to maximize your produce.
◆ Identify plant diseases effortlessly: Simply snap a photo, and get plant-specific treatment advice.
◆ Address common gardening issues: Eliminate garden weeds, pests w/o chemicals. Avoid plant diseases with proven planting strategies.
◆ Explore more to get inspired. Unlock secrets to regrowing from scraps, hydroponic growing, indoor gardening, and so much more! Make the most of your harvest with recommended recipes and preservation tips on canning, freezing and drying.
Join GrowIt now and enhance your gardening skills! Learn, plan, organize and care for your vegetable garden. Enjoy a bountiful harvest with your family and friends!

Design beautiful, personalized invitations for any event with Invitation Maker, the easiest and fastest way to create professional-quality eCards, flyers, and digital invites—right from your phone. * Birthday, Wedding & Anniversary

* Greetings, Thank You Cards & More

bluejetty:00070495:ios.description:
Writing is hard. Finishing is harder. Word Keeper helps you do both.
Word Keeper: Writing Tracker helps you build a writing habit, track your progress, and work toward your next deadline. Whether you’re writing a novel, screenplay, blog, or thesis, see how each session brings you closer to your goal.
Track your words, time, and pace. Set a schedule that fits your life. Keep your next writing goal in sight.
Track every writing session
Use the built-in timer or log a session after you finish. Record your words and time, follow your project’s progress, and see your effort add up.
Keep your progress in view with widgets
See today’s writing goals on your Home Screen and check your progress from your Lock Screen. Follow a chosen project with the Project Progress widget, including its word count, deadline, and required writing pace. The wider widget also displays your book cover. Tap a widget to open session logging with your project already selected.
Set goals that fit your schedule
Choose your writing days, set daily word goals, and plan toward a deadline. See how many words you need per writing day to reach your target, so you know what to focus on next.
Build a lasting writing habit
Complete your scheduled goals, grow your streak, and see your consistency over time. Plan rest days into your routine and use reminders to help you return to your writing.
Understand how you write best
Explore detailed insights into your word counts, writing time, session length, speed, and streaks. Discover your most productive hours and locations, follow your writing trends, and find a routine that works for you.
Join writing challenges
Connect with writing challenges through Writer Depot using your Word Keeper account. Link your projects, follow your challenge progress in the app, and work toward a shared goal alongside other writers.
Keep using your favorite writing tools
Write in any word writing tool. Log your sessions in Word Keeper to track your progress wherever you do your writing.
Your projects, your bookshelf
Organize your writing projects and personalize them with a cover from the gallery or your own image. Keep your goals and progress together, from your first session to your finished draft.
Simple pricing. Full access.
Get full access with a subscription or a lifetime purchase. Eligible new subscribers can start with a 7-day free trial.
Your words matter. Let’s make them count.
Website: https://writerdepot.org
Privacy Policy: https://writerdepot.org/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Effortlessly transfer funds across borders. From money transfers to currency exchanges, bulk transfers, and tuition fee payments, Quick Collect stands as the ideal online bank catering to all your requirements.
In contrast to traditional banks, we steer clear of hidden charges, inconvenient operating hours, and inflexible support. Quick Collect online banking offers swift money transfers to both bank accounts and mobile money. Conduct your money transfer activities seamlessly from anywhere around the globe, without restrictions.

4) Streamlined transfers to bank accounts and mobile money
5) Simplified online banking for hassle-free bulk transfers, tuition fee payments, and bill payments

Experience an affordable, rapid, and simple method of sending money internationally. We outshine traditional banks by being up to 10 times faster and more cost-effective.
Unparalleled Security: Your funds are in safe hands with us. Our secure servers and physical security measures ensure your privacy. Our website and app boast 256-bit SSL encryption. Real-time transaction alerts keep you updated on every money transfer in your account. Multifactor authentication thwarts unauthorized access to your Quick Collect online bank account.

Being a young dictator of a fledgling democratic republic is a tough task. Anyone would dream of being in your place as you wield unlimited power.
However, to hold the reins of power you are to make wise and timely decisions, eliminate scheming enemies, deftly plot, expose conspiracies and, of course, diligently look after the welfare of your large and happy family!
Be the most powerful dictator for your country! Only you know how to outwit the insatiable public prosecutors and greedy oligarchs, how to silence the determined opposition, and to keep the military who are eyeing your seat in check. Only you are able to rein in the ignorant masses and prevent revolution because you are the legitimate dictator of your country. 
Dictator allows you to:
– Determine your approach to each of the 6 factions!
– Make 2000+ critical decisions!
– Weave plots and unravel conspiracies!
– Prevent revolution!
Glorify yourself in the history of your country for centuries!
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Subscription options
We offer the following subscription options in our game:
1. Weekly Diamond Membership offers a weekly subscription for $7.99 after a 3-day free trial. It gives you $3,000,000, 100 gems, 3 advice on a daily basis. Moreover, it removes all pop-up and banner ads.
2. Monthly Diamond Membership offers a monthly subscription for $19.99. It gives you $3,000,000, 100 gems, 3 advice on a daily basis. Moreover, it removes all pop-up and banner ads.
3. Yearly Diamond Membership offers a yearly subscription for $99.99. It gives you $3,000,000, 100 gems, 3 advice on a daily basis. Moreover, it removes all pop-up and banner ads.
End of trial and subscription renewal
This price is established for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Canceling trial or subscription

bluejetty:00155109:ios.developer: Democrata Calcados e Artefatos de Couro LTDA
bluejetty:00155109:ios.summary:
"A Democrata é minha filha e eu a amo". Assim, com a emoção nos olhos e um sorriso largo, que o empresário Urias Cintra define uma das maiores marcas de sapatos masculinos em couro do Brasil, da qual é fundador, a Democrata Calçados.
Baixe
bluejetty:00155109:ios.description:
"A Democrata é minha filha e eu a amo". Assim, com a emoção nos olhos e um sorriso largo, que o empresário Urias Cintra define uma das maiores marcas de sapatos masculinos em couro do Brasil, da qual é fundador, a Democrata Calçados.
Baixe o app da Democrata e não perca funcionalidades e ofertas exclusivas. 
Com app de Democrata é possível:
Ter um fluxo de compra mais fluido 
Ter acesso a central de atendimento.
Salvar seus produtos Favoritos. 
Excolher como visualizar a grid de produtos e muito mais. 
O amor pela sapataria surgiu na adolescência com a necessidade de ajudar na renda familiar. Aos 14 anos, Urias, que completou apenas o primário teve seu primeiro registro em carteira já como sapateiro e mal suspeitava que ali seu instinto empreendedor também estava sendo formado.
O início da Democrata foi modesto. A produção começou em 1983, na cidade de Franca, em São Paulo - onde ainda é a sede da empresa - com menos de 10 pares. No entanto o objetivo do empresário, na época com 30 anos, sempre foi alcançar algo maior. Não é a toa que as duas fábricas que mantém no Ceará produzem 12 mil pares por dia, dos quais 30% são para exportação. São 2100 funcionários que o empresário faz questão de manter com um padrão de trabalho cada vez mais qualificado.
Urias viu altos e baixos da economia e enfrentou crises, mas sempre manteve a serenidade nos negócios para uma gestão focada e visionária. A Democrata foi pioneira na produção de sapatos masculinos com solados comfort e desenvolveu a exclusiva tecnologia Air, que traz as famosas bolhas de ar para ajudar a caminhar com menos impacto. Também deu novos ares aos coturnos e botas pesadas, trazendo para o dia-a-dia de homens contemporâneos o conceito da linha Garage, que é sucesso de vendas desde o seu lançamento.
É por isso que os modelos da marca se tornaram referência, e conquistaram além dos brasileiros muitos consumidores pelo mundo. Constantes pesquisas sobre as mais modernas tecnologias e tendências no setor calçadista fazem com que, desde 2006, a Democrata exporte para mais de 60 países, incluindo países da América Latina, Estados Unidos Europa e Oriente Médio.

bluejetty:00075700:ios.name: My Perfect IceCream
bluejetty:00075700:ios.summary: Embark on a mouthwatering journey of entrepreneurial bliss with "My Perfect Ice Cream & Juice Tycoon" – a delectable mobile game that invites you to build, expand, and manage your very own frozen treat empire. Immerse yourself in the world
bluejetty:00075700:ios.description:
Embark on a mouthwatering journey of entrepreneurial bliss with "My Perfect Ice Cream & Juice Tycoon" – a delectable mobile game that invites you to build, expand, and manage your very own frozen treat empire. Immerse yourself in the world of sweet delights as you balance the art of crafting irresistible ice creams and refreshing juices to satisfy the cravings of virtual customers. This captivating game combines the best of two worlds, allowing you to venture into the realms of icy indulgence and fruity freshness. something new
Key Features:
Create Your Sweet Empire:
Start your culinary adventure by establishing a charming ice cream parlor that's set to become the go-to destination for frozen delight enthusiasts. Craft an array of delectable ice cream flavors, each with its own unique twist, and blend refreshing fruit juices to entice a diverse customer base.
Diverse Flavors & Combinations:
Unleash your creativity by experimenting with an extensive range of ice cream flavors and juice combinations. From classic vanilla to exotic fruit blends, the possibilities are endless. Customize your offerings to cater to the varied tastes of your customers, keeping them coming back for more.
Strategic Business Expansion:
As your empire grows, strategically expand your reach by opening new locations in vibrant neighborhoods and exotic locales. Each setting presents unique challenges and opportunities, adding a layer of strategic depth to your business expansion endeavors.
Hire and Manage Your Team:
Build a skilled team of workers to assist in the day-to-day operations of your bustling ice cream and juice empire. Manage their tasks efficiently to ensure a smooth workflow, and unlock new abilities as your team gains experience.
Challenging Objectives & Achievements:
Navigate through a series of challenging objectives and unlock achievements that showcase your prowess as an ice cream and juice tycoon. From perfecting recipes to meeting sales targets, each achievement brings you one step closer to sweet success.
Global Culinary Adventure:
Explore the world as you take your sweet empire to new heights. From busy city streets to tranquil beachside locations, discover diverse settings that add flavor to your entrepreneurial journey. Adapt to local preferences and make your mark on the global culinary stage.
Innovative Marketing Strategies:
Implement creative marketing campaigns to promote your sweet creations. From limited-time offers to themed events, your marketing strategies will play a crucial role in attracting customers and ensuring the success of your business.
 Financial Management:
Balance your books and manage your resources wisely to ensure the financial health of your empire. Make strategic decisions on pricing, investments, and upgrades to keep your business thriving.
Continuous Updates & Challenges:
Stay engaged with regular updates that introduce new challenges, recipes, and features. Keep your skills sharp as you adapt to the ever-evolving world of frozen delights and refreshing beverages.
Compete & Collaborate:
Engage in friendly competition with fellow entrepreneurs, or collaborate with them in special events. Test your skills against the best in the business and earn rewards that will help you grow even faster.
Sweet Success Awaits:
Experience the joy of sweet success as you master the art of ice cream and juice entrepreneurship. Will you be the ultimate maestro of frozen delights? Download "My Perfect Ice Cream & Juice Tycoon" now and begin your journey toward a world of sweet indulgence!
Dive into a world where the sweetness never ends, and your entrepreneurial dreams take flight in a cascade of flavors. Download now and let the sweet adventure begin!

Y
bluejetty:00024260:ios.description:
We all love to smile and see smiles in return. But to keep our smile beautiful, we need to take good care of our teeth. If they get sick, you have to go to a dentist. In our game you play the role of a dentist and treat patients' teeth.
You will learn how to remove tooth decay, drill teeth, place fillings, fight against bad odors and evil germs. There is also another curious operation in our game. You can put braces on the patients’ teeth if they are too crooked. But in order to do all of these procedures, a dentist has to do a lot of preliminary work. First, you will have to invite the patient to the office, make sure that he sits comfortably in the chair, and collect all the necessary tools. The main task of the doctor is to carefully examine the teeth in order to understand what must be done for treatment.
Patients will be infinitely grateful to you for every tooth you treat. In addition, for each cured patient, you will receive rewards. Collect them and feel like a real doctor helping patients. Let’s get to work.
P.S. We will be very thankful if after playing the game you leave reviews with your ideas and recommendations regarding the game. It will help us to make our games better and to create interesting content for you.

bluejetty:00123409:ios.description:
Keep track of the foods recommended by Dr. Greger in his New York Times Bestselling book, How Not to Die, and now his new book, How Not to Diet.
The 21 Tweaks feature, based on How Not to Diet, also provides a weight tracker. The weight tracker can use HealthKit to either save manually entered weight values or to read weight data from HealthKit enabled scales.
In the years of research required to create the more than a thousand evidence-based videos on his website NutritionFacts.org, Michael Greger, M.D, FACLM, has arrived at a list of what he considers the most important foods to include in a healthy daily diet. 
Dr. Greger’s Daily Dozen details the healthiest foods and how many servings of each we should try to check off every day. He explains his rationale in his book How Not to Die. 
All his proceeds from his books, DVDs, and speaking engagements are all donated to charity.
NutritionFacts.org is a non-commercial, non-profit, science-based public service provided by Dr. Greger, providing free daily updates on the latest in nutrition research via bite-sized videos. He has nearly a thousand videos on every aspect of healthy eating, with new videos and articles uploaded every day.
Like this app, everything on the website is both free of ads and free of charge.

bluejetty:00135635:ios.description:
The best way to view Washington 511 traffic alerts, road conditions and travel information.
MAIN FEATURES INCLUDE:
 + WSDOT 511 Traffic Incidents
 + Road Closures & Planned Events
 + Mountain Passes Information
 + Customizable Push Notifications
 + Home Screen Widgets
 + Winter Driving Weather
 + CCTV Traffic Cameras
 - View WSDOT, SDOT & BDOT cameras
 - Live stream city cameras
TRAFFIC INCIDENTS INCLUDE:
Traffic collisions, advisories, hazards, weather / wind advisories, heavy traffic, road closures, planned construction
QUICKLY VIEW CCTV CAMERAS
Create customized groups of CCTV cameras for viewing traffic on your route. This feature gives users a quick way of assessing road and traffic conditions.
HOME SCREEN CAMERA WIDGETS
Add up to (4) home screen widgets displaying your favorite CCTV cams.
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
Track WSDOT incidents and receive Push Notifications when new updates are available. The app also sends notifications when an incident is no longer being tracked by WSDOT. This feature is critical for staying up-to-date on road closures due to accidents. 
WINTER DRIVING WEATHER:
 - NOAA Snowfall Reports
 - Current Radar
 - NWS Watches & Warnings
TERMS & CONDITIONS

bluejetty:00099645:ios.name: DropIn 3D!
bluejetty:00099645:ios.summary: Prepare for DropIn 3D!: The Ultimate Color Drop And Drag Challenge! It’s a high-speed color puzzle jam where your reflexes and strategic thinking are put to the ultimate test. This is the definitive puzzle game for fans of color hole games.
bluejetty:00099645:ios.description:
Prepare for DropIn 3D!: The Ultimate Color Drop And Drag Challenge! It’s a high-speed color puzzle jam where your reflexes and strategic thinking are put to the ultimate test. This is the definitive puzzle game for fans of color hole games. Can you match and become the supreme puzzle game master?
Fun Color Puzzle Experience to boost your mental agility
- Core Mission: Your goal is to drop colorful stick figures into their matching holes. Drop them fast to win. Get away from stress and relax while you play. 
- High-Octane Challenge: The adventure requires precision sorting to conquer intricate, complex layouts and clear every block on the board.
- Ideal Fix: Perfect for those who crave the excitement of a fast-paced jam and the satisfaction of solving. Every session is a quick drop-in for fun.
Dynamic Gameplay & Features - a test of mastery
- Hundreds of Challenges: Master your skills as the puzzles get tougher across hundreds of levels, handling every block complicatedly.
- New Obstacles: Every level introduces new obstacles, perfect for fans of hole games and matching challenges.
- Strategic Threat: The black hole on every level will truly put your strategic thinking to the test.
- Intuitive UI: Start playing right away, enjoying the flow and excitement of the puzzle jam session.
Dominate the DropIn 3D! World with speed and agility in every drag
- Swift Movement: Swiftly move the color-matching holes, feeling the speed with every drag.
- Strategize & Sort: Strategize to clear the path and sort all color puzzle holes before time runs out.
- Adaptation: Adapt to each level’s unique challenges, embracing the mental agility needed for this jam, a key to mastering this hole game and navigating every complex block.
Experience DropIn 3D! and Start Solving
Play DropIn 3D! and immerse yourself in an exciting puzzle game experience. Relax and enjoy the perfect color puzzle, with a lot of color jam action and the satisfying reward of solving complete levels.

bluejetty:00180603:ios.name: SELPHY Photo Layout
bluejetty:00180603:ios.summary:
SELPHY Photo Layout is an application that allows you to create/save layouts of images to be printed with SELPHY using images stored on your smartphone or tablet.
[Key Features]
- Connect your smartphone or tablet wirelessly with SELPHY pr
bluejetty:00180603:ios.description:
SELPHY Photo Layout is an application that allows you to create/save layouts of images to be printed with SELPHY using images stored on your smartphone or tablet.
[Key Features]
- Connect your smartphone or tablet wirelessly with SELPHY printers and enjoy high-quality photo printing.
 ("Canon PRINT" must be installed separately for CP1300, CP1200, CP910, and CP900.)
- Easily print photos directly from the ‘Photos’ menu.
- Decorate and layout your photos freely with the ‘Collage’ menu before printing.
[Supported Products]
SELPHY CP Series
- CP1500, CP1300, CP1200, CP910, CP900*
SELPHY QX Series
- QX20, SQUARE QX10
[System requirement]
- iOS 17/18/26
- iPadOS 17/18/26
[Supported Images]
- JPEG, PNG, HEIF
[Supported Layouts / Functions ]
SELPHY CP Series
- Photos (Easily print an unmodified original photo)
- Collage (Have fun decorating or arranging multiple photos before you print)
- ID Photo (Print ID photos such as passport and driver’s license pictures from selfies.)
- Shuffle (Select up to 20 images, and they will be automatically arranged and printed on one sheet.)
- Custom Size (Print in any photo size)
- Tiling (split the photo into multiple tiles to print large)
- Snap a shot (Take a photo on the spot, decorate, and print)
- Bookmark (Print in a bookmark-style layout)
- Layout (Simply choose a photo to combine with a frame and print)
- Reprint (Print additional copies from your previously printed collection.)
- Collage Decoration Features (Include stamps, frames, text, paint tools, and embedded QR codes.)
- Pattern Overcoat Processing (Only for CP1500).
SELPHY QX Series
- Photos (Easily print an unmodified original photo)
- Collage (Have fun decorating or arranging multiple photos before you print)
- Custom Size (Print in any photo size)
- Snap a shot (Take a photo on the spot, decorate, and print)
- Layout (Simply choose a photo to combine with a frame and print)
- Reprint (Print additional copies from your previously printed collection.)
- Collage Decoration Features (Include stamps, frames, and text.)
- Pattern Overcoat Processing.
- Card & Square Hybrid Printing / Borderless & Bordered Printing (Only for QX20).
[Supported Paper Size]
- All available SELPHY-specific paper sizes for purchase *1
SELPHY CP Series
- Postcard Size
- L (3R) Size
- Card Size
SELPHY QX Series
- Square Sticker Paper for QX.
- Card Sticker Paper for QX (Only for QX20).
*1: availability may differ depending on region.
[Important Notes]
- If application does not operate properly, try again after shutting down the application.
- Features and services available in this application may differ depending on the model, country or region, and environment.
- Visit your local Canon Web pages for more details.
* CP900 does not support printing in ad-hoc mode with "Canon Print". Please use it in infrastructure mode.

New
bluejetty:00130997:ios.description:
Learn German Easily and Have Fun!
Our app makes learning German simple and fun, whether you're just starting out or already know some German. It's the perfect tool to help you get better at reading, understanding, and speaking German.
New! Learn German with AI
Now you can also learn using our new AI-powered feature, which lets you practice real conversations, improve your pronunciation, get corrections, and receive personalized recommendations.
Enjoy Fun German Stories
Get lost in exciting stories that make learning German enjoyable. Our app has hundreds of stories, all created and told by German experts, to help you learn the right pronunciation and improve your reading skills.
Test Your Understanding
After you enjoy a story, see how much you understood by taking a short quiz with five interesting questions.
Practice Making Sentences
Improve your German by putting words in the right order to make correct sentences. This is a great way to get better at the language.
Practice Speaking
Use our voice feature to practice your German pronunciation and get instant feedback to help you speak more fluently.
Always Something New to Learn
Our app keeps getting better with more and more German stories added regularly. This means you'll always have new things to learn, whether you're just starting or want more challenging material.
App Highlights:
- Easy-to-Use: Our app is straightforward, making your German learning smooth.
- For All Levels: It doesn't matter if you're a beginner or advanced, our app is designed for everyone.
- Improve Your Skills: Boost your reading, listening, and speaking skills with our engaging stories, quizzes, and activities.
- Lots of Stories: With a wide variety of stories and new ones added every week, you'll never run out of learning material.
- Completely Free: Our app is free, so anyone can start learning German.
Start learning German with us today! Keep up with our updates, and feel free to contact us with your questions, feedback, or ideas. We love hearing from you!

bluejetty:00073910:ios.summary:
Used by beginners through Major Championship winners on the PGA Tour, and validated by an Independent Scientific Study by the Departments of Physics and Biomechanics at Yale University.
The Tour Tempo Total Game allows you to learn how to
bluejetty:00073910:ios.description:
Used by beginners through Major Championship winners on the PGA Tour, and validated by an Independent Scientific Study by the Departments of Physics and Biomechanics at Yale University.
The Tour Tempo Total Game allows you to learn how to correctly integrate the Tempo of the Tour Pros into your golf swing. Over 100,000 golfers worldwide, including Major Championship winners on the PGA Tour, have improved their games by using Tour Tempo. 
"In all the reviews I've written for MyGolfSpy (a number now pushing up on 100), I'd only given one perfect score. Now Tour Tempo can be added to that most-elite company. Tour Tempo is scientifically proven, it's easy to use, and it will help you in every facet of the game." 
— GolfSpy Matt: http://www.mygolfspy.com/tour-tempo-review
"It will be the best thing that you will ever do for your game." 
— Pat Dempsey, 2011 RE/MAX World Long Drive Grand Champion 55+
"You will get better right away! When you synch your swing to that of the Tour Pros with Tour Tempo, you’ll get better right now!" 
— Dan Rooney, Folds of Honor
"The Unified Theory of Tempo" 
— Golf Digest 
"No one has ever come up with a way to teach Tempo until now."
— Travel + Leisure Golf 
Based on the international best selling golf book, Tour Tempo. The book outlines and explains the discovery of a specific mathematical ratio regarding the elapsed time of the backswing and the elapsed time of the downswing of the Tour Pros. The Tour Tempo System is simple and easy to learn. All you do is react to three scientifically spaced musical notes. These musical notes alert you to start your takeaway, start your downswing, and then the third note lines you up with impact. It’s just that easy - you literally download the app, turn it on, grab a club and start swinging to the Tempo of the Tour Pros.
LONG GAME
The Long Game Tones will teach you how to swing with the tempo ratio exhibited by the Tour Pros. We measured the time of their backswings and downswings by counting how many frames of video each part took. The magic ratio on full swings turned out to be three parts backswing to one part downswing. Tones are provided for each of the following frame ratios of Tour Tempo - 18/6, 21/7, 24/8 & 27/9. The Tour Tempo Tones have a clear purpose. They establish the intrinsic tempo of the golf swing in your subconscious mind. Once this is accomplished, you will not have to think about tempo while playing. This is what the Tour Pros have already done. You are about to acquire that same ability.
SHORT GAME
The Total Game App also contains the Short Game Tones of 14/7, 16/8, 18/9 & 20/10. After the publication of Tour Tempo, John Novosel studied the short game swings of the top touring pros, and discovered that virtually all of them employ a 2 to 1 swing ratio on or around the greens - a different Tempo than the 3 to 1 ratio of the Long Game. This is another reason why the game of golf is so hard to master. 
TEMPO TRACKS
The Tempo Tracks are an easy way to integrate Tour Tempo into your daily routine. One of the best ways to use the Tracks is to listen to them while driving to the course before a round of golf. The more you listen to them, the more the Tour Tempo rhythm will be ingrained into your Golf Swing. 
FOCUS TRACKS
The Focus Tracks are revolutionary relaxation songs that contain the Tones of Tour Tempo. Each Track has a Part II that has binaural tones embedded in the music to get your brain into an optimum state for concentration. This optimum state is more commonly known to athletes as “Being in the Zone.”
VIDEOS
The videos give a complete explanation of the Tones and how to use them to immediately and dramatically improve your Total Game. 
DISCOUNT
Get a one-time $10 discount code from the Info screen, valid on future purchases at TourTempo.com and TourTempo.eu.
TERMS OF USE
(EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00064748:ios.name: CornerStone State Bank
bluejetty:00064748:ios.summary: The CornerStone State Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you
bluejetty:00064748:ios.description:
The CornerStone State Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact CornerStone State Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the CornerStone State Bank App, you must be enrolled as an CornerStone State Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00154025:ios.description:
SpeakPet: Animal Communicator
Imagine a world where the joy of pet ownership meets limitless creativity—welcome to SpeakPet: Animal Communicator, an immersive experience that redefines digital companionship. This isn't just another pet game; it's a dynamic universe where every interaction strengthens your bond with a truly responsive virtual companion.
A New Era of Pet Ownership
From the moment you meet your pet, you'll be amazed by its vibrant personality and ability to connect. Watch with pride as your companion masters new skills through our revolutionary clicker training system—a scientifically inspired feature that makes every training session rewarding. The more you interact, the more your pet's intelligence and abilities flourish, creating a genuinely evolving relationship.
Hear the Magic of Connection
Experience the comforting purr of a contented feline, the excited yip of a playful pup, or even the majestic roar of exotic creatures. These authentic vocalizations do more than entertain—they create meaningful communication between you and your friend.
A Journey of Discovery
