bluejetty:00082761:ios.description:
Create your workouts quickly and easily, whatever training methods you use Crossfit, HIIT, Tabata, TRX etc. 
*** A single watchword SIMPLICITY ***
TimeFit app is an intelligent Tabata Timer with a custom interval timer. This advanced interval timer adds craziness to your fitness training and workouts. An enhanced timer with interval alerts make your training activity more interesting. TimeFit - Workout timer is your gym boss to track all your exercise activities. HIIT interval training timer makes it easy for you to calculate workouts routine. 
### THE FEATURES OF TIMEFIT ###
 Smart Stopwatch - A smart stopwatch is integrated into the TimeFit app. It shows you the fastest and slowest lap live.
Adaptive Circuit Training - A very easy to use editor with which you can create the circuit training adaptive to your sport.
Interval Timer - Plan your workouts in advance using interval trainers. When the days come, they will be displayed on the home screen of the TimeFit. Seconds timer and minute timer are ready with interval alerts. TimeFit - Workout Timer IS THE ONLY ONE TO DO IT.
Workout History - Logbook lets you keep track of your training history. Add workout photos and training notes to your routine. 
Voice Alerts - TimeFit will tell you the next exercise using enhanced timer and interval alerts. No need to look at the screen. The voice synthesis and the beeps are fully customizable.
Personalized - Creates folders to organize your workouts.
Easy Share - Exchange your workouts with your friends or with a sports coach.
Eye Comfort - Large display is coloured for the comfort of the eyes even from a distance. An infinite number of colors are available. 
But as a practice is better than a long speech, I invite you to try it :)

- Notifications are only used to show current or upcoming workout when the application is in the background.
- TimeFit will ask you for permission to access data from the Health application. TimeFit - Workout Timer uses information on weight, number of steps and distance travelled for enhanced user experience.

Já pensou ter mais cuidado com sua saúde, melhorar hábitos, comer melhor e ter uma vida mais saudável?

bluejetty:00046394:ios.description:
Já pensou ter mais cuidado com sua saúde, melhorar hábitos, comer melhor e ter uma vida mais saudável?
A miHmo é exatamente o que você procura!
A miHmo é uma healthtech que combina tecnologia e humanização e que vai te ajudar, por meio de um programa de atividades e conhecimento, a fazer pequenas mudanças no seu cotidiano que trarão grandes benefícios para a sua saúde no futuro. Tudo isso para você ter uma vida saudável, viver mais e melhor. 
Um serviço exclusivo e totalmente gratuito para colaboradores de nossas empresas parceiras. 
Jornada de Saúde
Ser “saudável” é estar equilibrado nas 3 dimensões: física, mental e social. 
A miHmo criará uma jornada de saúde exclusiva para atender suas necessidades e prioridades. Nela, identificamos hábitos e comportamentos que possam ocasionar futuros danos à sua saúde e, a partir dessas informações, criamos um planejamento com atividades e orientações voltadas à melhoria da sua saúde, isso tudo com a ajuda de uma equipe personalizada de profissionais para atenderem às suas necessidades.
Além disso, vamos acompanhar sua evolução, entender suas preferências e cuidar para que você tenha cada vez mais saúde. Pra fazer isso a gente utiliza 4 etapas:
1. Questionário
É um questionário sobre seu histórico de saúde e estilo de vida. É completo, rápido e muito importante para gente entender sobre você.
2. Conversa
Você vai agendar um bate papo com um membro do seu time de saúde, para a gente te conhecer ainda mais, entender seus objetivos e mapear metas.
3. Elaboração do plano
Com base nos dados nas duas primeiras etapas, o time de saúde vai elaborar o seu plano de ação que é único e exclusivo para você.
4. Execução do plano
Hora de colocar o seu plano em prática. A gente vai estar sempre junto com você e em pouco tempo você já sentirá a mudança :)
Um time de saúde totalmente dedicado a você.
Na miHmo você tem uma equipe multidisciplinar formada por médico, enfermeiro, nutricionista, psicólogo e health coach. Pessoas reais que te conhecem pelo nome, que cuidam de você, e estão disponíveis 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana.
Enfim, vamos “miHmar” você.
Não perca a chance de ter uma vida melhor e mais saudável
Estamos te esperando!

《泽上寂寞萤火》漫画岛作者千本，新作《水中飘零之星》；
《贫穷游戏》主笔老妹，新作《我与魔君不可说》；

曾在微博动漫之家连载的《水晶鞋》《伞少女梦谈》；
在知音漫客刊载的《偷星九月天》；
在漫漫漫画连载的《两不疑》《榴花不及春》；
曾在大角虫漫画刊载的橘味漫画《Lily》；
在腾讯动漫之家刊载的《今日的魔女依旧拉胯》均在哔哩哔哩漫画阅读器可看！

如晋江文学城作家木苏里的《全球高考》改编的同名漫画；
长佩文学双男主热门小说《社交温度》《信息素说我们不可能》《你的距离》《落池》《我和我的四个伴舞》等改编的同名漫画；
菠萝包轻小说平台热门小说《好徒儿你就饶了为师伐》《武帝隐居之后的生活》等改编的菠萝包出品的同名漫画；
不可能的世界的《忘川夜行》《从前只有小骷髅》；
飞卢小说网的《我丢！原来主播在修仙》《我被s级加密了》；
纵横中文网的《我只有两千五百岁》《大国名厨》；
橙光出品的《蓝宝石般的被害妄想少女》；
七猫小说平台的《凰妃倾天下》《最强学霸系统》；
轻之文库的《商业系天职的战斗法则》《涩系大小姐废宅养成计划》；
17K小说网的《修罗武神》；
刺猬猫轻小说平台的《好感度刷满之后》；
书耽网平台改编的《与他正面对决的日子》；
起点读书平台作者猫腻的热门小说改编的《大道朝天》同名漫画；

叮咚漫画之家的新大门打开了！
《我独自盗墓》、《我是继母，但是女儿太可爱了》、《骷髅骑士没能守住副本》、《装备我最强》等热门韩漫作品独家连载中！
热门韩剧《金秘书为什么这样》《W：两个世界》《便利店新星》原作韩漫也能在哔哩哔哩漫画APP里看到！看韩剧原作漫画不止在咚漫，B漫也很多哦！还有很多咚漫没有的独家韩漫，B漫也有！

经典港漫《海虎》、欧漫《父与子》《疯狂山脉》、美漫《变形金刚》漫威漫画等，满足你的特定漫画口味！

喜欢在猫耳FM听广播剧？除了声音外，想看漫画画面？vomic有声漫满足你！
咚咚咚漫画新世界欢迎你！
《不小心救了江湖公敌》《恶人想要抢救一下》《捡到男鬼后脱单了》《并不是我想当秘书》等有声漫画已上线！人气声优（CV）马正阳X文森，赵毅X林予曦，羊仔X郑希等人倾情演绎~
不仅是个小说漫画阅读器软件，还是个有声漫播放器！
【原创小说】
小破站原创漫画看完不过瘾，快看小说！和菠萝包轻小说平台改编的漫画一样，这里能看到哔漫漫画的原作小说！开启小说第一弹！
热门漫画小说原作《娘子竟是未来暴君女帝》《这个天道不昏庸》《圣女小姐请停止你的奇怪脑补!》均在连载中！哔哩哔哩漫画APP适配小说阅读器，小说连载更快，看剧情更爽！
【多重福利】
新人登录即送券，官方福利多又香！
快看我们的登录福利！
欢迎关注B站官方帐号@哔哩哔哩漫画
【哔哩哔哩漫画荣誉】
2019年9月，哔哩哔哩漫画获得CACC第16届中国动漫金龙奖“最佳动漫与游戏平台奖”奖项；
2020年8月，哔哩哔哩漫画发表声明，已经与国内35家漫画汉化组达成合作；
2020年9月，哔哩哔哩漫画正式与欧洲最大的漫画出版集团达高集团达成战略合作，成为国内首个引入欧洲漫画的正版漫画平台；
2021年9月，哔哩哔哩漫画3部独家漫画作品获得第18届中国动漫金龙奖奖项；
2022年12月，哔哩哔哩漫画3部作品获得第19届中国动漫金龙奖奖项：
《镇魂街》获最具影响力奖、《战国千年》获最具IP价值奖、《街角的向阳花屋》获最具破圈潜力奖。

bluejetty:00069405:ios.name: Flourish: Design Dream Spaces
bluejetty:00069405:ios.summary: Flourish by Garden Joy is a relaxing home design game where you create beautiful spaces that feel like your own. Unwind as you bring your creativity to life through outdoor design, stylish home decor, vibrant plants, and inspiring spaces. D
bluejetty:00069405:ios.description:
Flourish by Garden Joy is a relaxing home design game where you create beautiful spaces that feel like your own. Unwind as you bring your creativity to life through outdoor design, stylish home decor, vibrant plants, and inspiring spaces. Design dream homes at your own pace, express your personal style, and create your happy place.
There is no right or wrong way to design dream homes - just your vision, your style, and endless ways to create. Take your time decorating gardens, patios, rooftop terraces, and more. Choose from beautiful furniture, charming décor, colorful flowers, and lush plants to transform each space into something uniquely yours. 
Explore new home decor design challenges inspired by beautiful destinations around the world, from Mediterranean villas and beach houses to English cottages and mountain escapes. With new spaces to design regularly, there is always somewhere new to explore and let your creativity flourish.
CREATE YOUR HAPPY PLACE
- Design beautiful home design spaces that reflect your personality and style
- Decorate dream homes, gardens, patios, terraces, and other inspiring outdoor spaces
- Choose from stylish furniture, décor, flowers, plants, and more
- Relax with creative design sessions you can enjoy at your own pace
- Transform each space from a blank canvas into your own personal escape
LET YOUR CREATIVITY FLOURISH
- Bring your home design vision to life with hundreds of beautiful items to choose from
- Express yourself through relaxing design challenges with no wrong answers
- Discover new styles, destinations, and spaces to inspire your creativity
- Showcase your home decor design ideas and share your latest creations with the community
GROW YOUR COLLECTION
- Collect flowers, plants, trees, and bushes to bring your designs to life
- Grow your collection with seed packs and trade to discover more plants
- Build your collection of stylish indoor and outdoor furniture and décor
- Find the perfect pieces to complete every design
DESIGN TOGETHER
- Team up and design dream homes with up to three friends in limited-time multiplayer events
- Work together to create beautiful floral arrangements and earn rewards
- Share home design ideas and enjoy creating alongside the Flourish community
DISCOVER THE WORLD OF PLANTS
- Learn fun and interesting facts about flowers, plants, and trees
- Explore an in-game encyclopedia as your collection grows
- Discover new plants and incorporate them into your designs
MAKE A DIFFERENCE WHILE YOU PLAY
- Flourish by Garden Joy gives you the opportunity to help plant real trees while you play through our partnership with One Tree Planted. Create beautiful spaces in-game while contributing to a greener world beyond the game.
Whether you're looking for a relaxing creative escape, love decorating beautiful spaces, or simply want somewhere to express yourself, Flourish by Garden Joy gives you room to create, unwind, and let your imagination flourish.

bluejetty:00124061:ios.description:
Monster Legends is a free-to-play monster collection and strategy RPG where you breed, evolve, and battle with over 900 unique monsters. 
Build your own monster island, grow your roster with new species every week, and compete against players from around the world in real-time PvP battles. 
Monster Legends is the monster collection and strategy RPG for players who love building the perfect team, mastering deep progression systems, and competing at the highest level. 
Monster Legends offers one of the deepest and most rewarding experiences in the genre with a constantly expanding universe and a thriving competitive scene.
Pick your monsters, master their elements, and build a team capable of taking on anything. Every monster has a unique set of skills, elemental strengths, and strategic role, attacker, tank, or control, making team composition as important as individual power. 
The more you play, the deeper the strategy gets.
MONSTER LEGENDS FEATURES:
== Collect & Breed Monsters ==
• Collect over 900 monsters across multiple elements and rarities, from common creatures to ultra-rare mythic legends with game-changing abilities 
• Breed monsters of different elements and rarities to create entirely new species that only exist in your collection 
• New monsters are released every week through limited-time events, seasonal content, and special collaborations, the roster never stops growing 
• Hunt for exclusive legendary monsters through dungeons, PvP rewards, and time-limited events that keep every week feeling different
== Deep RPG Progression & Strategy ==
• Evolve your monsters through multiple tiers and rank them up in the Monster Lab to unlock their full combat potential 
• Fine-tune your team's power with Runes, Relics, Beasts, and Talents — a layered progression system that rewards strategic thinking and long-term planning 
• Build battle teams around attacker, tank, and control roles, and master elemental strengths and weaknesses to counter any opponent 
• With hundreds of possible team combinations, no two Monster Masters play exactly the same way
== Real-Time Multiplayer PvP Battles ==
• Challenge real players in Live Duels, fast-paced, real-time PvP battles that put your strategy and team composition to the ultimate test 
• Climb through competitive Leagues in Multiplayer Mode, earning trophies and exclusive high-tier rewards as you rise through the global rankings 
• Fight through the Era Saga Dungeons to uncover the full lore and story of Monster Legends and its legendary inhabitants
== Build & Expand Your Monster Island ==
• Design and expand your own monster island with Habitats, Farms, a Breeding Mountain, and key facilities like the Monster Lab and the Library 
• Each habitat is tied to a specific monster element, build and organize your island around your collection and battle strategy
== Team Up & Dominate Together ==
• Join a Team to unlock exclusive cooperative events including Wars and Marathons, where coordinated strategy makes all the difference 
• Use the Team Chat to plan battle formations, share monster builds, and build a competitive edge with your teammates
• The most dedicated Monster Masters climb global leaderboards and earn rewards that solo players simply can't access
Are you skillful enough to become the #1 Monster Master in the world?
Connect with the Monster Legends Community:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MonsterLegends
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/monsterlegends
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/MonsterLegendsGame
X: https://x.com/Monster_Legends
Discord: https://discord.gg/monsterlegends
Monster Legends is FREE to download and includes optional in-game purchases (including random items). Information about drop rates for random item purchases can be found in-game. If you wish to disable in-game purchases, please turn off the in-app purchases in your phone or tablet’s Settings.
Do Not Sell My Personal Information: https://www.take2games.com/ccpa/

Whether you're a cont
bluejetty:00082036:ios.description:
Hover is the property intelligence platform that turns a scan of any residential or commercial property into high-quality 3D data, complete with accurate measurements, structured documentation, and reliable estimates.
Whether you're a contractor winning bids or an adjuster closing claims, Hover gives every property professional a single, verified source of truth—from first scan to final estimate.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Scan the property. Walk around the structure and scan with your phone. Hover takes the photos you need, no special equipment or second visit required.
2. Hover builds your 3D model and measurements. Hover AI generates a precise 3D model with accurate dimensions for the roof, siding, walls, windows, and doors.
3. Document, estimate, and close. For contractors: generate material quantities, explore design options, and send a professional bid before you leave the driveway. For adjusters: review organized damage documentation, get a repair vs. replace determination, and push a claim-ready package directly to your estimating platform.
ONE PLATFORM, EVERY WORKFLOW Hover connects measurement, inspection, and documentation in a single platform. Verified property reports and structured data flow directly into your estimating tools, CRMs, and project management systems—eliminating re-measurement and manual data entry from first site visit to final proposal.
Whether you're a solo contractor, a regional roofing company, or a national insurance carrier, Hover scales to your operation. One visual platform. Every property. Every professional.
FOR ROOFING & EXTERIOR CONTRACTORS Scan a property, get your measurements, and build a professional proposal—all before you leave the driveway. Hover covers roofing, siding, gutters, windows, doors, and full exterior projects.
No more manual takeoffs. No more return visits to re-measure. No more lost bids because your estimate took too long. Hover puts accurate material quantities in your hands on the spot—so you win more projects and close faster than the competition.
FOR INSURANCE ADJUSTERS & CLAIMS TEAMS Scan the property, document the damage, and push a claim-ready package to your estimating platform, all from a single visit. Hover covers exterior and interior claims for any damage type, any complexity.
No more return visits to re-measure. No more sorting and uploading photos after hours. No more starting over because something was missed on-site. Hover guides you through every step of the scan, inspection, and damage assessment on the property, so when you leave, you're done.
Back at the desk, review site photos matched to each roof slope in an interactive 3D model to make faster, more confident repair vs. replace decisions, and get the payout right the first time.
The result: accurate, defensible documentation that holds up, every time, no matter who performed the inspection.
WHY PROFESSIONALS CHOOSE HOVER
* 12M homes scanned
* Over 300K construction professionals trust Hover
* Trusted by nine of the top ten national carriers in the US
* Gold standard 3D measurements validated by industry experts
* Property reports accepted by leading insurance carriers nationwide
* Integrates with leading estimating platforms and construction CRM systems
* The only visual estimating platform that combines measurements and design—all the way to generating professional proposals
Hover is free to download. First scan takes under 10 minutes—start before you leave your next job site.

bluejetty:00078289:ios.description:
Daybook is a FREE, passcode-protected personal diary, journal, and notes app available for IOS. Daybook helps to record activities, experiences, thoughts, and ideas throughout the day. It lets you organize your created diary/journal entries or notes from the past in the easiest way.
WHY USE DAYBOOK?
• SAFEGUARD MEMORIES: Daybook enables you to write a private diary, memoir, journals, and notes in the most natural way and record memories in an organized manner.
• GUIDED JOURNAL: Supports guided journal for tracking mood and activities, Mental Health Journal for managing stress and anxiety, Gratitude journal, self-improvement, and more.
• JOURNAL INSIGHTS: Gather insights using mood analyzer from your activity log & mood log.
• Daybook AI: Journal GPT, lets you delve into the details of your journal entries, ask questions about them, and even explore topics from journaling to wellness and mental health. 
• SECURE AND PASSCODE PROTECTED: Journal with lock helps to keep the diary private. Security Code allows keeping your entries private. Data stored in the app is securely protected with diary with lock.
• EASY-TO-USE: It's easy-to-use journaling, a routine daily tracker with superior diary/journal experience — nothing confusing, nothing complicated- its simple diary for everyday daily writing. Just write and save a journal notebook! Diary Calendar view helps to navigate to a previously written lo easily.
• FREE CONTENT STORAGE WITH AUTO DATA BACKUP: Content/photos included in the daily notes journal will be accessed from different devices and will back up to the cloud automatically. 
• MULTIPURPOSE USABILITY: Following are some of Daybook use cases.
- As an emotion tracker: Capture your feelings that reflect your emotional state, whether you are thankful, filled with gratitude, upset or depressed about something, maybe an illness. 
- As a to-do list app
- As a Business diary day planner: 
- As a Trip journal app: Seamlessly enable us to travel journals, including travel photos in an orderly manner. Camera capture enables us to take photos quickly in a simple journal.
- As a Daily expense tracker: Organize your receipts, bills, and invoices daily. Note and save!
- As a Class notebook: For educational purposes, use it as - homework tracker, Assignment Planner, simple notebook, a quick reference, creating quick notes with pictures
- As a wish list app
- As a pocket diary and a note keeper app: Record your life journey. 
Standout features:
- Sync entries across platforms such as Mobile, Web, Digital Assistance.
- Voice-activated features 
Our Daybook premium unlocks the following features:
- Access to Custom Templates
- Elegant themes
- Access to all guided journal 
- Upload more photos with higher resolution
Daybook offers premium through:
1. Auto-renewing subscriptions $4.49/monthly and 29.99$/yearly 
2. Onetime purchase ($94.49)
These prices are in US Dollars (USD). Pricing in other currencies and countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
After the free trial, the total amount for the subscription will be charged to your iTunes Account. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal at the total subscription price within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed or canceled via your iTunes Account Settings. Any unused portion of the free trial is forfeited after purchase. Special introductory offers only apply to the first billing term.

• Terms of service: https://blog.daybook.app/terms-of-use.html
• Privacy policy: hhttps://blog.daybook.app/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00159899:ios.description:
Genesis is a free AI chatbot and AI assistant that puts every top AI model in one app. Chat with AI, ask anything, generate images, search the web, analyze files and photos, and talk using your voice, all inside a single AI chat app.
ALL THE TOP AI MODELS IN ONE APP
Genesis gives you GPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek and Grok side by side. Switch models in one tap and pick the AI that answers best for writing, reasoning, coding or creative work. Instead of installing a separate app for every AI chatbot, you get them all in one place.
PICK THE RIGHT MODEL FOR THE JOB
Genesis has many chat models and image models from the top AI companies. Choose a fast one for quick questions, a reasoning model for hard problems, or a creative one for writing. Switch models in the middle of a conversation without losing the thread, and compare how different AI answer the same question.
AI CHAT THAT ANSWERS ANYTHING
Ask questions and get fast, accurate answers in real time. Genesis is built for everyday AI chat: explain a topic, plan a trip, draft an email, debug code, summarize a document, or just talk.
AI IMAGE GENERATOR
Turn text into images in seconds. Create artwork, illustrations, logos and avatars with a built-in AI image generator, then edit and refine them without leaving the conversation.
AI WEB SEARCH
Genesis can search the web and bring back current, relevant information with clear answers, so you never have to switch apps to look something up. Paste a link and Genesis will summarize it, translate it or pull out the key points.
FILES, PHOTOS AND CAMERA
Upload PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, code files and images for analysis, or snap a photo with the camera and ask about it. Extract text from a photo, summarize long documents, understand a chart or pull the key points out of a report.
VOICE CHAT
Speak to the AI and hear natural spoken answers back, for a hands-free AI assistant experience.
WRITING, STUDY AND WORK
Write essays, posts, emails and stories. Get step-by-step help with math and schoolwork. Translate, proofread and rewrite. Genesis works as a study assistant and a productivity assistant in the same app.
ROLE-PLAY AND AI ASSISTANTS
Dive into interactive role-play with dynamic characters, or talk to specialized AI assistants built for specific tasks.
KEY FEATURES
- Free AI chat powered by GPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek and Grok
- AI image generator and AI image editing
- AI web search with up-to-date answers
- Upload PDFs, documents, code and photos for analysis
- Link Insight: paste a link for an instant summary or translation
- Camera: take a photo and ask the AI about it
- Image to text: pull written text out of any photo
- Voice input and spoken AI responses
- Writing, translation, math and homework help
- Role-play characters and specialized AI assistants
Download Genesis and get every AI chatbot in one free AI assistant app.

Terms: https://sites.google.com/view/genesisai-terms-and-conditions/home

bluejetty:00170892:ios.description:
Who needs a gym? Get in shape at home with workouts from FITIFY.
Fitify is your 100% personalized guide to lose weight, burn fat, build muscle strength. With over 900 exercises, your daily workout routines are always fresh, fun effective!
No gym required - you can only workout using the weight of your body (no equipment!). However, we are the only app out here also providing Workouts and Plans with fit tools, such as:
• Kettlebell
• TRX
• Bosu
• Exercise Ball
• Resistance Band
• Dumbbell
• Barbell
• Medicine Ball
• Foam Roller
• Pull-Up Bar
Fitify is your ultimate full body workout app to lose weight, burn fat, build muscle & strength. With over 900 exercises in the work out app, your daily workout routines are always fresh, fun & effective! Work out anywhere, anytime using any fit tool. No equipment required, but if you have one - take advantage of it!
What can we do for you?
• Personalized fitness plan - custom training plan based on your experience, goal, and time options. Each workout routine is created based on your personal fitness level to get you the best results.
• 15 minutes daily workouts
• over 900 bodyweight & fit tools exercises - so the workout is always fun, unique and effective
• 20+ prebuilt workouts - choose body part, type of training, and duration
• 15+ prebuilt recovery sessions - Stretching, Yoga, and Foam Rolling classes
• Bodyfat scanner and muscle mass tracking to help you monitor progress and stay motivated
• ability to build your own “Custom workout” from our huge exercise database
• works offline, voice coach, clear HD video demonstrations
FITNESS PLANS
• Weekly training plan full of Workout and Recovery sessions
• Workouts only take 15-25 minutes to complete.
• HIIT, Tabata, Strength Trainings, Cardio, and Recovery sessions with easy-to-follow video exercises.
• See history and track your awesome progress!
BODY SCANNER
Track more than just your weight. Fitify’s bodyfat scanner (muscle scanner) helps you follow changes in your body over time – with just your phone’s camera in 60 seconds.
STANDALONE WORKOUTS
Whether you go bodyweight or use a tool like Kettlebell, you can choose to follow a plan or run any of our prebuilt workouts. Choose body part, type of training and duration. Simple as that, effective as hell!
CUSTOM WORKOUTS
Workout Routines blend your own workout from our beast database of over 900 exercises.
APPLE HEALTH
Connect Fitify to Apple Health and keep track of all your finished activities and burned calories.
Fitify is free to download and includes access to selected workouts. Upgrade to Fitify Pro for personalized training plans, AI personal trainer, and a wider range of workouts.
Contact: support@gofitify.com
Terms of Use: https://gofitify.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://gofitify.com/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00113974:android.description:
Korona is a simple and convenient application for sending and receiving money transfers, debt transfers and other financial services. Online transfers are available in more than 50 countries without opening an account, and transfers are credited instantly.
In the application, you can:
• choose a convenient transfer currency depending on the direction
• send a money transfer to a card/account without commission. A 0% commission rate applies if the payment currency differs from the currency in which the transfer was sent
• send a loan transfer - send money now and pay later
• credit the transfer online to a bank card without contacting the bank
• receive transfers that can be received in cash
• find agent locations to receive a transfer in cash
• check the status of the transfer
• check transfer history
• apply for a loan online even without a credit history and credit money immediately to your card
• receive a loan on the day of application using the national passport of a foreign citizen or a Russian passport
• make loan payments and repay the loan completely
• find answers to frequently asked questions
• consult with support in chat
To send or deposit a money transfer, you need a bank card. To send an application for a loan to a card - documents of a migrant or citizen of the Russian Federation. All services are available around the clock.
Loans for users from the CIS are provided by LLMC “Korona”, Reg. No. in State MFO register 2120719001908 dated 08/07/2012, (Novosibirsk region, urban settlement Koltsovo, rural settlement Koltsovo, Technoparkovaya str., building 1, OGRN 1121902000879). Current loan conditions and Personal Data Processing Policy at https://banzelmo.com/documents/
Loans are issued in amounts from 1,000 to 70,000 rubles. Minimum period – 3 months; maximum - 5 months. Interest on loans is accrued from the day following the day the loan was issued and up to and including the day the loan is repaid at a rate of 291.635% per annum (range of values for the total cost of the loan is 286.327-291.889% per annum).
Loans are available to citizens of Russia, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Moldova, Armenia, Georgia, as well as citizens of Belarus if they receive a loan again, from 18 to 75 years inclusive.

-Transfer money between your accounts

-Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
-View and save your monthly statements
-Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Coulee Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Coulee Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Build Zombie-Free Shelter
Expand your shelter, protect survivors, and assign roles based on their unique skills to maximize efficiency.

Stay alert! Zombies and other threats lurk everywhere. Arm your shelter with powerful weapons to fend off waves of undead and monsters.

The HWPO Training app offers a variety of programs to suit different lifes
bluejetty:00091060:ios.description:
HWPO Training encompasses fitness programs created for a community of HARD WORKERS, inspired by 5x CrossFit Games Champion, Mat Fraser’s motto “Hard Work Pays Off”.
The HWPO Training app offers a variety of programs to suit different lifestyles, goals, equipment accessibility, and skill levels. Whether you need to be in and out of the gym in 45 minutes or you’re training to be an elite-level competitor, HWPO Training has a workout program for you.
Athletes can track their progress using personalized sessions based on individual performance metrics and celebrate their achievements on the real-time leaderboard. The app also provides coaching videos by Mat Fraser himself, as well as our team of world-class expert coaches, guiding members through every training session and providing demos of each exercise.
Our HARD WORKERS also gain access to our members-only support platform, where they can ask questions, receive feedback, watch exclusive content and engage with others in the community around the world. No matter how or where you move, all we ask is that you live out our core values in and out of the gym:
SHOW UP. Do today what others won’t so tomorrow you can do what others can’t.
WORK HARD. Define success for yourself and be relentless in your pursuit of it; it’s about the process.
MAKE YOURSELF PROUD. Do things with intention and set an example of HARD WORK for those around you.

bluejetty:00170018:ios.summary: Are you fascinated by the mysteries of the world? Do you notice anything unusual in your life? Do you want to discover the hidden side of yourself? Join us in the fun curiosity lab we have created for you, where we will take you on a journe
bluejetty:00170018:ios.description:
Are you fascinated by the mysteries of the world? Do you notice anything unusual in your life? Do you want to discover the hidden side of yourself? Join us in the fun curiosity lab we have created for you, where we will take you on a journey to explore and unleash your endless imagination of the world.
* Discovery Center
Do you want to see what your baby will look like or get a glimpse of your future? Discovery Center is the app for you. If you want to see your cutest baby in advance, just select your and your partner’s photos and choose the baby’s gender, then you can see your baby’s face in seconds. Using intelligent technology, analyze the similarity between your future baby and you and your partner, as well as the potential characteristic. 
If you want to peek into your future life, just take a photo of your left or right palm, then you will get the analysis of your love, wisdom and health.
*Aging Tour
Hop on the Curiosity Lab time machine and travel 40 years into the future with one click. See how you will look like at 80 and start a journey through time! You can also select photos of your family and friends to see how they will age.
* Self Exploration
Humans are the most mysterious creatures in the world. We also have many secrets. For example, how did you die in your previous life and how long could you survive on a deserted island, etc. By answering a few simple questions and taking some interactive tests, you might be able to understand yourself better and solve many of your doubts.
* Intellectual Challenge
Do you think you are smart enough? Come and try our puzzle game. Curiosity Lab has prepared a large number of brain teasers for you, waiting for you to challenge them!
* Life Discovery
Curiosity Lab collects interesting encyclopedia articles from around the world, they can help you unlock the door to the unknown world, satisfy your curiosity and learn useful knowledge.
Curiosity Lab is free to download and use, and at the same time, some of our features are premium features for members, which can be unlocked by subscribing to Curiosity Lab PRO!

bluejetty:00093200:ios.description:

• Retrieve your forgotten username/password
• Report a debit card as lost or stolen

bluejetty:00153790:ios.description:
Injurymap helps you independently reduce your pain - when and where you want to. 
The app's training programs are designed by leading specialist doctors to give you safe and effective treatment. The programs are easy to get started with and cover all the main body areas. Injurymap automatically adjusts its exercises to suit your needs and transforms your rehabilitation into a simple and manageable process so you can get back to enjoying your everyday life without the discomfort of pain.
BENEFITS OF USING INJURYMAP
• EFFECTIVE PAIN RELIEF
Every time you train with Injurymap, you get exercises that build your balance, mobility, and strength in the injured area. The exercises relieve, treat, and prevent pain.
• DEVELOPED BY SPECIALIST DOCTORS AND PHYSIOTHERAPISTS
Injurymap's 350+ exercises have all been selected by medical specialists based on the best scientific evidence in muscle and joint pain treatment.
• SAFE EXERCISES TAILORED TO YOUR NEEDS
The app continually adjusts your workout program to give you the exact exercises you need for your specific injury and pain. 
• TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
We compile your progress in a simple overview so you can easily see your progress, pain reduction, and training plan. 
• WORKOUTS THAT FIT INTO YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
The video exercises make it easy and safe to train wherever and whenever you want - at home or during a break at work.
• UNDERSTAND YOUR PAIN AND HOW TO PREVENT IT
Injurymap offers 100+ articles and tips to help you understand your injury and pain and how best to treat and prevent it in the future. 
MEET YOUR PHYSIOTHERAPIST ONLINE
Through selected health insurance plans, Injurymap offers online treatment sessions with experienced physiotherapists who follow your progress from start to finish. You meet your physiotherapist in online video consultations, so you can easily join from the comfort of your own home or during a break at work. 
The Injurymap app supports your online program with a personalized training program and all the other benefits that come with Injurymap. Between consultations, you can always get help and ask questions to your physiotherapist via the app's chat function. 
INJURYMAP COVERS THE FOLLOWING AREAS
• Achilles pain
• Ankle pain
• Arch pain
• Back pain
• Elbow pain
• Hip pain
• Knee pain
• Neck pain
• Shoulder pain
ABOUT INJURYMAP
Injurymap is CE-marked as a medical device. The CE mark guarantees that Injurymap conforms to the health and safety standards set by the European Union.
Injurymap is free to use for a trial period of two weeks, during which you are free to cancel your subscription at no cost. Injurymap requires a paid subscription after the expiration of the trial period. The subscription period is for one month or 12 months and provides full access to all exercises in Injurymap: 
12 months: $40.99 ($3.42 / month)
1 month: $9.49
• Payment is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
• Please note that subscriptions are automatically renewed unless automatic renewal has been turned off no later than 24 hours before the end of the subscription period.
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can cancel the automatic renewal of your subscription by navigating to the settings menu in your iTunes account.
• Any unused portion of the two-week free trial period is forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
Terms of use: https://www.injurymap.com/terms

bluejetty:00080145:ios.description:
It's time to have some fun in the Hit Knife Throw Master!
In Hit Knife Master, the excitement never stops! As you dive into the knife games, you'll find yourself immersed in the art of throwing knives. It's not just about hitting targets; it's about mastering the finesse of each throw. Grab those knives and get ready for a thrilling adventure. The more accurate your throws, the closer you get to becoming the ultimate knife throw master. Just be on your toes, the knife games keep getting more exciting with new obstacles to overcome. 
In a Knife throwing game, when you're ambushed by a massive crowd of enemies, all you've got are your trusty knives. But fear not! It's time to show off your knife throwing skills. Take aim, toss those knives, and eliminate your targets one by one. So, gear up, stay sharp, and conquer the crowd in the knife throwing game.
Hit Knife Throw Master has a lot of interactive items. If you don't like taking down enemies one by one, go for some explosive action! Just toss a knife into an exploding barrel, and bam! You can wipe out a whole crowd of enemies in one go. But beware, the enemies won't wait their turn politely. They come at you all at once, armed with baseball bats and massive spanners.
Hit Knife Throw Master Games Features:
Enjoy beautiful 3D graphics and stunning visuals.
Easily navigate the game with user-friendly controls.
Simple interface and enjoyable gaming experience.
Tackle challenging missions that push your knife throwing skills.
Get ready for an epic journey filled with sharp throws and victorious moments in a knife throwing game. 
Download the Hit knife Master and start your journey now!

bluejetty:00118802:ios.summary: Beesy is an all-in-one collaborative solution, AI powered, to help teams improve their daily productivity. Beesy consolidates all your data from all your usual tools to plan, organise, collaborate and track your work and teamwork in one sin
bluejetty:00118802:ios.description:
Beesy is an all-in-one collaborative solution, AI powered, to help teams improve their daily productivity. Beesy consolidates all your data from all your usual tools to plan, organise, collaborate and track your work and teamwork in one single place
"This application is perfect for managers, project managers and salespeople. " - Mac4ever
"Beesy, the smart organization on iPad. " - Macworld.com
"The application that makes meetings effective and participants smile. " - Locita
"The essential application you need to have in your tablet! " - iPhonote
"Beesy is a real tool in the quest for operational excellence. "F. Bidarra, Construction Manager, Eiffage Construction.
"With Beesy, my sales people earn 1 appointment a day. "E. Goncalves, Customer Experience Manager, Renault Switzerland
MEETING MANAGEMENT – TASK MANAGEMENT – ACTIVITY & PROJECT MANAGEMENT – TEAMWORK – PEOPLE MANAGEMENT – ACTIVITY REPORTING
SAVE ONE DAY PER WEEK TO FOCUS ON THE ESSENTIAL & INCREASE YOUR TEAMWORK
Every day Beesy helps you to:
1) manage your To-Do List and your projects
2) take your meeting notes for Effective meeting 
3) follow-up of your Team member’ action plans 
4) manage your goals and projects
5) follow-up of your important emails to avoid getting lost in the information overload
6) Drive your recurring meetings and their action plan progress
7) Professional and automated meeting minutes in less than 1 min
8) Complete reporting on all your activity to visualize your activity in a glance
9) Supercharge your Microsoft Tools with our Microsoft integration
10) 100% reusable information: sorted, stored, shared and synchronized between all members of your team > you save time and you no longer lose any information
In option you can use Beesy AI powered Smart assistant available from all your daily tools (instant messaging: Microsoft Teams, Skype, Slack; emails: Gmail, Outlook or even Siri) .
Exchange with your Beesy smart assistant in natural language to :
• Create notes and actions
• Delegate tasks
• Create projects
• Access and manage your information without having to connect to your Beesy app, directly from emails, instant messaging (Microsoft Teams, Skype, Slack...) and even in mobility with Siri 
• Generate automated MOM and automated reports on all your activity: action plan synthesis, individual point, project synthesis...
Beesy is designed for anyone who manages a large number of actions every day and needs to manage their follow-up: sales teams, technical teams, managers, project managers...
Join the 60 000+ users who save time every day with Beesy.
In addition, Beesy adds a number of features to help you be more efficient at taking notes and managing your To-Do:
- Add audio recordings and bullets to your notes
- Add photos to your notes from your library or by taking a photo
- Summary of actions
- Choice of report language by Note
- Additional on-demand To-Do filtering in each view
- Dual-Touch Drag&Drop to easily change the context of a task: for contacts, meetings, topics and projects
- CSV export for external analysis
- Drawing function, access to a web page or plans + Possibility to draw and write on your captures of web pages or plans
- Access your iCal calendar, Outlook in Beesy and possibility to create a note associated with a meeting. Beesy will identify participants and link your notes to your calendar
- Importing contacts from the iPad address book
- Pincode protection
- Compatibility with hardware keyboards
If you like the application, don't forget to recommend it!
In case of problems, contact us using our website under support (we have no way to contact you via your comments on the AppStore).

bluejetty:00033821:ios.name: OFFTO
bluejetty:00033821:ios.summary:
OFFTO is the first hotel and airline booking app specializing in ready-made packages and holidays designed by other experienced travelers and travel industry experts around the world.
Save your time and effort in searching for cheap airline
bluejetty:00033821:ios.description:
OFFTO is the first hotel and airline booking app specializing in ready-made packages and holidays designed by other experienced travelers and travel industry experts around the world.
Save your time and effort in searching for cheap airline tickets and comparing the details of hotels, and enjoy holidays, travel offers, and integrated packages including appropriate hotel reservations and timely flights.
Why choose OFFTO?
● Packages based on real travel experiences
OFFTO offers you ready-made travel packages based on real experiences from experienced travelers and travel experts. Packages include appropriate airline tickets and appropriate hotels, no more travel packages designed without a real experience or significant experience.
● Multi options for hotel reservations and various airline tickets
All OFFTO packages include 3 different accommodation options out of more than 400,000 hotels around the world. Package designers recommend the best hotels according to their experience, and you can change or upgrade the room or suite at any time.
OFFTO travel packages also include 3 different flight options from 350 airlines such as Kuwait Airways, Emirates, Gulf Air, Adele Airlines, Etihad Airways, Saudi Arabian Airline. Travel experts recommend cheap and convenient airline tickets for you with the possibility of changing class easily.
● Variety of travel packages
OFFTO travel and holidays are very diverse. Whatever your destination and budget, you'll find something right for you, and if you don't find a pre-prepared package that suits you, you can contact us via the app to design a customized package that meets your needs in terms of hotel reservations and airline tickets.
● Multiple payment methods
The OFFTO booking app provides you with secure and accessible payment options such as credit cards, debit cards, KNET Kuwait, and Sadad cards in Saudi Arabia, BENEFIT in Bahrain, and Qatar Debit Card.
● All details are clear
With OFFTO travel packages you can find out all the details about your hotel reservations such as hotel location, room and facilities photos, details about airline tickets, permitted weights the entire itinerary.
● Sophisticated Search Engine
A sophisticated search engine to access the best travel packages that suit you with sophisticated filtering options to showcase the best travel packages for you.
ease and speed
Easy to choose and book packages in just three steps Look, choose and book in less than 60 seconds and everything is ready.
Services included in packages
OFFTO packages include not only hotel reservations and airline tickets, but also other package services such as delivery service covered in most packages, travel health insurance is also included in most packages, and all OFFTO travel packages include free emergency medical consultations throughout the journey.
And more features!
Prices for travel packages, airline tickets, and hotels are instantly up-to-date.
● Immediate booking of pre-prepared packages.
● The app is available in Both Arabic and English in one version.
● A page for managing all your package bookings.
● E-mail notifications for reservations and payments.
● A page dedicated to all application settings such as currency and country.
● A page for customizing your account.
OFFTO - travel like experts!
Need help?
Contact us by 22257224/22257225 phone
E-mail care@offto.com.kw
Our website https://offto.com.kw

bluejetty:00083182:ios.name: The Word One to One
bluejetty:00083182:ios.summary: The Word One to One app gives you everything you need to get together with a friend and see what the Bible says about Jesus. It helps you journey with a friend through John’s Gospel a bit of the Bible which gives a unique overview of its me
bluejetty:00083182:ios.description:
The Word One to One app gives you everything you need to get together with a friend and see what the Bible says about Jesus. It helps you journey with a friend through John’s Gospel a bit of the Bible which gives a unique overview of its message as a whole, and its following book, Acts.
Around the world, thousands of people are finding that exploring the Bible together is an incredibly helpful and enjoyable experience – and with The Word One to One app, you can too!
JOURNEY THROUGH JOHN’S GOSPEL AND ACTS
The Bible text is presented verse-by-verse in short ‘episodes’, so you can enjoy reading at your own pace with a friend
Each episode takes no longer than 45 minutes to complete, meaning that you and your friend can make it work around your schedules
CHAT ABOUT WHAT YOU’RE READING
Helpful notes explain the meaning and guide your conversation about what you’re reading
LEARN MORE ABOUT THE BIBLE
Maps and historical information help you follow Jesus’ life and ministry, as well as learn about the cultures and places He lived in
RECAP THE KEY POINTS
Clear summaries at the end of each episode help you go back over what you’ve been reading
Bible text is also provided so that you can re-read what you’ve looked at in each episode
CONNECT WITH THE WORD ONE TO ONE
Get in touch with The Word One to One from inside the app
Find out where to buy copies of The Word One to One books
Stay encouraged by following The Word One to One on Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube and by subscribing to our Email Newsletter
Discover more about The Word One to One at theword121.com
---
Here’s what others think about The Word One to One:
“It’s such a significant text, you have to dedicate time and effort to it, and you need a fellow traveller. There’s nothing quite like reading and sharing your reactions to it.” – Alex, an atheist
“The thing I value most is the ability to be vulnerable as I explore something that I know is important, but is totally new to me, with a person I trust.” – Matt, an agnostic
“It’s been a wonderful experience reading the Bible with others!” – Jinna, a Christian
---
Download now and explore what the Bible says about Jesus, together.

bluejetty:00082410:ios.name: Goblins Wood: lumber tycoon
bluejetty:00082410:ios.summary:
Welcome to Goblins Wood: Tycoon Idle Sim – the ultimate goblin-themed merge and mining adventure!
Dive into a fantasy world where mischievous goblins run their own lumber empire. Combine, evolve, and manage goblin workers in this addicting
bluejetty:00082410:ios.description:
Welcome to Goblins Wood: Tycoon Idle Sim – the ultimate goblin-themed merge and mining adventure!
Dive into a fantasy world where mischievous goblins run their own lumber empire. Combine, evolve, and manage goblin workers in this addicting idle tycoon simulator. Ready to become the richest goblin overlord?
MERGE GOBLINS TO LEVEL UP
Start small with basic goblin diggers and merge goblins to create stronger, faster, and smarter workers! Unlock legendary goblin types with unique skills. This is not just another merge game – this is a goblin merge evolution experience!
EXPAND YOUR GOBLIN EMPIRE
Begin in a mysterious enchanted forest, chop wood, mine resources, and dig deep to uncover hidden treasures. Build sawmills, unlock new mining zones, and evolve your forest into a powerful goblin kingdom.
IDLE INCOME, REAL PROFITS
Even when you're offline, your goblin crew keeps working! Enjoy the satisfying idle clicker mechanics that let you earn gold, gems, and rare items effortlessly. Upgrade your goblins, boost production, and turn your woodland mine into a thriving idle tycoon business!
COLLECT CARDS & BOOST POWER
Gather a wide range of goblin character cards to unlock powerful bonuses. Strategically level them up to maximize efficiency in your lumber and mining empire.
STRATEGY + MERGE + TYCOON FUN
Every merge decision matters. Use smart idle strategy to manage goblin teams, time upgrades, and optimize your resources. Will you invest in faster goblins, expand your territory, or unlock rare merge combos?
DISCOVER NEW AREAS & TERRITORIES
As your goblin empire grows, unlock exciting new biomes and digging zones. From mushroom groves to crystal caves, each area brings new idle merge challenges and loot!
WHY PLAY GOBLINS WOOD: TYCOON IDLE SIM?
- Addictive idle gameplay with rich progression
- Unique goblin merge mechanics
- Endless upgrades, expansions, and customizations

---Intro---
-An adventure RPG based on the classic "Chinese Paladin"
-"Chinese Paladin" debuted in 1995 on PC and instantly became a classic. Over the years, over 20 related games and 7 TV adaptations have been released. Play this game to relive beloved storylines and characters. Veteran players can relive memorable moments, while new players can experience the enchanting world and swords and immortals.
---Features---
-Authentic Xianxia Worldview-
In "Chinese Paladin," you will find elegant Chinese fantasy design, detailed character portrayals, and heart-stirring plot. Relive the first prominent Xianxia RPG and experience the most authentic world of immortals.
-Interactive Story and Stunning Visuals-
Embark on a mysterious journey, encounter magical beings and experience love and hatred in the world of immortals. From the tranquil town of Yuhang to the enigmatic lands of Hmong, travel in mesmerizing and immersive scenery.
-Strategic Adventure RPG-
Strategize your team comp with a unique character development system and discover hidden combat formations. Revisit the Yuhang Inn, reveal hidden quests, and unveil untold stories of the Three Realms, with numerous Easter eggs scattered throughout waiting for you to discover.
-Adventure with Friends-
Embark together on a journey with fellow adventurers. Forge bonds with like-minded partners, joining the Golden Orchid Feast to invite heroes from all corners to witness blood oaths, and engage in real-time sparring on your journey!
-Abundant Rewards for F2P Players-
Start now and get 100 free draws! Draw powerful five-star heroes with ease! Join activities with generous rewards and freely select numerous characters! You can also save up resources for a week without any pressure to spend!

bluejetty:00001658:android.description:
📱Service Freezer (Root) is a utility app designed to help advanced users manage installed apps and services on rooted Android devices. The app allows you to freeze selected services or packages to reduce background activity and improve device control.
The app works with most rooted Android devices, including Samsung, Sony, LG, Xiaomi, Oppo, HTC, and more.
🔑 Main Features
✔Freeze services or packages
freeze selected installed apps, preinstalled apps, or system services (root access required).
✔Custom bloatware list
Create and manage your own list by marking packages as bloatware or non-bloatware.
✔Package management tools
View detailed information, launch apps, or uninstall packages.
✔Clear cached data of app
Remove cached data of selected applications.
✔Biometric authentication
Optional fingerprint/biometric lock for app access.
⚠️ Important Notes
- Only freeze services or packages if you clearly understand their function. Disabling essential system components may cause unexpected behavior.
- Before installing Android system updates (OTA), make sure all frozen services and packages are re-enabled.
- Please back up your device and important data before using this app.
- Root access is required for freezing functionality. Rooting may affect device security or warranty. This app does not encourage or guide users to root their devices.
- We do not collect personal data. The app only uses Google Crashlytics and Google Analytics to collect anonymous crash and performance information for stability improvements.
📩 Support
We value your feedback.
If you have questions, issues, or suggestions, please contact us at:
📧 kunkunsoft@gmail.com

bluejetty:00016493:ios.description:
Ready for a mind-bending, relaxing, and addictive challenge? Welcome to Guess The Pictures - Logo Quiz, the perfect picture trivia game for family fun, brain training, and endless entertainment! This exciting picture guessing game will put your puzzle-solving skills to the test while keeping you engaged for hours. Designed for players of all ages, this game offers multiple levels of challenges, from word puzzles to guess the logo trivia, ensuring that every member of the family can enjoy and participate.
Try Guess the Pictures – Logo Quiz Today!
Solve Picture Puzzle
Do you love brain teasers? Get ready to sharpen your thinking with our unique image word puzzle challenges! In this picture quiz, you’ll be shown two pictures that you need to combine to form a word. For example, you might see an image of a basketball and a ball — the answer? Basketball! These puzzles are a fantastic way to keep your mind sharp and improve your creativity. With hundreds of combinations, the possibilities are endless, and so is the fun!
Picture Trivia
Challenge yourself to a match-making game with a twist! In this picture quiz mode, you’ll see a picture and must form a word by selecting the correct letters from a given set. This feature allows for both mental exercise and relaxing gameplay, making it perfect for unwinding while still giving your brain a workout.
Guess the Logo
Think you know brands? Prove it! Test your knowledge of global brands with our Guess the Logo challenge. Logos from famous companies will be presented, and it’s your job to guess the brand name. It’s a fun way to see how well you recognize your favorite companies!
Guess the Animal
Calling all animal lovers! In this picture guessing mode, you’ll need to guess the name of various animals based on their pictures. From the common cat to the majestic lion, this picture quiz challenge will appeal to both kids and adults alike.
Can You Guess Whats the Word?
Each level is a new puzzle where the challenge is to guess what the pictures represent. With thousands of combinations, you’ll never run out of fun and tricky challenges!
Multiple Levels and Hints
Don’t worry if you get stuck! Unlike other guess the picture games, this image word puzzle offers hints to help you along the way. But here’s the catch: the fewer hints you use, the more levels you’ll unlock! So, challenge yourself to use as few hints as possible and reap the rewards.
Train your brain, relax, and have fun with this image word puzzle—the ultimate picture guessing game for the entire family! Download Guess the Pictures – Logo Quiz now and start guessing!
Perfect picture trivia game for all ages.
Music in video Credit: "Royalty Free Music from Bensound"

bluejetty:00126683:ios.description:
Discover in just one minute whether you see colors the way most people do.
Color Blindness Checker is a fast self-test of your color vision based on classic pseudoisochromatic plates (Ishihara style). A handful of plates, direct feedback and a clear explanation in plain language - no medical jargon.
HOW IT WORKS
* Look at a plate and tap the number (or "Nothing") you see
* See immediately whether your answer was right
* Finish with a clear conclusion and an explanation of your type of color vision
WHAT'S INSIDE
* A color blindness test you complete in about a minute
* Clear explanations: normal color vision, or signs of red-green or blue-yellow deficiency
* Information about the most common types: protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia
* Photo simulation: see how people with color blindness may perceive your own photos
* A shareable result card to compare with friends and family
* No account and no sign-up - the test runs entirely on your device
* Available in 11 languages
PRIVACY
Your answers and photos stay on your phone. Nothing is uploaded to a server.
PLEASE NOTE
Screens differ in how they display colors, so the accuracy of this self-test is limited. This app is meant for entertainment and self-discovery and is NOT a medical diagnostic tool. For a real diagnosis, consult an eye care professional.

bluejetty:00021276:ios.description:
Are you trying to buy a new car? Or want to buy or sell a used car? 
CarWale app is one of the top rated car apps in India for new and used car research. Today, finding a suitable car for your needs can be exhausting with a multitude of options available. 
CarWale app, answers all your car related queries online. At CarWale, we work towards simplifying your car buying journey by providing accurate on road prices of cars, genuine user and expert reviews, option to book test drives with nearest dealers. You can also compare different cars with the car comparison tool. This app also helps you to connect with your nearest car dealers for the best offers available.
If you are looking to buy second hand cars, this app provides more than 50,000 verified used car listings from genuine sellers. You can also sell your second hand car in just a few steps and know the right price for your car with the car valuation tool.
Features of the CarWale App:
• On road car price – Get accurate and up to date ex-showroom, on road price and price breakups for all cars sold in India of brands such as Maruti Suzuki, Ford, MG, Kia, Honda, Hyundai, Renault, Tata, Toyota, Mahindra, Nissan, Datsun, Audi, Mercedes-Benz, BMW and so on
• Car features and specs - Up to date features and specifications (such as mileage, seating capacity, transmission type, etc.) of cars including the most recent launches
• Compare Cars - Best car comparison app for comparing prices, features, specifications and colours
• Customer Review of cars - 10,000+ user reviews to help you make the right choice. Write review on your cars and get a chance to win amazing vouchers and get featured on our platform
• Expert Reviews - 5000+ video reviews of cars by industry experts
• CarWale Advantage – Get incredible offers in car service from Authorised Service Centers, insurance, car care, accessories, tyres and more
• Buy or sell old cars - 50,000+ used cars listed for sale across various cities in India. Buy second hand cars from a wide array of listings from genuine and top rated sellers. List your second hand car for sale with a few simple steps and get connected with genuine buyers
• Car News - Latest domestic and international car news including a special section for upcoming cars in India. Stay updated with all the latest events in the Automobile Industry in India such as Auto Expo 2018 and Track Day 2019. Share your favourite car news with friends and families
• Used Car Valuation - Check the right market price for used cars in different cities
• New and used car dealers - Locate dealers in your city/area
• Car photos, videos - Experience car features including 360 degree view, interior/exterior views of popular cars
• Feedback – If you have any car related queries or want to give us suggestions to improve your car buy or sell experience, write to us using the feedback option
• Share Car - Share your shortlisted cars and content with your friends
• Luxury Cars - For the car enthusiast in you, we have up to date information on luxury cars
Download now, and experience the new way of doing car research.
We value your feedback. Write to us on contact@carwale.com.
Website - https://www.carwale.com/

bluejetty:00174953:ios.description:
PicMonkey is a photo editor, design maker, sticker maker, collage maker, ad maker, and background eraser, all rolled into one. 
CREATE STUNNING DESIGNS
• Make a photo into a design or start with a blank canvas and add graphics and text to it.
• Make Facebook post designs, ads, banners, quote posts, flyers, collages 
• Draw, erase, and adjust transparency on everything, including graphic stickers (overlays)
• Add your own photos or graphics to a background. When you add your logo, it keeps its transparency
• Tons of graphics to choose from, and fonts galore.
EDIT YOUR PHOTOS
• Elevate your photos with classic photo editor effects like B&W, Orton, Pixelate, Soften.
• Juice the color with photo filters like ColorAmp, Tint, Ombre.
• Get oldie looks with effects like Instafilm, Seventies, Light Leaks.
• New effects are added all the time! You can paint them onto a specific area or apply them to the whole image.
• Use our background eraser to instantly remove pixels around a photo subject.
• Have fun doodling over your photos with Draw.
• Crop photos and resize them—we have all the sizes.
STICKER MAKER/BACKGROUND ERASER
Work wonders with our insanely easy Background Remover—one tap and the pixels around your photo subject are GONE. Use it for product shots or to put people in front of different backgrounds. And you can make stickers with it, too.
ADD TEXT TO PHOTOS
• Add curved text and drop shadows, and adjust them to perfection 
• Adjust letter spacing and line height
• Tons of fonts to choose from
• Match any color in your design or photo with the eyedropper tool
• Get an exact color using hex code, RGB code, or the color wheel
TOUCH UP YOUR PORTRAITS
Touch up photos on the quick with the Presto automatic adjustment or use our other tools to adjust complexions, fix blemishes, create dramatic contours, and brighten eyes and teeth (in-app purchase).
BLOW UP YOUR SOCIAL CHANNELS
• Create social posts by starting with a blank canvas or a photo. We have all the sizes—YouTube, Pinterest, Facebook, Instagram, • and more.• 
• Design banners and cover images, edit profile pics, and ads for social.
• Share directly to Instagram; choose Story or post.
MAKE GORGEOUS COLLAGES
Start with a colored background and add your own photos as graphic stickers. Make 'em grid-like or go free-form. Add text and graphic flourishes. 
BOOST YOUR BIZNAZZ 
Create banners, profile images, and store icons. 
Make product shots perfect with our background eraser tool —no need to use expensive photo setups. We've got all the Etsy sizes and it's easy to crop for the other online shops. 
WHAT OUR USERS ARE SAYING:
"So easy! I have zero professional background but I love to create. This just makes it so so easy. The app and online editor work so well together. I would highly recommend! "—LizS42
CONTACT US: FOLLOW, LIKE, SHARE

Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/PicMonkeyapp

https://www.picmonkey.com/legal 
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Touch Up is free if you have a Basic or Pro subscription. Just log in, via the gear icon in the upper left corner of the app. Or you can buy it as a one-time purchase in-app.
- *Basic/Monthly* — Adds 1 GB of storage for images and full access on Desktop. Auto-renews monthly.
- *Basic/Annual* — Adds 1GB of storage for images and full access on Desktop. Auto-renews annually.

bluejetty:00096615:ios.summary: Discover the true value of your antiques with AntiqSnap – from ceramics and glassware to furniture, silverware, jewelry, and other antiques and collectibles. Explore inherited keepsakes, flea-market finds, and the stories behind your collec
bluejetty:00096615:ios.description:
Discover the true value of your antiques with AntiqSnap – from ceramics and glassware to furniture, silverware, jewelry, and other antiques and collectibles. Explore inherited keepsakes, flea-market finds, and the stories behind your collection. Simply snap a photo to identify your find, explore its estimated market value and rarity, and save it to your digital collection.
Whether you are a beginner who just inherited an antique, a collector building an archive, or a reseller looking for quick valuations, AntiqSnap is your all-in-one companion.
What can AntiqSnap do?
- Discover What It’s Worth – Get an estimated market value for a flea-market find, an inherited keepsake, or a piece in your collection. Put its potential worth in perspective before you decide what to keep, research, buy, or sell.
- Instant Identification – Turn an unfamiliar object into a discovery with one quick scan. Explore its possible origin, age, materials, and history to better understand what you have.
- Uncover Hidden Rarity – Is your find a familiar collectible or something more unusual? Explore its potential rarity and learn what might make it stand out to collectors.
- Keep Your Personal Archive Together – Save your scans and identification details so you can return to them anytime. Track your collection’s estimated total value and keep a record as your collection grows.
- Grow Your Collecting Knowledge – Explore antique stories, practical collecting tips, and beginner guides. Learn what to look for on your next treasure hunt and see familiar objects with fresh eyes.
Why Choose AntiqSnap?
- Be Better Informed — Bring an item’s identity, estimated value, and rarity into focus, giving you a starting point for your next decision.
- Start in Seconds — Simply take a photo to begin exploring, whether you are at an estate sale, browsing a thrift store, or sorting through family belongings.
- Discover the Story — Look beyond the price tag and explore the history and details that make an object interesting to own.
- Enjoy Your Collection — Keep your discoveries in one place, revisit your favorite finds, and watch your collection grow.
Premium Subscription
Upgrade to Premium for unlimited identifications, exclusive market insights, and priority support.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off in iTunes settings
Privacy Policy: https://app-service.antiqueworthai.com/static/privacy_policy.html
Terms of Use: https://app-service.antiqueworthai.com/static/user_agreement_20210224.html

Cub: Your self-care pet for mental health, focus, and daily habits.
Cub is your friendly companion designed to help you stay focused, build healthy routines, and manage daily tasks—all with the support of an interactive pet by your side.
Whether you're working through ADHD challenges, building new habits, or simply looking for a calming way to organize your day, Cub makes the journey feel fun and encouraging.
FEATURES:
Interactive Self-Care Pet
Stay motivated and supported by your pet Cub. The more you take care of yourself, the more your Cub thrives.
Habit Tracker & Daily Planner
Build routines, check off tasks, and track your progress in a visual, rewarding way.
Focus Tools for ADHD & Productivity
Use built-in tools like Pomodoro timers, gentle reminders, and structured planning to stay on task and reduce distractions.
Mood & Reflection Log
Track how you're feeling, celebrate small wins, and reflect on your day to improve emotional wellness and self-awareness.
Custom Reminders
Set personalized reminders for your goals, habits, or wellness check-ins—your Cub’s got your back.
Wellness Modules
Learn bite-sized strategies for anxiety, time management, and self-improvement inside Cub’s learning hub.
Cub helps you feel less overwhelmed and more in control—like a soft reset for your day. It's a habit tracker, mental health companion, and daily focus tool wrapped into one caring experience.
Start building better habits, improving focus, and taking care of your mental health—with Cub by your side.

bluejetty:00088013:ios.summary: Explore British royal history like never before with the Royal History Quiz! Whether you are a history enthusiast or curious learner, our quiz is a fun way to test your knowledge of the past. Dive into a wide range of quizzes that cover all
bluejetty:00088013:ios.description:
Explore British royal history like never before with the Royal History Quiz! Whether you are a history enthusiast or curious learner, our quiz is a fun way to test your knowledge of the past. Dive into a wide range of quizzes that cover all aspects of royal history, from the lives of monarchs and their courts to the architectural marvels and significant events that shaped British heritage. With regularly updated quizzes and new topics, there is always something new to discover. 
Features
Assorted Topics: Covering all eras and subjects; discover the secrets of the world-famous Tower of London, the notorious reign of Henry VIII, fascinating royal dining habits, and much more. 
Historical Accuracy: Questions backed by reliable sources and rich explanations given for each answer. 
Question Types: Quizzes include multiple choice, true or false, fill-in-the-blank, and chronological sort questions. 
Track Progress: Earn points to level up, win achievements, and climb the leaderboard. 
Challenge Friends: Compete in head-to-head matches against friends or foes and share your victories. 
Time Limited Quizzes: Keep an eye out for seasonal and limited time quizzes; turn on your notifications so that you don’t miss a thing. 
Do you have what it takes to climb the ranks at court? Download the Royal History Quiz now! 
About Historic Royal Palaces 
Historic Royal Palaces is a team of people who love and look after six of the most wonderful palaces in the world. We create space for spirits to sit and be stirred. We want everyone to feel welcome and accepted. We tell stories about the monarchs you know and the lives you don’t. We let people explore and we set minds racing. We are a charity, and your support gives the palaces a future, for everyone. 
Learn more about the palaces and the fascinating royal stories behind them at hrp.org.uk 
Privacy notice: https://royalhistoryquiz.hrp.org.uk//info/privacy-notice 
We’d love to hear your feedback. Please contact us at royalhistoryquiz@hrp.org.uk

bluejetty:00098103:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00098103:ios.description:
Ready to challenge your brain and have fun at the same time?
Whether you're a fan of trivia, logic games, or puzzles that make you think, Word Wise delivers a satisfying brain workout in bite-sized levels designed to keep you guessing and engaged.
In WordWise, your task is simple:
You’re given a category—like “Things That Fly” or “Types of Cheese”—and your job is to type the words most people would associate with it. Some levels are easy. Others will make you pause, think, and even second-guess your instincts. How well do you think like the rest of the world?
As you play, you’ll uncover new categories, unlock harder levels, and expand your mental word bank. You’ll improve your vocabulary, sharpen your memory, and train your brain—all without the pressure of a ticking clock.
What Makes WordWise Special?
EXPLORE ENGAGING CATEGORIES
Every level introduces a new category designed to challenge your associations and knowledge. From everyday objects to clever twists, there’s always something new to discover.
ENJOY SATISFYING WORD PLAY
Forget multiple-choice. Just type what comes to mind. The game tracks your guesses and nudges you when you're close, rewarding creative thinking and logic.
CHALLENGE YOURSELF WITH INCREASING DIFFICULTY
As you progress, the puzzles grow more complex, encouraging you to think deeper and expand your vocabulary and perspective.
STAY SHARP WITH A MISTAKE COUNTER
Enjoy a relaxed pace. A mistake limit adds challenge without the stress of timers, keeping focus sharp and gameplay relaxed.
PLAY ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
Online or offline, WordWise is perfect for quick breaks or longer brain workouts.
FOCUS BETTER WITH MINIMALIST DESIGN
Clean and distraction-free, the interface keeps your attention where it matters—on the words.
How well do you know what comes to mind?
Download WordWise today and find out.

Finish Shas in just twenty-three minutes a day!
Welcome to the official app of the "Daf in 23 minutes", the number one Daf shiur in Yiddish. 
Our unique format allows the listener the easily understand and grasp the daily Shiur. Whether you're a scholar or novice, the clarity in which the shiur is given will enhance your Torah learning.
Join the thousands of Lomdim who learn every day a Daf Gamara with the daily Shiur given by Harav Harav Hertzka Greenfeld.
Join the thousands of Yiden who say that their lives have changed with a daily Daf Yomi Shiur.
In addition, you can find here Shiurim on the Parsha and other occasional topics.
This user-friendly App will help you keep up with you daily Shiur.
To get the Shiur on whatsapp, go to www.shiur23.org.
To get the shiurim on telegram, go to https://t.me/dafyomi23
To get the shiurim by email please email: dafyomi23@gmail.com
To listen to the shiurim by phone - 929-533-2323
For any questions, suggestions, or to sponsor a shiur please email us at dafyomi23@gmail.com
This app contains the following additional features:
* Streaming access to listen to Shiurim from anywhere
* Always updated with the latest shiurim- and an archived back catalog
* Playback resume (when interrupted by a call or other distraction)
* See the daf while you listen
* Easy-to-manage downloads and queues
* Chose your speed, from 0.5x to 2x
* Select unplayed Shiurim
* Set an alarm

bluejetty:00037950:ios.description:
Play Word Search Solitaire to unwind and give your brain a great workout!
Dive into the ultimate word puzzle adventure with Word Search Solitaire! Unwind with challenging puzzles as you form words from letter cards, solve bonus goals, and score high points. Keep your brain sharp while enjoying a stress-free, solitaire inspired gameplay experience! 
Word Fun Meets Card Strategy: Combine letter cards to create words and solve puzzles. Experience the ultimate fusion of word games and classic solitaire, packed with challenges that will keep your brain sharp and engaged! 
Train Your Brain: Word Search Solitaire is the ultimate playground for wordsmiths and puzzle solvers! Each level is packed with opportunities to expand your vocabulary, tackle engaging puzzles, and boost your brainpower. 
Sit Back and Chill: Word Search Solitaire combines relaxation and excitement in one game! Enjoy stress-free puzzles, improve your vocabulary, and take a peaceful journey through stunning destinations as you celebrate each victory. 
Word puzzle solving at Its Best: Whether you have a few minutes or some extra time, Word Search Solitaire is your ideal game for quick fun on the go! With simple mechanics and endless entertainment, it’s the perfect way to unwind or pass the time during your break. 
Word Search Solitaire Features
- Boost Your Brainpower: Challenge your mind with word puzzles, conquer engaging challenges, and dive into brainteasers that enhance your vocabulary and IQ! 
- Expand Your Vocabulary: Build your language skills while solving puzzles and creating words from letter cards. Dictionary shows meaning of all valid words made in the game.
- Solitaire Meets Wordplay: Connect letters, match cards to form words, and strategically solve puzzles with a word twist. 
- Relax & Unwind: Enjoy a stress-free experience as you work through fun puzzles, celebrating every win along the way.
- Explore the World: Unlock new words and immerse yourself in stunning environments inspired by global cultures, each level offering unique word challenges. Collect cool stamps and country facts by travelling different countries, all with new wallpapers.
- The Ultimate Word-Card Combo: Pair cards with words in a fun solitaire format, offering a perfect blend of strategy and language learning in a single game. 
Ready to Challenge Your Mind? Test your word skills and boost your brainpower with fun and engaging puzzles! Download Word Search Solitaire now and embark on a journey through stunning landscapes and magical destinations!

bluejetty:00061353:ios.description:
Built to help simplify your work needs, the Workforce Central mobile app (formerly known as Kronos Mobile) provides employees and managers quick, secure access to Workforce Central. 
Employees can punch in/out for work, check their schedules, time off, benefits, and pay. Managers can take care of exceptions as they come up, ensure staffing and schedules are good to go, take action on time off requests, and other and other key needs. 
The Workforce Central mobile app also works offline, so don’t worry if you’re not able to connect to data. Your punches will be stored and the next time you’re connected, the punches will be sent off to Workforce Central. 
If you’re new to the Workforce Central mobile app, come visit our Mobile Resources site to quickly get started: https://community.kronos.com/s/wfc-mobile
Note: Your organization must have UKG Workforce Central configured and mobile enabled. Please reach out to your Workforce Central administrator if you’re having trouble with access.
