bluejetty:00087551:ios.summary: Dr. Prius is an app developed to help professional Toyota/Lexus hybrid repair shop or owners to examine the health of the High Voltage battery. It turns your mobile device into a professional diagnostic equipment that usually cost thousand
bluejetty:00087551:ios.description:
Dr. Prius is an app developed to help professional Toyota/Lexus hybrid repair shop or owners to examine the health of the High Voltage battery. It turns your mobile device into a professional diagnostic equipment that usually cost thousand of dollars, it is being trusted by 351+ professional repair shops around the world.
Dr. Prius perform test and provides access to all the relevant battery information to quickly help identify problems with a simple touch on the screen of a smartphone, do not fall victim to bad battery, test the battery and print the certificate to prove the health of the battery system.
Note: This app requires a ELM327 Bluetooth OBD interface to communicate with your hybrid vehicle, most of the cheap clone ELM327 will not work due to inability to switch between ECUs in your vehicle. Please visit http://PriusApp.com/obd.html for more detail or feel free to email us for any adapter compatibility question.
Some useful features: 
1. Real-time battery monitor with clever charts and numbers.
2. Life expectancy test with proprietary algorithm to find out battery remaining life.
3. Full battery test to run diagnostic on battery system.
4. Print or share test certificate with customer.
5. Read error codes, reset error codes in a breeze.
6. Disable or enable the reverse beep, seat belt beep, adjust battery fan speed and more.
7. Find nearby reputable hybrid repair shop.
Current supported model:
1. 2020 Prius all lineup except 4WD version
2. 2020 Highlander hybrid
3. 2017-2019 Prius Prime Plug-In
4. 2016-2019 Prius Gen4 One, Two, Two Eco, Three(Lithium) and Four(Lithium)
5. 2012-2015 Prius Plug-In
6. 2009-2015 Prius Gen3
7. 2003-2009 Prius Gen2
8. 1997-2003 Prius Gen1 (partial support)
9. Auris
10. Aqua
11. Prius C
12. Camry Hybrid
13. Avalon Hybrid
14. Highlander Hybrid
15. Lexus CT200h
16. Lexus ES300h
17. Lexus HS250h
18. Lexus RX400h
19. Lexus RX450h
20. Lexus GS450h
21. Lexus LS600h
22. Lexus UX250h
23. CHR Hybrid
24. GM hybrid - Chevrolet Tahoe
Any feedback or feature request please reach out to support@PriusApp.com

bluejetty:00065372:ios.description:
Timberland Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Timberland Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Timberland Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Timberland Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00146965:ios.description:
Meet Dayly — the beautiful countdown app for every important day, now with a built-in AI Assistant that creates and updates your countdowns through simple conversation.
Just tell Dayly what you need. "I'm off to Brighton at 9am this Saturday." Done. "Make it half nine." Updated. No menus, no date pickers — your AI Assistant understands natural language, voice input, and casual phrasing the way a friend would.
Add stunning countdown widgets to your Lock Screen, Home Screen, and Dynamic Island. Whether it's a wedding countdown, vacation countdown, birthday countdown, or holiday countdown, every important day stays right where you'll see it.
———————————————
AI ASSISTANT — A NEW WAY TO COUNT DOWN
———————————————
- Create countdowns by typing or speaking, like texting a friend
- Update times with phrases like "make it half nine" or "push it a week"
- Delete events through conversation, no digging through menus
- Voice input for hands-free countdown creation
- Smart parsing of dates, times, and casual language
———————————————
COUNTDOWN TO ANYTHING
———————————————
- Birthday and anniversary countdowns
- Wedding and engagement countdowns
- Vacation, trip, and cruise countdowns
- Holiday countdowns — Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving
- Pregnancy and baby due date countdowns
- Graduation, retirement, and new home countdowns
- Concerts, games, and exam date countdowns
- Work deadlines and personal goal countdowns
———————————————
BEAUTIFUL COUNTDOWN WIDGETS
———————————————
- Lock Screen countdown widgets — see your important day the moment you pick up your phone
- Home Screen countdown widgets in multiple sizes
- Dynamic Island countdown for live activities
- StandBy mode countdown clock
———————————————
POWERFUL COUNTDOWN FEATURES
———————————————
- Count down days, hours, minutes, and seconds to any event
- Count up from past events
- Repeat countdowns — daily, weekly, monthly, yearly
- Smart notifications before the big day
- Import events from your iOS Calendar
- iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
———————————————
MAKE EVERY COUNTDOWN YOURS
———————————————
- Custom backgrounds, colors, and photos
- Beautiful themes and gradients
- Light and dark mode support
———————————————
WHY DAYLY
———————————————
Unlike basic countdown apps, Dayly combines a conversational AI Assistant with beautiful countdown widgets — so creating an event is as simple as saying what's on your mind, and seeing it counted down is as effortless as glancing at your Lock Screen.
———————————————
DAYLY PREMIUM
———————————————
Unlock the full Dayly experience with Premium:
- Unlimited AI Assistant conversations
- All countdown widget styles and themes
- Unlimited backgrounds and customization
- Priority support
Subscription options:

- Lifetime VIP (one-time purchase)

We read every single email. Contact us at fombo888@gmail.com

bluejetty:00147321:ios.description:
Create a new local number and enjoy all the benefits of having it today. With us, you can use your new mobile number for private texting, text chat, contact management, and more. 
Stop giving out your private number to protect privacy, separate work & privacy! 
KEY FEATURES:
- Phone number
You can get a new real phone number with a local area code without an extra SIM. Choose one, two or more numbers - all of them will be available right in the app! A second phone number is a great way to keep your messages and phone calls private and secure. 
- Unlimited Calling & Free Texting
Send unlimited messages, receive and make calls, or share MMS. It's all available now! All calls and texting are cellular, so your second number is just as reliable as your primary number.
- Multiple phone numbers
We allows you to use your phone with unlimited anonymous numbers. This means that you can enjoy multiple phone numbers while keeping your personal number private. It's great for announcements, dating, travel, and business.
More useful things:
- Make international calls
- Identify new callers
- Unlimited call and chat history
- Spam blocking 
- Muting
- Do-not-disturb settings
- Organize and share your contacts
- Manage your number
And a lot more :)
Communication should be without limits. Stay connected to what matters most with unlimited texting and calling. Our app provides an alternate number that works flawlessly on iPhone. It turns your mobile device into a full-featured phone.
*MMS and Area code availability varies
• Privacy Policy: https://pp.2number.co
• Terms of use: https://tou.2number.co

bluejetty:00129045:ios.name: Glucose Tracker - Blood Sugar
bluejetty:00129045:ios.summary: Glucose Tracker - Blood Sugar is a simple yet beautiful app that helps you track your glucose levels, A1C, carbs, blood pressure, medication, and more. This app is specifically designed for people struggling with diabetes, blood pressure, a
bluejetty:00129045:ios.description:
Glucose Tracker - Blood Sugar is a simple yet beautiful app that helps you track your glucose levels, A1C, carbs, blood pressure, medication, and more. This app is specifically designed for people struggling with diabetes, blood pressure, and other health-related issues.
Have you ever wanted an app that tracks all your health and medical readings in one place? Log blood sugar, A1C, carbs, medication, insulin, weight, temperature, blood pressure, SpO2, ketones, and exercise simply and easily. The app also provides you with detailed reports, charts, and statistics to help you manage your diabetes.
Features:
- Track blood sugar, blood pressure, and more
- Unlimited entries
- Add notes to your readings
- Dashboard to see your stats at a glance
- Estimated A1C
- Averages over 7 days, 14 days, 30 days, 60 days, and 90 days
- Chart visualization
- Medication tracking
- Export report in PDF and CSV formats
- Unlimited reminders to log your readings
- The US, metric or mixed unit system support
- Simple user interface
Please note that this app does not measure any medical reading by itself. You need to manually enter the data. The purpose of this app is to track your health data all in one place and help you analyze them to improve your overall health.
Please leave a 5-star rating if you find this app useful. Your support helps us keep improving this app.

ThermoWorks App: The Ultimate Temperature Tracking Companion
Experience how nothing Works like ThermoWorks with ThermoWorks app, a powerful tool for monitoring cooking, BBQ, and ambient temperatures using compatible Bluetooth and Wi-Fi co
bluejetty:00173609:ios.description:
ThermoWorks App: The Ultimate Temperature Tracking Companion
Experience how nothing Works like ThermoWorks with ThermoWorks app, a powerful tool for monitoring cooking, BBQ, and ambient temperatures using compatible Bluetooth and Wi-Fi connected devices. Main features an enhanced interface, simplified setup, improved graphing and checklist capabilities, and easy connection to the Cloud, ThermoWorks app makes temperature tracking a breeze.
Stay Connected and In Control
Set up temperature alarms with push notifications to stay informed. Whether you're a competitive BBQ enthusiast, a professional chef, a dedicated home cook, or a laboratory or warehouse worker, you'll know exactly when to make critical adjustments. All session data, including user notes and saved graphs, is stored in ThermoWorks Cloud for unlimited access and easy review whenever needed. The app also features a checklist function, ensuring that food businesses can meticulously follow safety protocols, making it an essential tool for maintaining high standards in any environment.
Backed by Expertise You Can Trust
ThermoWorks products are trusted by more competitive BBQ teams, celebrity chefs, and food professionals than any other brand. With decades of experience in temperature technology and support from our in-house accredited calibration laboratory, ThermoWorks is your go-to when precision matters.
Compatible Instruments:
RFX: Uses advanced radio frequency technology to connect RFX MEAT wireless meat probe and RFX GATEWAY, providing reliable, real-time temperature monitoring for ultimate control in any cooking environment.
Signals: 4-channel BBQ alarm with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi for versatile, remote temperature monitoring. Works seamlessly with Billows control fan for perfect pit control.
BlueDOT: 1-channel BBQ alarm utilizing Bluetooth, allowing you to set high/low alarms, track min/max temperatures, and save data.
Smoke Gateway: Connects the Smoke 2-channel BBQ alarm to Wi-Fi, sending data directly to ThermoWorks Cloud for remote monitoring and alerts.
ThermaQ Blue: Measures dual thermocouple probes for professional-grade accuracy, ideal for competitive pitmasters and serious cooks.
ThermaQ WiFi: Dual-channel monitoring over Wi-Fi, perfect for commercial kitchens and serious home cooks.
ThermaData WiFi: Logs critical temperature data, stores up to 18,000 readings, and sends alerts for complete peace of mind.
NODE: Monitor temperatures, humidity, and more 24/7 from anywhere with alerts sent directly to your device.
App Requirements:
Compatible device including Signals, BlueDOT, ThermaQ Blue, ThermaQ WiFi, ThermaData WiFi, NODE, Smoke, Smoke Gateway, RFX GATEWAY, or RFX MEAT.
Requires a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network for initial device setup and internet connection for data synchronization

◆Exclusive Companionship: Step by Step into His Heart

◆Intimate Interaction - Immersive Romantic Experience
Trigger exclusive story events and get personal video calls from him! Hear his charming voice, see his everyday gestures, and experience the thrill of romance. Enjoy close interactions, memorable dates, and let your heart flutter with love!

bluejetty:00146659:ios.description:
Schedule text messages and send them automatically through iMessage, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, Line, and Email. Whether it's a birthday wish, a meeting reminder, or a weekly check-in, Scheduled makes sure the right message reaches the right person at the right time.
HOW IT WORKS:
Write your message
1. Pick your contacts
2. Choose when to send — once, recurring, or as a sequence
3. Scheduled delivers it automatically via SMS or notifies you to send through your preferred messenger
PLATFORMS WE SUPPORT:
- iMessage, SMS, and Email (auto-send with iOS Shortcuts)
- WhatsApp, Telegram, and Line
- Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Slack, LinkedIn, and more
KEY FEATURES:
- Auto-send SMS messages directly from your number
- Recurring messages — daily, weekly, monthly, or custom
- Sequences — schedule a series of messages like "Fit in 30 Days" or "Weekly Motivation for a Year"
- Mass text — send to large groups with a personal touch
- Birthday and contact import — pull birthdays from your contacts and never miss one
- iOS Calendar integration — see all your scheduled messages alongside your events
- Multi-recipient and group selection
- Templates and message suggestions
- Repeat, snooze, skip, archive, and delete
PERFECT FOR:
- Staying in touch with friends and family
- Sending birthday and holiday messages on time
- Meeting reminders and team updates at work
- Appointment reminders for clients or patients
- Motivational or community messages on a recurring schedule
- Event announcements and group check-ins
Scheduled is free to download and use. For exclusive features, opt for our Premium or Business subscriptions, priced from $3.99 to $4.99 monthly. Subscriptions renew monthly unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Turn off auto-renew anytime from your iTunes account settings. Refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. Prices may vary outside the United States and charges may be converted to local currency depending on your country of residence.
- Privacy Policy: https://scheduledapp.com/privacy-policy/
- Terms & Conditions: https://scheduledapp.com/terms-conditions/
We hope you love using Scheduled.
The Scheduled Team

bluejetty:00170434:ios.description:
momondo searches hundreds of travel sites to show you your options and let you pick what works best for your trip. Track prices, set a budget, build your itinerary and more.
WHAT’S IN OUR APP.
Get the flight you want: Compare flight options from hundreds of sites then zero in on the best one for you by using our filters.
Hotel rates only on the app: Find mobile-only prices from select hotels.
Car sharing: Search car sharing alongside traditional agencies for more options (and maybe better prices).
Know when prices change: Track search results for your trip and get a notification when prices change.
Search on your budget: Only have $300 to spend? momondo Explore will show you your flight options, on any budget.
ONLY ON THE MOMONDO APP.
Flight tracker: Get alerts when something about your flight changes or track flights so you can see if you’ll make your connection.
Trips offline: All your ticket confirmations and reservations loaded into Trips are accessible regardless of whether or not you have Wifi.
Measure your bag: Direct your camera at your bag or carry on and we’ll let you know if it’s the right size for your flight without incurring a fee.
WE LOVE FEEDBACK.
Got a question and in need of support? Send us a message at https://www.momondo.com/help and we’ll help you out
MORE ON WHAT MOMONDO OFFERS.
Find flights, hotels, vacation rentals, rental cars and more - then filter by what matters to you most. Like a pet-friendly boutique hotel with a pool. Or a 4-door sedan with airport pick-up to get you on your way. We bring together great deals from your favorite travel sites in one place.
SEARCH HUNDREDS OF FLIGHT SITES AT ONCE.

MORE OPTIONS, MORE SAVING.
Find mobile-only rates and exclusive deals on the app. Set Price Alerts to know when prices drop on the flights, cars and hotels you’re interested in.
CREATE ITINERARIES AS YOU PLAN.
Our Trips tool puts all your plans in one place. Get alerted to flight and gate changes, access boarding passes both on- and offline, and share your itinerary with friends – all in one spot. You can sync your inbox or manually add any part of your trip - from tour and restaurant confirmations to notes on things to see.
CAR RENTAL DEALS.
Search from over 70,000 locations to find the perfect rental car. Book risk-free by filtering for free cancellation policies.
GET A HOTEL… OR A HOME.
See your accommodation options from major hotel chains and resorts to local boutiques to apartments, cabins, beach homes and more. Filter for free cancellation if you’re worried plans will change.
Plan your next trip with momondo. Download now to start planning a great trip.

bluejetty:00072987:ios.description:
Pass Your U.S. Citizenship Civics Test with Confidence
Preparing for your U.S. naturalization interview? To become a U.S. citizen, you’ll need to pass the official oral civics test. Under the current standard, the USCIS officer will ask you up to 20 questions from a master pool of 128 civics questions. You must answer at least 12 out of 20 correctly to pass.
Whether you’re just starting out or doing final reviews, this app gives you a simple, stress-free way to master all 128 questions at your own pace.
Key Features
Complete 128-Question Bank: Study every official USCIS question and answer covering American Government, American History, and Integrated Civics.
Category-Based Practice: Focus on one topic at a time so you can build your knowledge step by step.
Realistic Mock Exams: Test your readiness with simulated 20-question practice tests structured just like the real interview.
Bookmark & Review: Save tricky questions with a single tap to revisit them whenever you need extra practice.
Progress Tracking: See your score improvements over time so you know exactly when you're ready for interview day.
Don't leave your citizenship interview to chance. Practice systematically, track your growth, and walk into your USCIS interview fully prepared!

bluejetty:00039154:ios.description:
Всё, что нужно для заботы о здоровье: онлайн-консультации с врачами, быстрая запись на очный приём в 2000+ клиник и умный трекер для бережного достижения ваших целей по улучшению самочувствия.
НАПОПРАВКУ — ЦЕЛАЯ ЭКОСИСТЕМА ДЛЯ ЗДОРОВЬЯ
Мы собрали всё в одном приложении, чтобы забота о здоровье стала простой, доступной и непрерывной привычкой:
- Онлайн-консультации с врачами 24/7.
- Умный трекер здоровья.
- Быстрая запись к врачу, на анализы и диагностику — более 2000 клиник-партнёров.
- Проверенные отзывы реальных пациентов о врачах и клиниках.
ОНЛАЙН-КОНСУЛЬТАЦИИ С ВРАЧАМИ «НАПОПРАВКУ ПЛЮС»
Решайте вопросы в онлайн-чате — быстро, без поездок и очередей:
- Терапевт и педиатр — круглосуточно, а также 25+ узких специалистов (гинеколог, дерматолог, невролог и др.).
- Месяц подписки для всей семьи (до 5 человек) стоит меньше, чем один визит в клинику.
- Конфиденциально и комфортно для самых деликатных вопросов.
Что можно обсудить с врачом онлайн:
- Расшифровать анализы и результаты МРТ/УЗИ.
- Проконсультироваться по лечению и симптомам.
- Получить рекомендации по ЗОЖ и ведению беременности.
- Здоровье взрослых и детей.
БЫСТРАЯ ЗАПИСЬ НА ОЧНЫЙ ПРИЁМ: К ВРАЧУ, НА АНАЛИЗЫ И ДИАГНОСТИКУ
Найдите лучшего специалиста или клинику — сэкономьте время и деньги.
Как это работает:
- Введите специальность или услугу (например, "МРТ колена").
- Сравните свободные окна, цены и реальные отзывы пациентов.
- Запишитесь онлайн на удобное время, без комиссии.
Почему это выгодно:
- Широкий выбор: более 50 000 врачей, более 2 000+ клиник, включая госучреждения.
- Надёжность: мы тщательно проверяем отзывы и не манипулируем рейтингами.
- Скидки и кэшбэк: уникальные предложения от клиник и баллы за запись, которые можно обменять на 500 рублей.
УМНЫЙ ТРЕКЕР ЗДОРОВЬЯ — ВАШ ПЕРСОНАЛЬНЫЙ ПОМОЩНИК
Устали от универсальных советов, которые не работают? Мы создали умный трекер здоровья, который бережно приведёт вас к цели. Разработан вместе с врачами и усилен AI — он учитывает ваш ритм, привычки и предпочтения, чтобы меняться было просто и устойчиво.
Выберите свою цель — и получите план, который реально работает:
- Снижение веса без жёстких диет
- Устойчивость к стрессу и контроль эмоций
- Глубокий сон и восстановление энергии
- Уровень энергии и общее самочувствие
- Улучшение внешнего вида и формы
- Контроль хронических заболеваний
- Восстановление после родов
- Укрепление иммунитета
- Снижение потребления алкоголя
Подключите интеграцию с HealthConnect, чтобы получать более точные отчёты и рекомендации с учётом таких показателей, как: активные калории, расстояние, тренировки, пройденные этажи, шаги, скорость, частота дыхания, процент жира в организме, вес, сон, vo2 max, пульс, вариабельность сердечного ритма, насыщение крови кислородом, пульс в состоянии покоя, осознанность.
Загрузите историю данных о здоровье и разрешите фоновую передачу данных, чтобы получать самые актуальные рекомендации.
Всё, что нужно, — в одном месте:
- Дневники здоровья: отслеживайте питание, настроение, сон и другое.
- Распознавание еды и подсчёт калорий по фото.
- Интеграция с HealthConnect.
- Персональные рецепты из любимых продуктов.
Всё для вашего здоровья уже в приложении НаПоправку! Скачайте и начните свой путь к лучшему самочувствию сегодня.

bluejetty:00145522:ios.name: City.Play
bluejetty:00145522:ios.summary:
Unlock the hidden truth of your performance and develop your football skills the City way. 
CITYPLAY hands you the numbers to your game, measuring your technical and physical performance as you play. Powered by the technology of Playermake
bluejetty:00145522:ios.description:
Unlock the hidden truth of your performance and develop your football skills the City way. 
CITYPLAY hands you the numbers to your game, measuring your technical and physical performance as you play. Powered by the technology of Playermaker and the football philosophy of Manchester City, CITYPLAY gives you the keys to your football journey. 
Advancements in sports technologies and AI methodologies have enabled the tracking of footballers' on-pitch actions. Playermaker has developed a wearable foot-mounted performance tracker device that captures athlete data from the source of motion using smart sensors. After any type of training session or match, indoors or outdoors, players are able to connect to the CITYPLAY app on their mobile and sync their data. 
* Monitor your progress: Track and analyse every training session and match you play. Improve your technical and physical skills within 3 months, using the CITYPLAY app. 
* Measure and Compare Training and Game Performances: Compare your stats and performance level with others.  
* Level up your game: Exclusive access to training videos and personalised advice developed by Manchester City from their training philosophy.
It is all about taking ownership of your own skill development and success. The CITYPLAY app will allow you to hit your goals from game to game, measuring the skills critical for talent development and identification: 
· First Touch: The ability to receive and control the ball with both feet, at different speeds and in different directions
· Dribbling: The ability to move with and manipulate the ball with both feet at different speeds and directions 
· Two Footed: The ability to use both feet for various interactions with the ball 
· Speed: The ability to run fast 
· Agility: The ability to respond to game actions fast through quick turns or changes in pace 
CITYPLAY - the future of football starts now

bluejetty:00163616:ios.name: Doctor Care Anywhere
bluejetty:00163616:ios.summary: Doctor Care Anywhere is a private digital health service founded by doctors, providing you and your family with the confidence and reassurance to manage your health, no matter where you are or when you need us. Our team of UK-qualified regi
bluejetty:00163616:ios.description:
Doctor Care Anywhere is a private digital health service founded by doctors, providing you and your family with the confidence and reassurance to manage your health, no matter where you are or when you need us. Our team of UK-qualified registered doctors and Advanced Clinical Practitioners are available for video and phone appointments at a time that suits you. Additionally, we offer a prescription delivery service, instant referrals, 24/7 secure access to your medical records, and more. We empower you to take control of your health by putting you in charge of your healthcare needs.
Appointment times to suit you
You can book an appointment with Doctor Care Anywhere easily by logging in to our platform through your device. Our service is available 24/7, 365 days a year, so you can find a time that works for you and book your appointment instantly. We understand that your time is valuable, which is why we make it easy for you to see a doctor or Advanced Clinical Practitioner at a time that suits you.
Our Clinical team
Doctor Care Anywhere offers you the ability to choose your preferred clinician from our team of UK-registered doctors and Advanced Nurse Practitioners. You can search for a clinician based on their area of expertise, their name if you have seen them before, or their gender if you prefer to speak to a male or female clinician. All our clinicians are UK-registered with either the General Medical Council (GMC) or Nursing and Midwifery Council ( NMC). They are also specially trained in virtual consultation skills, ensuring that you receive the highest quality of care during your consultation. 
Same day medication
You can have your prescription medicine delivered to your door or get it sent to your nearest local UK pharmacy for you to pick up at a time that suits you.
Instant referrals
Following a thorough consultation, if appropriate, the clinician will write you an instant referral and email you to let you know it has been stored securely on your patient record. You can then download this to share with your specialist or insurer.
24/7 secure access to your patient record
You can access your patient record at any time, update it as necessary and use it to download notes and referrals for future consultations. We can also share your notes with your NHS GP with your consent.
What our patients say
"The advice from the GP was excellent and thorough and the whole service is refreshingly immediate. I have already recommended it to friends and family and will continue to do so."
Charlie from Fulham
"I’m delighted my days of stuffy waiting rooms are over! I was able to make an appointment really quickly and easily with a doctor who really took the time to answer my questions fully and gave really informed and relevant advice."
Lucy from Surrey
"Doctor Care Anywhere has changed the way I view GP medical care from both a personal and professional perspective. Their online service is incredibly easy to use yet still maintains the highest level of personal care and privacy."
Lara from Warwickshire
“There are times when it can be difficult to get to the doctor, especially for parents juggling home, work and small children. Having access to Doctor Care Anywhere, a service that allows you to consult with a doctor online or over the phone seven days a week is both handy and helpful, at the times when you need it most."
Justine Roberts, CEO Mumsnet

bluejetty:00177531:ios.description:
PokerAtlas is the world's largest source of information and player reviews on legal poker rooms in the US, Canada, and beyond. 
Find every room, cash game, and tournament near you, or anywhere you're headed, with real details, real reviews, and real-time info. 
DISCOVER THE ACTION 
• Discover poker and card rooms near you or anywhere you travel 
• Browse 50,000+ cash game and tournament listings 
• Search upcoming tournaments and major poker series 
• Get room details, directions, contact information, amenities, and more 
REAL-TIME INFORMATION 
At more than 200 poker rooms powered by PokerAtlas TableCaptain®: 
• View live cash game and waitlist information 
• Join poker room waitlists and register for tournaments 
• Follow live tournament clocks, standings, and player chip counts 
• Access your Digital Player Cards and poker room account balances 
PLAN YOUR POKER 
• Favorite poker rooms, cash games, tournaments, and events 
• Build your personal tournament schedule 
• Set reminders and notifications so you don't miss the action 
• See announcements and updates published directly by poker rooms 
CONNECT WITH THE POKER COMMUNITY 
• Read reviews from other poker players 
• Rate and review poker rooms 
• Ask questions and share feedback in TableTalk 
• Check in and share your poker experiences 
GET MORE WITH POKERATLAS PRO 
PokerAtlas PRO unlocks premium features and exclusive access to Valuetown™, Poker's Member Rewards Marketplace, appropriately dubbed “Poker's Biggest Overlay, on and off the tables.” Valuetown is packed with tournament discounts, cash game promotions, and exclusive deals designed to give PRO members tremendous value at poker rooms and beyond. 
With PRO, you get:
• A dedicated view of just your favorite rooms and tournaments 
• Real-time counts of running games 
• Reminders and calendar sync for your tournaments 
• A premium avatar and personalized alias 
• Note-taking on your tournament opponents 
Find your game. Join the action. 
PokerAtlas uses your location to provide relevant poker room information and notifications based on your preferences. Location information may be collected while the app is running in the background to support location-based features and improve your PokerAtlas experience.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

It’s EASY to use, SECURE, AFFORDABLE for all,
bluejetty:00146562:ios.description:
PaySii app is designed and built to give you the best in class customer experience. Download the app today for free and love it as you support your business, family, friends and your loved one.
It’s EASY to use, SECURE, AFFORDABLE for all, delivers super-FAST through MMT’s, Bank deposits, Airtime top ups worldwide and makes your transfer instantly available for collection for those of you who prefer cash collection.
Features & benefits
Simple registration
- Easy registration steps
- Simplified account verification
- Easy and gradual ID verification
How to send money
- Select send to country
- Enter amount
- Confirm the offer
- Enter recipient or select existing one
- Pay and follow up the status of your transfer
Transparent
- No hidden fees
- Requires your agreement on each transaction
Fast delivery
- Instant delivery to following services;
- Mobile money wallets
- Bank accounts
- Cash collection - available to collect.
- Mobile top up worldwide
Convenient to use
- Send money at your fingertips anytime anywhere.
- Affordable for everyone
- No fees for first two transfers
- Lowest fee in the market
Secure to use
- Secure login with pin or biometrics
- Money remains client account until delivered
- No delivery no fee basis applies
- Follow up your transaction to see the status
Excellent customer support
- Responsive customer support available 24/7
Wallet service
- SafariPay Corp. DBA PaySii has partnered with AVENU, a division of FDIC-insured MainStreet Bank, to offer the current customers the option of opening a digital bank account also known as PaySii Wallet. The customer, if approved, would have the option to use such a wallet to pay for its remittance/transaction, and/or make other (digital) payments to other compatible devices, granted there are funds available. These funds can be added to the wallet using debit or ACH mechanisms from the customers’ own bank account. The wallet will be under the control of Avenu.
- This product is only available in the continental United States to those of legal age that meet the requirements stated in the Terms of Condition.
- To a degree, some customers’ information (such as name, address, identifiable information, and other) will be shared with AVENU for our everyday business purposes such as to process your transactions and maintain your account(s). For any customer assistance or support, PaySii will be the primary point of contact, and if needed, the customer might be referred to the AVENU hotline.
Travel service
- Paysii has been linked to travel service that provides flight, hotel and other bundles booking for Paysii customers. The service is currently hosted at TaamTravel and is owned and managed by AfroAtlas (afroatlas.com). AfroAtlas will manage the complete booking follow (reservation and payments). AfroAtlas uses separate payment processor for customer bookings. Once the customer clicks on the Travel link/button on the app/web, he/she will be redirected to the TaamTravel booking site.
- The customer will be shown the following disclaimer message and will be given the option to be redirected to TaamTravel or to stay in Paysii. 
- Disclaimer: You are now leaving PaySii and are going to a third-party website. PaySii makes no claims or warranty regarding the accuracy of the information contained in this site. If you have any questions or concerns about the products and services offered, please contact the third party directly. You are being redirected to: TaamTravel 
- No Paysii customers information (profile and payment) will be shared with AfroAtlas. AfroAtlas customer support information is published at the bottom of the travel site TaamTravel . If the customers contact Paysii support for travel related issues, we should forward them to AfroAtlas support.
-Here is the support information.
Address: 14th Floor, Real Towers | Hospital Road, 0001 - Nairobi.
Telephone: (+254) 702 444999
WhatsApp: (+254) 702 444999
Email: info@taamtravel.com

bluejetty:00071048:ios.summary:
Turn your device into a Teleprompter for free... Teleprompter is the best free teleprompter app used by creators and studios including Netflix, ABC, CBS, BBC, Fox, ITV, Channel 4, UKTV and many more. 
Engineered for real-world reliability,
bluejetty:00071048:ios.description:
Turn your device into a Teleprompter for free... Teleprompter is the best free teleprompter app used by creators and studios including Netflix, ABC, CBS, BBC, Fox, ITV, Channel 4, UKTV and many more. 
Engineered for real-world reliability, Teleprompter is packed with everything you'll need for your content, production or presentation.
Available for Free:
• Compose, create, and manage unlimited scripts with NO character or length limits
• Adjust text size, font, and colour to suit your setup
• Import (up to 5) documents in Word, PDF, .txt, and .rtf formats from any app
• Record videos using your device camera while reading from the Teleprompter
• Save recorded videos directly to Photos or share to apps like Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok
• Apply real-time video effects (Virtual Backgrounds, portrait mode)
• Scripts scroll smoothly with easy speed control 
• Scroll up to 120Hz on ProMotion devices
• Use any font installed on your device for your teleprompter scripts
• Basic control options from connected keyboards and controllers
• Export and share scripts easily, or save as backup files
• Add cue points to jump to specific parts of your script
• Add a countdown timer before scrolling begins
• Re-arrange scripts by title, date, or custom order
• AirDrop scripts to nearby devices
• (Optional) Synchronise your scripts across all your devices automatically via cloud sync
• Use Timed Scrolling to scroll your script over a set duration
• Display elapsed and remaining time based on scroll speed
• Display a reading guide arrow or line with customisable style and position
• Set custom default settings (font, colour, layout) for new and imported scripts
• Display your scripts full screen by hiding the controls while scrolling
• Set a custom background colour behind your script
• Adjust side margins to reduce eye movement or fit beam splitter glass
• Select between "Continuous" or "Paging" scroll modes
• Use the Teleprompter while participating in video meetings (e.g., Zoom or Google Meet)
• Use Slide Over or Split View on iPad to multitask with other apps
Extra features available with the optional Pro upgrade:
• Import unlimited documents in Word, PDF, .txt, and .rtf formats from any app
• Mirror or reverse the text for use in professional on-camera Teleprompter rigs
• Control the Teleprompter from any web browser on the same WiFi network
• Use other nearby iOS devices to monitor and control scrolling and speed via Bluetooth
• Control the Teleprompter remotely using keyboard, handheld remote, foot pedal, or gaming controller (including PlayStation and Xbox)
• Customisable button/key assignments for remote controls and keyboards
• Use Apple Watch to control the scrolling of your script on iPhone
• Use the IKAN Elite Remote for scrolling control
• Display your script full screen on a connected display or AirPlay TV, with optional independent mirroring
• Use the built-in script editor to format text with rich text features like bold, italic, underline, and text colour
• Export scripts as Rich Text (.rtf) files for editing on other devices
• Connect via HDMI or AirPlay to external displays with "clean feed"
• Automatically generate '.srt' captions and subtitles for your videos
• Retrieve backups of your recordings from the cloud
Designed to be the best free Teleprompter app with mirroring.
Teleprompter is designed for presentations, lectures, broadcasters, filmmakers, musicians & singers, business professionals, or any public speaking!
Pro Upgrade Purchase:
The Teleprompter Pro upgrade is available as a one-time in-app purchase forever, or as a subscription. If you chose to subscribe (optional), you can cancel anytime within the app, or from your Apple ID account settings.
Terms: https://teleprompterpro.com/terms
Privacy: https://teleprompterpro.com/privacy

bluejetty:00119465:ios.description:
Want professional-grade photo editing at your fingertips? There’s no training needed! 
Pixomatic will help you elevate your images and create captivating compositions with a full range of photo-editing features. Explore endless options through available tools like: background and objects removal, clipping out shapes, сropping, text, filters, photo merging, adding logos or watermarks, and more. You’ll be able to remix and reimagine your pics like the professionals with our digital photo editing app. Explore endless options through available tools like:
- REMOVE BACKGROUND -
Clip out objects of any shape – no matter the complexity. Try the revolutionary Magic Cut tool. It identifies objects in your photos and automatically separates them from their backgrounds. Curly hair? No problem! 
- ERASE OBJECTS -
Say goodbye to photo distractions! Use the Heal Tool to remove unwanted objects from photo backgrounds–even photobombers! Customize stock images with instant watermark removal, or use the magic object eraser for instant, AI-powered object selection and removal. 
- BLUR BACKGROUND -
Wish you could shift the perspective of your photos? Create focused image effects for your pics with our Blur Background tool, or get creative with blur effects using our manual blur wand on faces and other photo objects. 
- FILTERS AND EFFECTS -
Set the mood! Have different looks for different social networks? Choose from 100+ filters and 300+ effects for the look and feel you want.
- CUSTOMIZABLE TEMPLATES -
Make the most of customizable photo templates available in 1000s of themes. Whether you want to create an artsy collage, a new profile pic, or hilarious meme, you can choose from tons of different photo templates for any occasion. Simply add your photo to a selected template, and save!
- PHOTO BLENDER -
Want the best parts of multiple photos? Merge them! Using multiple layers, you can play with colors, textures, and opacity. The simplest edits can change the style or shift the mood. The only rule here is to have fun and enjoy the creative process.
- FACE TUNE -
Show your best face: Smooth skin, white teeth, and no red eyes. Selfies and portraits will show the real you – only slightly improved.
- TEXT -
Classic or modern? Your choice! Choose from a vast collection of fonts for all occasions to convey the message you desire. 
- ADJUST TOOL -
A perfectionist’s paradise: Add finishing touches manually to get the exact contrast, exposure, shades, and color depth that you want.
- VARIETY OF FORMATS -
Work with both JPEG and PNG formats. Mix them if necessary to create custom works of photo art.
- SHARING TO INSTA, FACEBOOK, TWITTER, ETC.-
Share directly to your favorite social media platforms. Your following will no-doubt notice your cool, modern content – whether it’s for personal or professional purposes.
Be on trend. Be different. And always be creative.
Become a Premium member to unlock all of the features.
* Subscription payments will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of your purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew and you will be charged unless auto-renew is turned off or unless you cancel at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription or trial period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period. The cost of renewal depends on the Subscription Plan you choose. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase or by contacting Customer Support.
Privacy Policy: https://support.bendingspoons.com/privacy.html?app=1332651082
Terms of Service: https://support.bendingspoons.com/tos?app=1332651082
Contact us: support@pixomatic.us

bluejetty:00157306:ios.summary:
Care more. Stress less.

bluejetty:00157306:ios.description:
Care more. Stress less. 
Whether it’s the flu or a tummy bug, ADHD or asthma, Encurage has what you need to navigate the ocean of to-do lists and details, and help you release the mental load, stay on top of things, and feel more confident. 
Every aspect of caring for your child, baby and all family members at home is taken care of following extensive research, medical vetting and parents’ valuable feedback, to:
-Manage their medication schedules
-Support sick days, pain and post surgery management
-Track everything health related, and have it organized and ready for doctors’ visits
and
-Keep everyone in the family in sync. 
Get reliable, comprehensive and tailored tools to:
MANAGE MEDICATION SCHEDULES 
A smart, advanced medication & pill tracker and reminder, with a vast selection of options and to adjust to your family’s needs, helps you get on top of med schedules in seconds.
PUT YOUR MIND AT EASE WITH OUR UNIQUE AS-NEEDED MEDS WIZARD
A dynamic medication schedule builder that updates itself automatically, while keeping accurate time gaps, so you can optimize your child’s pain and fever management, and switch or alternate acetaminophen and ibuprofen with one tap. No updating, counting or recalculating needed. 
TRACK SYMPTOMS, SIDE EFFECTS, VITALS, THERAPIES AND MORE 
Track and log everything related to your family’s health, whether it’s an occasional bug or an ongoing condition requiring daily monitoring. 
Use our guided trackers to log information, organize it in a folder of your choice, and have it ready for your healthcare team.
JOURNAL YOUR FAMILY’S HEALTH AND WELLBEING
Follow and monitor general health, reaction to medications, the progress they are making, and their physical and emotional wellbeing. 
Sleep, appetite, energy, focus, mood and many more provide you with valuable insights, and help in shaping the best treatment plan. 
SEE & SHARE THE PROGRESS 
Detailed, shareable reports help you view the progress, uncover trends, and gain valuable insights, enhancing clarity and supporting more confident decisions with every healthcare visit. 
MANAGE AND SYNC WITH CAREGIVERS 
An essential tool for caring together. 
Add everyone you want, decide who they care for, and keep everyone in sync 
seamlessly, ready to take over at the tap of a button.
Encurage is here to help you track and manage your child's health, in accordance with the instructions given to you by your child's healthcare team. 
IT IS NOT INTENDED TO, AND DOES NOT, PROVIDE ANY KIND OF MEDICAL ADVICE. Always make sure you are following your child’s healthcare team instructions and guidelines. Please read our Terms & Conditions linked below for complete information.
Keeping your and your child’s data private, safe and secure is our top priority. We take considerable measures, and use advanced methods, to protect the data and keep your family’s privacy intact. You can read more about data privacy and protection in our Privacy Policy linked below. 
Encurage premium: subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to Subscriptions in your Google Play app. 
Our Privacy Policy: https://www.encurage.app/
Our Terms and Conditions: https://www.encurage.app/
Your feedback is extremely important to us! We’d love to chat at hello@encurage.app.

bluejetty:00139931:ios.name: Indyx: Wardrobe & Outfit App
bluejetty:00139931:ios.summary: Indyx unlocks the potential of what you own. As the best FREE digital wardrobe and styling app, you can index your closet, plan outfits, track your cost-per-wear, share your closet with friends, and get styled by experts...all in one place!
bluejetty:00139931:ios.description:
Indyx unlocks the potential of what you own. As the best FREE digital wardrobe and styling app, you can index your closet, plan outfits, track your cost-per-wear, share your closet with friends, and get styled by experts...all in one place!
DIGITIZE YOUR WARDROBE
Indyx gives you the tools to create an oh-so-scrollable digital wardrobe that makes shopping your own closet just as satisfying as doom scrolling a shopping site. Add your own photos — messy hanger shots, rushed flatlays, whatever you've got — and we'll automatically remove the background, auto-tag with AI that works, and transform them into clean, editorial flatlays. You can also forward shopping receipts or paste in product links to instantly add items to your closet.
STYLE YOUR WARDROBE
Plan outfits on your own with fully customizable drag-and-drop outfit boards. Or, take advantage of our personal styling services to get professional help re-styling your own wardrobe along with personalized shopping recommendations. No random outfits styled by robots or complete chance, just real style solutions along with just-for-you tips and tricks that make all the difference. 
SHARE YOUR WARDROBE
Ever wanted to peek into someone else's closet? With Indyx, now you can. Share your closet with friends to get help from those you already trust the most. And, browse the featured Open Closets of other Indyx users to get real-life style inspiration, from what they *really* own down to exactly how they mix-and-match those pieces into outfits. 
FULL FEATURE LIST FOR THE INDYX CLOSET APP
Digital Closet Organizer:
+ Add items your way: upload your own photos, forward shopping receipts, or paste product links from retailer websites
+ No good photos? No problem. Snap them messy and we'll handle the rest. Enhance transforms any hanger shot, on-model image, or rushed flatlay into a clean, editorial image, and AI auto-tags category, subcategory, and color for every item
+ You can then add brand, season, location, and more — and, filter or search across your entire wardrobe by any of the above
+ Organize your closet however you like and customize your view: from close-up details to the full wardrobe at a glance
Closet Analytics:
+ Sort your closet by number of wears and cost-per-wear (CPW)
+ Deep dive into your wardrobe dashboard with interactive charts that nudge you to wear your underused pieces, and teach you what’s actually worth buying more of next time
Outfit Planning & Tracking:
+ Create your own outfits with our fully customizable drag-and-drop outfit boards
+ Use outfit tags to organize your outfits into categories
+ Plan your week by scheduling outfits to a calendar, automatically tracking the cost-per-wear of your pieces
+ Save your OOTD selfies to the calendar to remember how you looked and felt in each outfit, visualizing how your style develops over time
Discover Your Personal Style:
+ Use the Style Quiz to help articulate your style words
+ Take our free 8-week Style Workshop course to get inspired, define your style, and build a wardrobe plan to match
Share with Friends:
+ Your closet is private by default, but open your closet to share with friends and other Indyxers
+ Get inspired by browsing the real-life closets of other Indyx users
Get Styled:
+ Get your closet styled by friends or other Indyx users to find fresh outfit inspiration
+ Book a Lookbook for a set of ten (10) expertly styled outfits from your own closet, and with a few new pieces mixed in (if you choose)
Travel Outfit Planning and Packing Lists:
+ Use Collections to build seasonal capsules or packing lists
+ Add outfits to a Collection to automatically generate an itemized list, so you never forget an important piece again

bluejetty:00022097:ios.summary: 9 juegos educativos infantiles para niños de 3, 4 y 5 años en español. Con nuestra aplicación, los niños aprenderán las 5 vocales de abecedario en español de una forma divertida y cómo se escriben tanto en mayúsculas como en minúsculas. Tam
bluejetty:00022097:ios.description:
9 juegos educativos infantiles para niños de 3, 4 y 5 años en español. Con nuestra aplicación, los niños aprenderán las 5 vocales de abecedario en español de una forma divertida y cómo se escriben tanto en mayúsculas como en minúsculas. También aprenderán nuevo vocabulario, con más de 40 palabras en las que tendrán que prestar atención a la primera letra, ¿por qué letra empieza abeja?
Fases del juego:
 - Aprender vocales: al pulsar la vocal, el niño escucha la letra y visualiza un video que le muestra cómo se escribe cada letra
 - Aprender vocabulario: más de 40 divertidos dibujos que representan objetos o conceptos, acompañados de la palabra escrita y una fotografía, que ayuda a los niños a trabajar la abstracción y la comprensión del lenguaje
 - ¿Dónde están la A? Se muestran las vocales y los niños tienen que estar atentos a la pregunta y elegir la vocal correcta.
 - ¿Dónde está la abeja? En estas fase se muestran diferentes opciones y los niños y niñas deben estar atentos a la pregunta y elegir el dibujo adecuado. 
 - ¿Qué letra falta? se muestra la imagen y una palabra a la que le falta la primera letra, los niños deben pulsar la vocal correcta para completar la palabra.
 - ¿Qué palabra empieza por A? Se muestran diferentes imágenes y hay que elegir la que empiece por la vocal que se está mostrando.
 - Ordena por la vocal que empieza: se muestran dos vocales y hay que ordenar las palabras atendiendo a la vocal por la que empieza
 - Memory: un divertido juego para estimular la memoria visual.
 - Trazos de vocales para niños: aprender a escribir las vocales de una forma divertida y con bonitos trazos. Un lápiz le ayudará a descubrir el siguiente trazo.
Nuestro juego habla de forma clara a los niños, lo que permite aprender nuevo vocabulario de una forma muy sencilla y seguir las instrucciones.
Nuestra aplicación tiene diferentes opciones de configuración: dificultad de vocabulario, reproducción de música y bloqueo de botones, que permite adaptar el juego a las necesidades del niño. Las imágenes van acompañadas de las palabras escritas en mayúsculas, para favorecer el aprendizaje de palabras por el método lectura global o ruta global.
Juegos sin anuncios para niños: nuestros juegos educativos para niños no tienen interrupciones publicitarias, para permitir a los niños disfrutar sin publicidad.
Edad: el juego está indicado para niños de 3, 4 y 5 años.

bluejetty:00185703:ios.name: Fill-a-Pix: Minesweeper Puzzle
bluejetty:00185703:ios.summary: Find which neighboring squares must be painted and create a beautiful picture! Each puzzle consists of a grid containing clues in various places. The object is to reveal a hidden picture by painting the squares around each clue so that the
bluejetty:00185703:ios.description:
Find which neighboring squares must be painted and create a beautiful picture! Each puzzle consists of a grid containing clues in various places. The object is to reveal a hidden picture by painting the squares around each clue so that the number of painted squares, including the square with the clue, matches the value of the clue.
Fill-a-Pix are exciting logic puzzles that form whimsical pixel-art pictures when solved. Challenging, deductive and artistic, this original Conceptis puzzle offers the ultimate mix of logic, art and fun while providing solvers with many hours of mentally stimulating entertainment.
The game features a unique fingertip cursor which enables playing large puzzle grids with ease and precision: to fill a square, move cursor to the desired location and tap anywhere on the screen. To fill multiple squares, press and hold fingertip until cursor fills the square and start dragging to neighboring squares. The game also features a powerful Smart-fill cursor for quick, single-tap filling of all remaining empty squares around a clue.
To help see the puzzle progress, graphic previews in the puzzle list show the progress of all puzzles in a volume as they are being solved. A Gallery view option provides these previews in a larger format.
For more fun, Fill-a-Pix contains no ads and includes a Weekly Bonus section providing an extra free puzzle each week.
PUZZLE FEATURES
• 125 free Fill-a-Pix puzzles
• Extra bonus puzzle published free each week
• Puzzle library continuously updates with new content
• Manually created by artists, top quality puzzles
• Unique solution for each puzzle
• Grid sizes up to 65x100
• Multiple difficulty levels
• Hours of intellectual challenge and fun
• Sharpens logic and improves cognitive skills
GAMING FEATURES
• No ads
• Zoom, reduce, move puzzle for easy viewing
• Smart-fill cursor for faster playing
• Show errors during gameplay
• Unlimited check puzzle
• Unlimited hints
• Unlimited Undo and Redo

listings.description:
Find which neighboring squares must be painted and create a beautiful picture! Each puzzle consists of a grid containing clues in various places. The object is to reveal a hidden picture by painting the squares around each clue so that the number of painted squares, including the square with the clue, matches the value of the clue.

Fill-a-Pix are exciting logic puzzles that form whimsical pixel-art pictures when solved. Challenging, deductive and artistic, this original Conceptis puzzle offers the ultimate mix of logic, art and fun while providing solvers with many hours of mentally stimulating entertainment.

The game features a unique fingertip cursor which enables playing large puzzle grids with ease and precision: to fill a square, move cursor to the desired location and tap anywhere on the screen. To fill multiple squares, press and hold fingertip until cursor fills the square and start dragging to neighboring squares. The game also features a powerful Smart-fill cursor for quick, single-tap filling of all remaining empty squares around a clue.

To help see the puzzle progress, graphic previews in the puzzle list show the progress of all puzzles in a volume as they are being solved. A Gallery view option provides these previews in a larger format.

bluejetty:00145579:ios.description:
Five minutes to unwind, or fifty — Dice Empire turns rolling dice into a satisfying puzzle habit.
Roll the dice, drop them on the board, clear the blocks. That's it. No timers, no pressure — just a relaxing brain teaser you can pick up anywhere, offline, anytime.
HOW TO PLAY
- Roll the dice — every turn gives you new numbers to work with
- Place them on the board to fill blocks
- Clear blocks to complete the level
- Plan ahead and use power-ups to breeze through tougher puzzles
WHY PLAYERS KEEP COMING BACK
- Easy to pick up, genuinely hard to put down
- Hundreds of levels — each one a fresh puzzle, not a reskin
- Gorgeous worlds that unlock as you progress
- Works completely offline — no Wi-Fi, no interruptions
- Free to play, at your own pace
A NEW SPIN ON A CLASSIC
If you grew up on Yahtzee or Solitaire, Dice Empire will feel familiar and new at once — the simple joy of a dice roll, combined with the strategy of clearing a block puzzle board.
PERFECT FOR
- Block puzzle fans looking for something different
- Dice game lovers who want more than a classic roll
- Anyone who wants a relaxing brain game for the commute, the couch, or the waiting room
Download Dice Empire and see why puzzle players can't put it down.
Got feedback? We read every review — it shapes every update.

bluejetty:00147203:ios.description:
NYDocSubmit enables residents of New York State to submit required documents for SNAP, HEAP, Temporary Assistance, and Medicaid – avoiding another trip to the local social services district (“district”) office.
This App is available to residents of Albany, Allegany, Broome, Cattaraugus, Cayuga, Chautauqua, Chemung, Chenango, Clinton, Columbia, Cortland, Delaware, Dutchess, Erie, Essex, Franklin, Fulton, Genesee, Greene, Hamilton, Herkimer, Jefferson, Lewis, Livingston, Madison, Monroe, Montgomery, Niagara, Oneida, Onondaga, Ontario, Orleans, Oswego, Otsego, Putnam, Rensselaer, Rockland, Saratoga, Schoharie, Schuyler, Seneca, St. Lawrence, Steuben, Suffolk, Sullivan, Tioga, Tompkins, Ulster, Warren, Washington, Wayne, Westchester, Wyoming, and Yates Counties at this time. If your district is not listed, check back soon to see if it has been added.
This App is NOT monitored for emergencies. You must contact your district office directly if you need help to address an emergency. DO NOT use this App to submit an initial application for SNAP, HEAP, Temporary Assistance, or Medicaid; to submit a SNAP Interim Report, SNAP Change Report Form, or SNAP Periodic Report; or to submit a recertification application for SNAP, HEAP, or Temporary Assistance. However, you may use NYDocSubmit to submit a Medicaid recertification.
DO NOT submit sensitive information, such as HIV status or domestic violence information and/or addresses that must remain confidential to safeguard you or a household member. If you need to submit such information, or if the App is not available, provide the documents to your district in a manner OTHER THAN through this App, such as through the U.S. Postal Service, in person, kiosk (if available), or fax machine.

bluejetty:00127191:ios.name: Wolf Tales - Online RPG Sim 3D
bluejetty:00127191:ios.summary: The Animal wildlands is a dangerous RPG world, where the forest animals guard their territory while hunting and surviving off the land. For centuries, the wolf packs have remained at the top of the food chain, maintaining the natural order,
bluejetty:00127191:ios.description:
The Animal wildlands is a dangerous RPG world, where the forest animals guard their territory while hunting and surviving off the land. For centuries, the wolf packs have remained at the top of the food chain, maintaining the natural order, led by their alpha, the last remaining dire wolf. When the dire wolf goes missing, you must lead your pack to greatness. Select a gray wolf or a black wolf, and start building your ultimate wolfpack. A wild life simulation adventure awaits!
Worldwide Multiplayer Battles - PvP
Fight for dominance in the virtual world! Take on the world in online real-time multiplayer PvP battles. Hunt together with your team in co-op and battle enemy clans to control the most territory. Will you be the hunter or the hunted?
Upgrade Your Battle Skills
Create your ultimate RPG hero - you can choose which skills to learn and upgrade. Unique skills range from basic MMORPG abilities to fantasy elemental attacks - and even stealth skills which allow you to hide in the forest and become the ultimate predator!
Breed & Raise Cubs
Build a family and role play! A realistic breeding sim gives cubs stronger fighting attributes compared to their parents. Take your pups out with you as you raid other clans and hunt your prey. Your pups will watch your every move, learning important survival and life skills. Trail your pup well, else they will not stand a chance in the online multiplayer PvP battle arena.
Collect Animals
The alpha is the hero of each pack. You can duel enemy clans and recruit their alpha to your den. Collect wolves, foxes, bears and other wild animals, each with realistic and fantasy evolution skins. Each creature is rendered in stunning 3D graphics.
Live The Story Of A Wolf Clan
A true survival simulator. When nature’s balance is threatened as the Great River has become contaminated, competition between the animals over the remaining spring water has begun. Even foreign tigers have been spotted far outside of their borders, causing concern amongst the rest of the animals.
There have also been rumours of ancient reptiles, rising to the surface from centuries of slumber, claiming the mountains and caves as their own. The gray wolves are now called upon to craft a solution in these troubled times.
A Massive Open World
Explore a huge, unbroken open MMO world teeming with wild life, from the dense forest, mountains to the freezing arctic. You can fight in online multiplayer PvP areas, tackle quests, role play, gather resources or raid enemy clans and take over their home. You might even encounter the tiger king on your adventure (a superior evolution of the natural tiger), who has been spotted in the forest for the first time in centuries! 
Groundbreaking 3D Graphics
Experience never before seen 3D graphics quality in a wildlife simulation MMO, with dynamic lighting and time of day cycles which bring the virtual world to life! Start your day at the mountain peaks, watching the sunrise with your pack before embarking on your adventure for survival and territory dominance.
Build & Decorate Your Den
Craft a home! Dig tunnels and secret passageways to expand your virtual family. Craft the best environment for your cubs, and raise a family to tackle the strongest predators in the forest. The realistic breeding simulator allows you to breed your animals and watch them grow to adults in real time.
Terms of Service & Privacy Policy
By downloading this app you are agreeing to our terms of service which can be found at: https://www.foxieventures.com/terms
Our privacy policy can be found at:
https://www.foxieventures.com/privacy
In-App Purchases
This app offers optional in-app purchases that cost real money. You can disable the in-app purchasing functionality by adjusting your device settings.
A network connection is required to play. Data fees may apply if WiFi isn’t connected.
Website: https://www.foxieventures.com

bluejetty:00021111:ios.description:
Bicycle Stunts is a fast, skill-based stunt riding game where every jump, landing, and flip counts. Pick your favourite rider, hop on a bike, and race through 3 chapters of handcrafted stunt tracks—each chapter packed with 5 levels (total 15 missions) across distinct environments like Canyon Desert, Forest Trails, and Autumn Woods.
Push for a perfect run by beating your best time, collecting stars, and stacking rewards through air time and stunt bonuses. Unlock and collect 8 bicycles and 8 riders, each with different stats, and choose the control style you prefer (buttons or slider controls).
Highlights
- 3 chapters, 15 missions (5 levels per chapter)
- 8 bicycles to collect and ride
- 8 riders to unlock and play
- Stunt rewards + air-time bonuses
- Two control options: Buttons or Slider

VIP includes:
- No Ads
- Unlock All Bicycles
- Unlock All Riders
Auto-renewal & billing
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription auto-renews weekly unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
If you cancel, the subscription remains active until the end of the current billing cycle.
Manage/cancel
iPhone/iPad: Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions
Terms & Privacy

bluejetty:00164533:ios.description:
Helping you pass your GED® exam is our primary goal. Study and prepare for the exam with a professional mobile app that will boost your confidence in passing the exam on the first try!
The GED®, or General Educational Development, test is a group of four subject tests which, when passed, provide certification that the test taker has United States or Canadian high school-level academic skills. Passing the GED® test gives individuals the opportunity to earn a high school equivalency credential, which can be used for pursuing further education or employment opportunities.
Our application helps you to prepare for GED® test with the required domain knowledge. The details are given below:
- Math
- Science
- Language Arts
- Social Studies
With our mobile apps, you can practice with systematic testing features and you can study with specialized content created by our exam experts, which will help you prepare to pass your exams more efficiently.
Key Features:
- Practice using more than 1,100 questions
- Choose the topics you need to focus on
- Versatile testing modes
- Great looking interface and easy interaction
- Study detailed data for each test.
- - - - - - - - - - - - -
Purchase, subscription and terms
You need to purchase a subscription to unlock the full range of features, topics and questions. The purchase will be automatically deducted from your iTunes account. Subscriptions are automatically renewable and billed according to the subscription plan and rate you choose. The auto-renewal fee will be charged to the user's account no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term.
After you purchase a subscription, you can manage your subscription and cancel, downgrade, or upgrade your subscription at any time in your Account Settings in iTunes. Unused portions of the free trial period (if provided) will be canceled when the user purchases a subscription to the publication, if applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://www.iprep.pro/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.iprep.pro/terms-of-use.html
Disclaimer : 
We provide practice questions and features for demonstrating the structure and wording of GED® exam questions for learning purposes only. Your correct answers to these questions will not earn you any certificates, nor will they represent your score on the actual exam.
GED® is a registered trademark of the American Council on Education and may not be used without permission. The GED® and GED Testing Service® brands are administered by GED Testing Service LLC under license.
Legal Notice:
We are not affiliated with any testing organization, certificate, any trademark or exam name. All registered trademarks are the property of the respected trademark owners.

The first weather app that fully integrates into your home and car with real-time audio weather reports and emergency weather notifications; personalized for you.
We take weather to another level.
Our patented technology delivers real-time audio weather reports to your location.
It's voice-activated: Ask Weatherology for the latest forecast.
At home. In your car. On your phone.
It's real-time. With up-to-the-minute weather updates including the latest watches, warnings, advisories, and bulletins. We alert you with relevant weather notifications to keep you informed.
It's real people, not voice simulation: Select your favorite weather talent, and they provide real-time weather reports on demand.
It's accurate and personalized for your location.
The technology is new, but the Weatherology team has been around for nearly 40 years. We have contributed to more award-winning local weather broadcasts than our largest competitors combined.
Apple CarPlay audio apps must be voice-activated and offer audio capabilities only, which is exactly what our app does. With the exception of navigation apps, content such as weather maps and radar are currently prohibited from being displayed as content on the dashboard. We are fo­cused on cre­at­ing the best hands-free audio ex­pe­ri­ence in ve­hi­cles in ac­cor­dance with Apple Car­Play guide­lines.
Although our expertise is audio, we are meteorologists, so we offer all the tools you need to stay informed. Up-to-the-minute radar that loads quickly and zooms in to your specific location. Storm vectors that illustrate current storm location and storm movement.
We offer current weather advisory graphics with up-to-the-minute audio weather details for each bulletin.
Hourly and 7-day forecast displays.
Weather conditions from around the world.
Beautiful weather widgets with an elegant, accurate and aesthetically pleasing Apple Watch interface.
With Apple CarPlay, Weatherology provides a hands-free, safe way to get the latest weather in your car.
At home, have a real meteorologist provide your forecast with details for your location unmatched by synthetic voices currently available through Smart Speakers.
Automobile safety is priority number one and our app is the only weather app that discourages distractions in your vehicle.

bluejetty:00014278:ios.description:
The go-to app for your HP devices. Set up your new printer, personalize your experience, print, scan, and contact support—all in one place. 
Formerly HP Smart, the new HP app[1] offers you more ways to get more from your HP devices. 
Easy Setup, Wherever You Are 
New device? No problem. Get up and running fast with a guided setup that does the heavy lifting for you. Once you are ready to go, you can manage your HP printer and computer and stay on top of the essentials, like checking your ink levels. 
Make the Most of Your Device 
Stay informed with top recommendations. Plus, you can adjust your device settings and discover HP products that match your needs—it is all about making your tech work just the way you like it. 
Print and Scan, On Your Time 
Print a school form from the kitchen or a last-minute birthday card. Even, scan receipts in seconds and send it straight to your email. Whether you are at home or at the office, completing your print tasks is a click away. 
Instant Help Whenever You Need It 
When something goes wrong, help is right there—make a quick call, message live chat or find answers in the app[1]. You’ll be back to what matters before you know it. 
But wait, your experience just gets better and better! 
• Unlock a world of creativity with HP Printables[2]. Explore tons of cards, coloring pages, educational worksheets, and fun crafts projects. 
• Adjust and edit your documents before you hit print. 
• Set up custom shortcuts for print tasks you use often. 
• Automatically correct images, name files, flatten pages, extract text, and scan multiple pages at the same time with the HP app.[3] 
• Get a notification when your printer is low on ink or paper and easily order more to keep printing uninterrupted. 
We're always adding cool new features to the app. Make sure you turn on auto-updates, so you don't miss all the latest improvements! 
Disclaimers
1. HP Smart and myHP are now the HP app, available for download on macOS devices; and for iOS mobile phones and iPads. The HP app requires download available at www.hp.com/hp-app. Not all HP devices, services, apps are available in the HP app. Certain features are available in English language only, and may vary by printer and PC model/country, and between desktop/mobile applications. HP reserves the right to introduce charges for use of select HP app functionality. Internet access required. HP account required for full functionality. Fax sending capability only. Live chat and phone support are available during business hours and varies by country. Chat service is localized in supported regions, and where not supported, will default to English. Supported conferencing features vary by device and device configuration. For complete Terms of Service see: www.hp.com/hp-app-terms-of-use. 
2. Printables are for personal use only and may not be distributed for any commercial purpose. 
3. Choose HP+ at setup to activate benefits. HP+ requires an HP account, ongoing connection to the internet, and the use of only Original HP ink for the life of the printer. More at hp.com/plus

bluejetty:00156423:ios.summary: Cerebrum is the world’s first intelligent tire solution that enables individual users and the largest commercial fleets to gain innovative insights into their tires. By mounting directly to the tire with our patented technology, Cerebrum Se
bluejetty:00156423:ios.description:
Cerebrum is the world’s first intelligent tire solution that enables individual users and the largest commercial fleets to gain innovative insights into their tires. By mounting directly to the tire with our patented technology, Cerebrum Sensors provide real-time advanced tire analytics, ensuring safety and peak vehicle performance. Fleet customers also have access to our cloud-based Fleet Management application enabling real-time vehicle monitoring from anywhere. Together, Cerebrum Sensors and our advanced software products work together helping you ensure your tires are ready for the road. 
Key App Features
- Pressure Monitoring: Ensure proper tire pressure and monitor for leaks 
- Temperature Monitoring: Prevent excessive overheating reducing risk of blowouts 
- Tread Depth Monitoring: Ensure tire tread is in a safe operating range 
- Alignment Monitoring: Monitor wheel and tire conditions to avoid premature wear 
- Efficiency & Emissions Monitoring: Quantify the impact of operating a vehicle with improperly installed tires 
- Many more to come… 
App Modes
- Tire Maintenance Mode: Easily log and track your maintenance activities within the App. Fleet customers will also see changes made in the Fleet Management application. 
- Professional Mode: Get the most out of your tires on the road or track! Advanced Mode records and reports advanced 'Session' analytics including a GPS map-view, minimum and maximum tire conditions, session playback and even recommends pressure adjustments to improve tire performance. This information can then be exported for further analysis and shared with friends through social media. 
- Pressure Gauge Mode: No need to rely on unreliable gas station gauges. Use this screen when filling your tires to help ensure accurate tire pressure. 
Account Types 
- Product Owner: Unlocks the full capability of the Cerebrum App 
- Technician: Support the setup and management of customer vehicles for tire shops and technicians. Joining the network by signing up as a Technician can also help to refer customers to your shop to get Cerebrum installed on a new set of replacement tires. 
- (Fleet Customers Only) Fleet Manager: Unlocks the full capability of the Cerebrum App and Web Application. 
- (Fleet Customers Only) Fleet Technician: Limited App and Web access

listings.description:
Cerebrum is the world’s first intelligent tire solution that enables individual users and the largest commercial fleets to gain innovative insights into their tires. By mounting directly to the tire with our patented technology, Cerebrum Sensors provide real-time advanced tire analytics, ensuring safety and peak vehicle performance. Together, Cerebrum Sensors and our advanced software products work together helping you ensure your tires are ready for the road. 

Key App Features

- Pressure Monitoring: Ensure proper tire pressure and monitor for leaks 
- Temperature Monitoring: Prevent excessive overheating reducing risk of blowouts 
- Tread Depth Monitoring: Ensure tire tread is in a safe operating range 
- Alignment Monitoring: Monitor wheel and tire conditions to avoid premature wear 
- Efficiency & Emissions Monitoring: Quantify the impact of operating a vehicle with improperly installed tires

App Modes

- Tire Maintenance Mode: Easily log and track your maintenance activities within the App. Fleet customers will also see changes made in the Fleet Management application.

This information can then be exported for further analysis and shared with friends through social media. 
- Pressure Gauge Mode: No need to rely on unreliable gas station gauges. Use this screen when filling your tires to help ensure accurate tire pressure.

- Product Owner: Unlocks the full capability of the Cerebrum App

Children of Morta is a story-driven action RPG with a roguelite approach to character development, in which you don’t play a single character but a whole, extraordinary family of heroes. 
Hack’n’slash through hordes of enemies in procedurally generated dungeons, caves and lands and lead the Bergson family, with all their flaws and virtues, against the forthcoming Corruption. - Immerse yourself in the beautiful, deadly world of Rea through gorgeous 2D pixel art mixing handcrafted animations with modern lighting techniques
- Family that slays together stays together: use the two-player online coop mode and rely on each other in every fight (available in a post-launch update)
CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Game Center achievements
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices
- Compatible with MFi controllers
- iPhone 15 Optimization (including Pro Max)
