The indispensable app for all hear.com HORIZON hearing aid wearers. The hear.com HORIZON app allows you to discreetly control the pioneering hearing system from hear.com in complete comfort via your smartphone. Transfer multimedia content such as music or phone calls directly to the hearing aid, set different amplification programs and activate innovative functions such as SPEECH FOCUS, PANORAMA EFFECT and the world first MY MODE functionality. Thanks to the simple, intuitive user interface, you'll be able to use it right from the start.
Remote Control
Control all functions and settings of your hear.com horizon hearing aid from the smartphone screen:
• Volume
• Hearing programs
• Tonal balance
• SPEECH FOCUS for particularly clear speech understanding 
• PANORAMA EFFECT for a unique 360° all-round listening experience
• MY MODE with four new functions making each hearing situation perfect: MUSIC MODE, ACTIVE MODE, COMFORT MODE and RELAX MODE. 
Direct Streaming
Transfer multimedia content directly to the hearing aid via Bluetooth connection:
• Music
• Calls
• TV sound
• Audio books
• Web content
Device information: 
• Battery status
• Warning message
• Statistics on device usage 
The user guide for the app can be accessed from the app settings menu. Alternatively, you can download the user guide in electronic form from www.wsaud.com or order a printed version from the same address. The printed version will be made available to you free of charge within 7 working days.

bluejetty:00072936:ios.summary: satellite is the sipgate app with its own mobile number. It works no matter who your current provider is – and you can be reached from anywhere in the world. Use satellite alongside your current mobile plan, or switch to satellite completel
bluejetty:00072936:ios.description:
satellite is the sipgate app with its own mobile number. It works no matter who your current provider is – and you can be reached from anywhere in the world. Use satellite alongside your current mobile plan, or switch to satellite completely. Make calls just like you’re used to, and stay reachable on your satellite number – whether it’s friends, family, or the plumber calling. To them, it’s just another regular call – no app required.
What you get:
* A German mobile number
* Simultaneous multi-device use
* Always-on reachability, even with the app closed
* Great call quality – even on slow connections
* Calls over Wi-Fi or mobile data – no SIM needed
* Encrypted calls using SRTP and TLS
* 100 free minutes/month to landlines and mobile networks in 60 countries (including Germany)
* AI-generated call summaries
* Smart inbox to help you handle and collaborate on calls
Hundreds of thousands of people worldwide already use satellite.
The press says:
“Wenn etwas gut ist, dann ist es einfach gut” – ComputerBild
“Dienst und App überzeugen - sie belegen nachdrücklich, wie einfach man zusätzliche Mobilfunknummern auf modernen Smartphones nutzen kann” – Heise online
We developed satellite from scratch and even built our own telecom carrier from the ground up, making satellite way more than just another VoIP app: satellite gives you real independence from the big mobile providers in Germany.
The best of mobile and VoIP
satellite offers the convenience of a mobile number with the flexibility of VoIP. All backed by our own infrastructure, used reliably by hundreds of thousands of users since 2018XX. All you need is a Wi-Fi or mobile data connection. And since your number isn’t tied to a SIM card, switching data providers is easy.
-----------
For sipgate customers
You can log in to your sipgate account directly in the satellite app. Once logged in, your sipgate account conditions apply.
You can make mobile calls just like in the sipgate desktop app. Feature availability may vary, but we’re constantly improving satellite and rolling out new features.
-----------
In-App Purchase Info
Flatrate+ gives you unlimited calls to landlines and mobile numbers in 60 countries.
You’ll also get regular add-ons to enhance your experience. For example:
* Record and manage your own voicemail greetings
* Smart availability: Set up profiles with custom ringtones, voicemails, and notifications. Activate them manually or based on time and location.
Flatrate+ is available as an in-app subscription for €4.99/month.
* Billed monthly via your iTunes account
* Auto-renews one day before each billing cycle
* Cancel anytime in the App Store or iPhone settings
* If you cancel less than 24 hours before renewal, you’ll be charged one last time
* After cancellation, your account switches to the free basic version. Your settings and data stay intact.
T&C's - https://satellite.me/utilites/agb

✔ 70 Achievements to suit all styles of play

bluejetty:00122540:ios.description:
WHAT IS BLUEBIRD?
Bluebird is a financial account that offers you the flexibility and convenience to take control of your money. With no monthly fees and many other fee-free features, Bluebird helps make the day-to-day necessities easier to take care of so you can spend your time doing the things that matter most. 
Visit us at Bluebird.com for more information.
HOW THE BLUEBIRD APP WORKS
• Easily manage your Bluebird Account on the go, wherever you are!
• Log in to easily access your Available Balance and view the details of all your active and completed transactions
MONEY IN
• Add cash fee free at Family Dollar¹
• Get your pay up to 2 days faster with free early direct deposit²
• Easily add money from checks using your mobile device³
MONEY OUT
• Use your Bluebird card to make purchases online or in-store
• Withdraw cash for free at over 37,000 MoneyPass ATMs nationwide⁴
• Send money to other Bluebird accountholders
A BRAND YOU CAN TRUST
• Our security features bring the reliability you need and the value you deserve
• We work hard to keep your information and money safe and secure
• Our 24/7 Customer Service representatives are there for you, day or night
¹You can add cash at other locations for up to $3.95. As of July 1, 2023, cash reloads at Walmart will no longer be fee free and will incur a fee of $3.74 per transaction. See bluebird.com/faqs for more details.
²Faster access compared to standard payday electronic deposit and subject to your employer submitting paycheck information to the bank before payday. Your employer may not submit paycheck information early.
³The Mobile Check Capture by Ingo Money service is provided by First Century Bank, N.A. and Ingo Money, Inc., subject to the First Century Bank and Ingo Money Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy. All checks are subject to approval for funding in Ingo Money’s sole discretion. Approval usually takes 3 to 5 minutes but can take up to one hour. Fees apply for approved Money in Minutes transactions funded to your Account. See bluebird.com/fees for details. Additional terms and conditions and limits are associated with your use of the Mobile Check Capture by Ingo Money service through the Bluebird Mobile app. See bluebird.com/legal for details. Data rates may apply. Note: As of 2/13/2022, Mobile Check Capture is not available for use in the state of New York. 
⁴Transactions at non-Money Pass® ATMs have a $2.50 fee. ATM operator fees may also apply. See bluebird.com/atm for details.

bluejetty:00175658:ios.description:
Match – The Dating App for Real Relationships and Real People.
Looking for something real? Welcome to Match – the dating app designed for singles who know what they want. For over 25 years, Match has helped millions of men and women find meaningful relationships through authentic conversations, expert-backed guidance, and a safe, trusted platform.
Whether you're searching for love, exploring local dating, or ready to meet someone new, Match makes it easy to connect with real people near you who are looking for the same thing.
We believe being honest about who you are and what you’re looking for isn’t being picky – it’s being confident. Match is here to help you date like an adult: with intention, clarity, and the tools to make meaningful connections.
Why Match Stands Out
Match goes beyond swipes and surface-level chats. It’s a dating experience built on trust, safety, and real human connection.
- Real Singles, Serious Intentions: Our members are here to find something meaningful – not just kill time.
- Expert Dating Support: From profile tips to first date advice, our team of dating experts is here to help.
- Verified Profiles: We take safety seriously, so you can focus on getting to know people without second guessing.
- Advanced Matching Tools: Get specific with your preferences and discover matches that really align with your goals.
Features Designed for Real Connections
- Customized Search Filters: Set your criteria and explore singles who meet your relationship goals.
- Conversation Starters: From trending topics to easy prompts, Match helps you break the ice effortlessly.
- Local Events – Online & IRL: Meet singles in your area at fun, low-pressure events designed to make dating easier.
- Expert Tips & Insights: Optimize your profile and improve your approach with advice from real dating professionals.
- Safe, Verified Community: Every profile goes through checks to help keep the platform authentic and respectful.
Free to Start, Easy to Explore
It’s free to download and start matching right away. With no subscription required, you can:
- Create your profile and upload photos
- Browse and receive daily match suggestions
- Chat with recommended matches
- Join virtual and in-person singles events
Want more control and visibility? Go Premium.
Unlock exclusive tools and benefits:
- See unlimited profiles
- Use advanced filters to find exactly what you're looking for
- Reconnect with profiles you passed on
- Boost your profile to get seen faster
- Get premium-level dating advice and tips
Whether you’re looking for a serious relationship or just want to meet quality singles near you, Match gives you the tools and confidence to make it happen.
Real people. Real relationships. Real dating.
Join Match today and discover a dating experience that’s honest, safe, and made for adults who are done playing games.
Download Match and start connecting – it’s free to try.

bluejetty:00060680:ios.description:
Read Comics, Manga, Webtoons, Manhwa & Manhua And More
- All the hottest comics are right here! You can read all kinds of comics, including Fantasy, Action, Romance, Horror, BL Manga (Boy’s Love), and more.
- We have manhwa and webtoon stories from Korea. We provide manhwa & webtoon fans with various genres of wonderful work.
- There also are manhua stories for you to read. You can find the latest and hottest manhua stories in different genres on MangaToon. Tales of Demons and Gods, Bossy President, Battle Through the Heavens and more iconic manhua arewaits you to read!
Read Free Comics
- At MangaToon, many of our comics require paying a unlocking fee to read. The reason is that manga creators also need to make a living. Only with manga fans' support, they can continue to create better comic storiess. Your support is the best motivation for them to create mangas.
- But MangaToon also provides plenty of free ways for readers to read manga for free. Every week, there are different comics released for manga readers to read for free.
- Also, You can get free comics, unlock them with points or reading vouchers. By completing platform tasks, you will receive a certain number of points and reading vouchers every week, which allows you get free comics.
- Even if you don't have points or manga vouches, you can still read free comics by watching a short video to unlock manga chapters.
Great Manga Reading Experience
- At MangaToon, you can not only read comics online but also download them for offline reading, allowing you to enjoy the fascinating world of manga anytime and anywhere.
- MangaToon is a manga reader designed specifically for mobile phone reading. You can scroll mangas & webtoons smoothly for an uninterrupted reading experience.
- We provide colorful manga and comic works on MangaToon, bring you a more immersive comic reading experience.
- Join our manga community and discuss everything about your favorite manga with millions of manga lovers!
- A vertical search tool for comics. You can search and read mangas like One Piece, Jujutsu Kaisen, Naruto and other hottest mangas.
- Pad version is also supported. Enjoy manga with a better screen on your pad!
- As a manga reader designed for manga fans all over the world, you can find mangas and stories in more than ten languages, including English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Indonesian Vietnamese and Thai. You can switch to other languages on the App's settings page to read comic stories.
Tell stories like chatting
- At MangaToon, in addition to reading comics, you can also find many exciting chat stories. Chat stories are a new form of novel where the story unfolds in the form of chatting. Chat stories have exciting plotlines, the world views full of imagination, and a more relaxed reading experience, allowing you to read stories as easily as chatting with a friend.
- A vast array of wonderful stories awaits you to discover, where you can see characters from One Piece chatting with each other, fanfiction stories about the personal stories of BTS members, and so on.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MangaToonEN/
Contact us by Email: support@mangatoon.mobi

bluejetty:00180643:ios.description:
Retrouvez l’intégralité du journal papier accompagné du cahier quotidien Eco & Entreprises, ainsi que les cahiers hebdomadaires, les suppléments mensuels et des hors-séries.
Le Monde à consulter partout :
- L’édition du jour disponible dès 13 heures, heure de parution à Paris
- La possibilité d’accéder aux 30 dernières éditions du journal
- En avion ou dans le train, consultez les éditions chargées, même hors connexion…
- Téléchargement anticipé : permet de commencer à lire le journal avant la fin du téléchargement
Une navigation tactile et intuitive :
- La mise en page est adaptée à l'écran de l'iPhone ou de l'iPad, pour un confort de lecture unique
- Le mode déconnecté vous permet de profiter des contenus, même en avion
- L'accès direct à M, le magazine du Monde, aux suppléments de votre journal ainsi qu'à des hors-séries.
Abonnez-vous directement depuis l'application :
- Téléchargez Le Monde en illimité sur votre iPhone/iPad
- Abonnement mensuel à partir de 12,99 €
- Profitez d’une semaine d’essai gratuit
- Le montant de l’abonnement est débité sur votre compte iTunes automatiquement à la confirmation de l’abonnement
- L’abonnement est automatiquement reconduit sauf si cette option est désactivée hors 24 heures précédant la fin de la période en cours
- L’abonnement et son renouvellement peuvent être gérés en vous rendant dans votre compte dans l’App Store après l’achat
Si vous avez une question, ou que vous rencontrez un problème technique, n’hésitez pas à consulter notre FAQ ou à nous écrire grâce à la rubrique «Aide » accessible dans les réglages de l’application.

يوفر التطبيق ن
bluejetty:00171368:ios.description:
مشغل اغاني بدون نت هو تطبيقك الشامل لتحميل، حفظ، وتشغيل الأغاني والشيلات والملفات الصوتية بدون إنترنت. سواء كنت تدور على أحدث الشيلات، الطرب الأصيل، أو موسيقاك المفضلة — التطبيق يمنحك مكتبة صوتية منظمة تقدر توصل لها بأي وقت.
يوفر التطبيق نظامًا ذكيًا لإدارة وترتيب الملفات يساعدك تنظّم أغانيك وفيديوهاتك داخل مجلدات مخصصة، مع بحث سريع، فرز حسب الاسم أو التاريخ أو الحجم، وإعادة تسمية أو حذف أو نقل الملفات بسهولة. ابنِ مكتبة صوتيات مرتبة توصل لمحتواك فيها بضغطة وحدة.
مشغل فيديو وصوت احترافي يدعم أشهر صيغ الملفات، مع كل أدوات التحكم: تشغيل، إيقاف مؤقت، تقديم وتأخير، وضبط الصوت. يدعم التشغيل بالخلفية، فتقدر تسمع محتواك وأنت تستخدم تطبيقات ثانية بدون انقطاع.
أداة قوية لتحويل الفيديو إلى MP3 واستخراج الصوت بجودة عالية — مثالية لإنشاء ملفات موسيقى، نغمات، أو استخراج مقاطع صوتية من فيديوهاتك المحفوظة. التحويل سريع مع إمكانية تسمية الملف وتنظيمه فورًا بعد التحويل.
قص وتحرير المقاطع الصوتية لتحتفظ بالجزء اللي يعجبك بس، وإنشاء وإدارة قوائم تشغيل خاصة لتنظيم مفضلتك بطريقة مرتبة واحترافية.

bluejetty:00029497:ios.name: Busy Kids - Early Learning
bluejetty:00029497:ios.summary: Welcome to the world of "Busy Kids - Useful and Happy", where learning and play come together to create a delightful experience for your child! Our app is a carefully curated collection of games, riddles, and learning tools designed to help
bluejetty:00029497:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of "Busy Kids - Useful and Happy", where learning and play come together to create a delightful experience for your child! Our app is a carefully curated collection of games, riddles, and learning tools designed to help your children learn, develop logic and improve creative thinking skills.
A Collaboration of Experts
We believe in creating the best learning environment for your child. That's why we collaborated with a team of experts, including parents, educators, linguists, and speech therapists, to ensure our app meets the highest standards of quality and effectiveness. The phrases, words, and letters in our app are thoughtfully voiced by professional actors, adding an element of charm and authenticity to the learning experience.
Safety and Compliance First
Your child's safety is our top priority. We have meticulously designed our games to be safe for children, adhering to both international and US standards for children's products, including COPPA requirements.
Discover the Exciting Features
"Busy Kids - Useful and Happy" is packed with an array of exciting features that will captivate your child's imagination and foster their love for learning:
1. The Preschool ABC Class - This unique tool serves as a stepping stone for your child's reading and writing journey. In this section, your child can interactively learn the basics of reading and writing (Letter Formation Tracing) English words with the help of a magical keyboard. Contains a mode of reading and voicing by syllables with transcription.
2. Large Phonics Alphabet with Pictures - Alphabetic Principle & Phonics. An immersive alphabet featuring delightful pictures and professional voice over that engage and enhance your child's learning experience. Also with Letter Formation Tracing mode.
3. Whiteboard for Drawing, Coloring, Shapes Tracing and Studying Colors - Encourage your child's creativity and help them explore shapes and colors.
4. Learning and Trace Numbers.
5. Music Studio - Kids can learn music and create their own songs, play the piano or drums.
6. Fascinating and colourful Jigsaw Puzzles of varying difficulty.
7. Entertaining Games with Letters and Words. Games are designed to make learning enjoyable, stimulating your child's curiosity and understanding of letters and words.
8. Large Thematic 360 Degree Panoramas with Riddles - Spark your child's imagination with over 200 riddles and unlock a world of fascinating knowledge.
9. Daily Rewards - our app celebrate your child's progress with daily rewards, motivating them to continue their learning journey.
10. Stats on Your Child's Achievements - Keep track of your child's accomplishments in the parents' section, staying informed about their progress.
Enhance Reading Skills with the Preschool ABC Class
The Preschool ABC Class in English is a remarkable feature designed to foster your child's reading and writing abilities in an engaging manner:
1. Unique Keyboard - Your child can learn to read English words interactively using an fully voiced customizable magic keyboard. Word and Sentence Typing - Type words and short sentences to explore the magic of reading.
2. Pronunciation Assistance - The app provides audio assistance for letters, sounds, syllables, and complete words, helping your child develop pronunciation skills.
3. Writing Practice - The learning mode allows your child to practice writing letters and numbers (Letter Formation Tracing), enhancing their fine motor skills.
This app encourages collaborative learning between children and adults, including parents, teachers, and speech therapists. With a variety of ideas and exercises, you can enhance your child's reading skills, including phonemic awareness, phonics, vocabulary.
Your feedback is invaluable to us. We welcome your ideas, suggestions, desires, so don't hesitate to reach out to us via email at [ hello@editale.com ].
Privacy Policy: https://editale.com/policy
Terms of Use: https://editale.com/terms

~ Results and payoffs delivered quickly

•Results

bluejetty:00087979:ios.description:
Nepal’s No.1 Health, Baby & Beauty Store
Initially established in 2019 with the aim of digitizing the healthcare sector, Jeevee moved towards setting up as an online hub not just for health but baby and beauty products as well.
Undeniably, bringing affordable, quality healthcare to the masses with just one tap is what primarily Jeevee aims at.
Alongside, Jeevee slowly stretched its wings to an online marketplace platform and aimed to personify itself as Nepal’s largest e-commerce in health, Baby, and beauty categories.
And all in all the tech company was solidified to cater to customer needs and provide them with the best shopping experience and thrived to provide quality, authentic and reliable products at an affordable price with innovative technology.
Additionally, prompt nationwide delivery, standardized shipping rates, certain ease in communication, and booking orders also come aligned while meeting customer satisfaction.

 Our Key Features
1. Nepal’s No.1 Health, Baby & Beauty Store
Apart from being a prominent player in the healthcare arena, we have expanded our domain to cater to the overall head-to-toe, daily needs of consumers and babies positioning itself as the #1 Health, Baby, and Beauty Store.
2. 100% Authentic Products
We have a dedicated team who ensures the quality and authenticity of the products before sourcing them in our store from brands and authorized distributors.
3. Nepal’s First Semi-Automated Fulfillment Center
Whilst stepping up the efforts for a wider market presence and addressing the demands of every customer, Jeevee has reorganized a fulfillment center of 15,800 sqft where the team operates day-in-day-out to provide on-time delivery for 90% of orders.
4. Completely Homegrown
What sets us apart is our home-grown foundation, we share complete locally-based human resources, driven to bring change in standards of society with the flexibility of online shopping.
We have a talented team of Nepali Software Engineers fully committed to the development of functional app/web applications while incorporating the most effective design principles, robust architecture, analytics, and ML/AI models behind the scene.

bluejetty:00030999:android.description:

🧠 Addictive Gameplay: Master the skill of screwing and rotating nuts and bolts logically to escape the plates

bluejetty:00041032:ios.name: Zeta Stitch - Long Screenshots
bluejetty:00041032:ios.summary: Need to send a whole chat, article, receipt, or set of steps? Zeta stitches your screenshots, or a screen recording, into one long image. Before you share, clean up the status bar, blur out names and numbers, and mark up what matters. Every
bluejetty:00041032:ios.description:
Need to send a whole chat, article, receipt, or set of steps? Zeta stitches your screenshots, or a screen recording, into one long image. Before you share, clean up the status bar, blur out names and numbers, and mark up what matters. Everything is processed on your device and never uploaded.
Automatic stitching
Select a series of screenshots. Zeta finds where they overlap, lines them up, and joins them into one long image, with clean seams and no repeated or missing content.
Screen recording to long screenshot
Record the page with the system Screen Recording as you scroll, then import the recording into Zeta. No need to take screenshots one by one.
Clean up the status bar and scroll bars
Replace the status bar with a clean one: the time is kept, and signal and battery are drawn full. Or crop it out or erase it. Scroll bars can be removed too. Turn on automatic cleanup in Settings if you want it every time.
Mark up and redact
Hide profile photos, names, and phone numbers with a brush or a box. Choose from 8 styles, including mosaic, blur, and black. Draw with a pen or highlighter, and add arrows, shapes, and text. Undo and redo are always there.
Edit long screenshots
Check seams, split the image, cut out sections, and crop the edges before you save.
Save and export
Save to Photos, share directly, or export as PDF or ZIP. After saving, you can delete the original screenshots to keep your library tidy.
Make it yours
Choose a theme color and app icon.
Pricing
Free to download. Automatic long screenshots and Scrollshot are free to use 5 times, and manual stitching is unlimited. Zeta Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited use. It is not a subscription and never renews. Markup, redaction, and cleanup cost nothing extra.
Privacy
The screenshots and recordings you choose are processed only on your device and are never uploaded to a server. Zeta collects no data and shows no ads.

bluejetty:00200030:ios.description:
Welcome to StoryReel — Short Drama Stories That Fit Your Day
StoryReel brings you short dramas, miniseries, and movies made for mobile viewing. Discover emotional stories with fast-paced plots, rising suspense, and memorable twists, all presented in episodes that are easy to enjoy whenever you have a moment.
Whether you are in the mood for romance, fantasy, revenge, suspense, or an unexpected second chance at love, StoryReel makes it easy to find a story that keeps you watching.
● Discover Your Next Short Drama
[Fast Stories for Every Moment]
- Enjoy short drama episodes designed for commutes, breaks, trips, and quiet moments at home.
- Follow compelling characters, emotional conflicts, and dramatic twists without the long wait of traditional TV series.
[Popular Genres and Engaging Stories]
- Explore forbidden werewolf romance, billionaire family secrets, dangerous mafia worlds, second-chance love stories, and more.
- Switch between romance, fantasy, revenge, suspense, rebirth, secret identity, and other popular short drama themes.
[Clear and Immersive HD Viewing]
- Watch available short dramas in HD with clear visuals and smooth full-screen playback.
- Stay focused on the characters, conflicts, and important moments that move each story forward.
[Offline Episodes for Life on the Go]
- Download available episodes before a flight, commute, or trip and continue watching without an internet connection.
- Keep your saved episodes close so you can easily return to your favorite short drama series wherever you are.
[Curated Collections and Personal Recommendations]
- Browse curated collections, explore different themes, or use search to find the short dramas you want.
- Receive personalized recommendations based on what you enjoy and discover more short dramas, miniseries, and movies that match your interests.
[Daily Rewards and Episode Access]
- Check in to collect available rewards and use coins to unlock premium episodes.
- Some content and features may require coins or a subscription purchased through Apple’s in-app purchase system.
- Reward availability and amounts may vary in the app.
Subscription and Payment Rules:
1. Subscription Instructions
The subscription function is only to improve the user experience of the APP. It does not affect the normal use of the APP whether you subscribe or not.
2. Subscription Benefits
With a Weekly Pass Pro or Annual Pass Pro subscription, you can:
- After purchasing Weekly Pass Pro or Annual Pass Pro, you can watch any episode without limit.
- Ad-free: After unlocking, except for incentive ads, other types of ads will no longer be displayed.
- 1080P resolution: Video playback supports selecting 1080P resolution.
3. About automatic renewal
- Subscription will be automatically renewed 24 hours before the valid period. You can cancel the automatic renewal at any time. There is no refund when the renewal is successful.
- If your payment method cannot be charged, your subscription may not renew. The payment may be retried in accordance with the applicable billing policy. If a retry is successful, you will be charged the applicable renewal price for the subscription period disclosed to you.
4. How to cancel the subscription
- Open StoryReel and click on the avatar in the top right corner.
- Click on "Payment and Subscription" and then click on "Subscription".
- Select your StoryReel subscription.
- Click on "Cancel Subscription".
Contact Us:
For support, go to Profile → Contact Support. Our support team is available 24/7.
You can also email us at service@storyreel.life.
Privacy Policy:
https://www.storyreel.life/Privacy-Policy.html
Terms of Service:
https://www.storyreel.life/User-Agreement.html
Website:
https://www.storyreel.life

1. Pulpit - nowoczesne centrum dowodz
bluejetty:00061257:ios.description:
VELObankuj mobilnie z nową aplikacją VeloBanku.
Przedstawiamy nową odsłonę naszej bankowości mobilnej. Stworzyliśmy ją od podstaw, aby jeszcze wygodniej Ci się bankowało. Już teraz zobacz, jak wygląda:
1. Pulpit - nowoczesne centrum dowodzenia, w którym od razu widzisz to, co najważniejsze dla Ciebie. Dostosuj do siebie szybkie skróty, wybierz ulubiony produkt, który wyświetlimy Ci na pierwszym miejscu.
2. Potrzebujesz sprawdzić szczegóły Twoich kont, lokat, kredytów czy kart kredytowych? Wszystko masz pod ręką w zakładce Finanse.
3. Chcesz zlecać swoje płatności szybko i wygodnie? Korzystaj z przelewów na telefon BLIK, zapisuj stałych odbiorców i przelewy. Powtarzalne operacje możesz dodać do szybkich skrótów. Więcej w zakładce Płatności.
4. Potrzebujesz szybko przewalutować środki po korzystnym kursie? Zrobisz to bez dodatkowych opłat, przez całą dobę w naszym kantorze. Aktywuj płatności mobilne i płać wygodnie telefonem jak kartą zbliżeniową. Chcesz szybko i wygodnie zapłacić w naszej aplikacji za bilet lub parkowanie? Wszystko to znajdziesz w zakładce Usługi.
5. Potrzebujesz kredytu lub karty kredytowej? Chcesz otworzyć konto albo lokatę? Sprawdź naszą ofertę w zakładce Oferty. Możesz tu składać wnioski produktowe lub obsługowe. W każdej chwili sprawdzisz listę złożonych wniosków.
Bankuj bezpiecznie. Nigdy nie instaluj aplikacji z nieznanych źródeł (spoza sklepu App Store). Instaluj tylko aplikacje pochodzące od znanych i zaufanych dostawców. Zainstaluj oprogramowanie antywirusowe i ustaw jego automatyczną aktualizację.
Dostępne funkcje:
Rachunki
• Stan konta, historia, szczegóły
• Przelewy własne, krajowe, do odbiorców zdefiniowanych, do US
• Przelewy natychmiastowe Express Elixir
• Zlecenia stałe – tworzenie, edycja, zawieszanie, zamykanie
• Powtarzanie przelewów
• Opłacanie rachunków i faktur QR kodem
• Doładowanie telefonu
• Dostęp i zarządzanie rachunkami oszczędnościowymi
• Wyszukiwanie operacji w historii
• Podgląd zaplanowanych operacji
• Możliwość pobrania i wysłania potwierdzeń transakcji
• Dodawanie odbiorców zdefiniowanych
• Kopiowanie i wysyłanie numeru konta
Karty debetowe i kredytowe
• Podgląd kart debetowych i kredytowych
• Aktywacja, zastrzeganie, blokowanie, zmiana limitów i PIN-u
• Podgląd historii kart
• Spłata karty kredytowej
• Przelewy z karty kredytowej
• Zamawianie kart wirtualnych i dodawanie kart debetowych i kredytowych do Apple Pay
• Karta wielowalutowa
Lokaty
• Zakładanie i podgląd posiadanych lokat
• Edycja i zrywanie
• Opcja opłacenia lokaty później
• Możliwość zakładania lokat bez posiadania konta
Kredyty
• Podgląd kredytów gotówkowych, hipotecznych i firmowych
• Spłata kredytów gotówkowych (spłata raty: całkowita i częściowa z opcją zmniejszenia raty lub skrócenia okresu kredytowania, zmiana dnia spłaty raty)
• Podgląd posiadanego limitu w rachunku
• Wnioskowanie o nowy kredyt (w ramach oferty specjalnej)
Płatności telefonem
• Apple Pay – aktywuj usługę, dodaj kartę debetowe do Apple Wallet bezpośrednio w aplikacji, zamów wirtualne karty debetowe i kredytowe
• Płatność kodami BLIK w sklepach
• Wypłaty kodami BLIK z bankomatów
• Wpłaty BLIK
Funkcje dodatkowe
Dostępne środki przed zalogowaniem i 3 ostatnie transakcje
Awizacja gotówki w oddziale
Program rabatowy i program poleceń
Kantor walutowy
Opłaty za parkingi
Zakup biletów komunikacji miejskiej
Logowanie Touch ID lub Face ID
Zarządzanie szybkimi skrótami
Lokalizacja placówek banku i bankomatów
Aktualne kursy walut
Bezpłatne powiadomienia push
Kontakt z bankiem - połącz się z infolinią od razu jako zweryfikowany klient, odbieraj i wysyłaj wiadomości do nas
Mobilna autoryzacja - zatwierdzaj transakcje zlecane w bankowości internetowej (bez przepisywania haseł SMS)
Skróty na ikonie aplikacji – by skorzystać z niektórych funkcji aplikacji, nie musisz jej otwierać, przytrzymaj dłużej palec na ikonie aplikacji
Wniosek o Przelew wynagrodzenia – wypełnij prosty wniosek i otrzymuj wynagrodzenie na konto w VeloBanku

Empire is an all-in-one mobile application designed to streamline daily work for professional drivers, dispatchers, and fleet management. Manage loads, track status, communicate directly, and handle your documents in one convenient tool.
Ke
bluejetty:00045262:ios.description:
Empire is an all-in-one mobile application designed to streamline daily work for professional drivers, dispatchers, and fleet management. Manage loads, track status, communicate directly, and handle your documents in one convenient tool.
Key Features:
- Smart Dispatch Communication: Receive potential load offers instantly, discuss details with dispatchers, and accept profitable offers without delays.
- Integrated Location & Tracking Chats: Keep dispatchers updated automatically with real-time location sharing and dedicated load-specific chats.
- Automated Pickup & Delivery Workflow: Easily update status at loading and unloading points with step-by-step guidance, reducing manual reporting.

bluejetty:00041383:ios.description:
The second installment of the pick-up-and-play hack-and-slash Action RPG! Make use of a variety of weapons and skills. Venture into randomly generated dungeons to save the world from the rule of demonkind!

Dungeons are randomly generated, which means the layout changes every time you enter
Defeat the enemies lurking in the depths of the dungeon, obtain powerful equipment, and power-up your character!
◆Battle Mighty Bosses
Progress enough in the game and you will encounter bosses
Facing the overwhelming might of these bosses will be tough, but by leveling up and changing your gear you should be able to find the path to victory

An array or equipment and skills can be found in-game
How well you can use them will depend on your own skill
Find equipment that you like and aim for victory with your own fighting style!
In addition, armor you equip will change your character's appearance
Use your favorite equipment to customize your character!
◆A Pixel Art Fantasy World
The game world is depicted entirely through nostalgic pixel art
In this fantasy world overflowing with mysteries,
you're sure to encounter many characterful NPCs and enemies

apple-itunes:1044950341.description:
Short home workouts for every fitness level, from the makers of Streaks.
Pick a workout, press start and follow along on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch or Apple TV.
One-time purchase. No subscription.
The app comes with 30 exercises that need no equipment, just a few minutes and a floor. You choose which exercises you want to do, so it works for all ages and abilities.
WORKOUT PACKS
Workout Packs add more workouts and 100 more exercises when you want them. They're optional one-time in-app purchases, and you can use them on all your devices. Three are free.
Some packs add exercises you can use in your own workouts and random workouts, and each comes with workouts of its own. There are packs for calisthenics, kettlebell, yoga, stretching and mobility, plyometrics, core, and HIIT and cardio.
Other packs are ready-made workouts. There are packs for core strength, fat-burning HIIT, lower body, postnatal workouts, and quiet workouts with no jumping. Ring Chaser has workouts with no set length that keep going until your Move and Exercise goals for the day are met. Recharge has six sessions to boost your energy.
The free packs are Fresh Start (beginner workouts), Shake It Out (warm-up moves) and All-Rounder (one exercise from six of the paid packs). Next Level, with harder versions of the basics, comes with the app.
FEATURES
* 4 workout lengths (about 6, 12, 18 or 30 minutes), or set your own
* Create custom exercises and custom workouts
* Set the time for each exercise and the rest between exercises and sets, or build interval workouts
* Up to 1,000 reps per set, or Until Done sets that keep going until you tap
* Pick any color for a custom workout
* Voice guidance through your workout, with three coaches to choose from
* Live heart rate zones during workouts with Apple Watch
* Trophies for streaks, milestones, exercises and packs
* My Stats, with best sets, records, trends and a chart for each exercise
* A home screen with your week, your streak and your best sets
* Plays workout music (requires Apple Music subscription)
* Saves workouts to the Health app
* View your workout history
* Siri and Shortcuts support
* Widgets for your Home Screen
* Syncs your data across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple TV
If you have any questions or comments, please contact support@streaksworkout.app

With over 7 million downloads, Simple Transfer is the easiest way of transferring your photos and large videos to computer using WiFi or USB. It can also convert HEIC photos to JPG, HEVC videos to MOV/MP4 and Live Photos to videos.
Reviews:
●●●●● "Have never looked back since finding this app! Couldn't live without it now."
●●●●● "Works beautifully: I wish this was easier to find. It’s amazing how much time you can waste trying to transfer things from iPhone/iPad to PC, and all along this app was here, making it so easy."
Main Features:
◉ View all your photo albums and videos on your computer and download them by a single click via WiFi or USB cable.
◉ Save photos and videos from your computer to your iPhone/iPad
◉ Export photos as JPG (Windows compatible) or HEIC 
◉ Convert videos as MOV or MP4 (Windows compatible H.264 format)
◉ Export Live Photos to video or photo+video
◉ Photo Cleaner: clear space on your device by deleting large or duplicate photos and videos (premium feature).
◉ Photo Organizer: easily select and filter photos to delete, favorite or unfavorite them
◉ Free up space by automatically deleting transferred photos/videos (optional)
◉ Support for the new Apple's ProRaw and other RAW formats
◉ Safest way to transfer your photos and videos in your local WiFi network. They never go on the Internet or stored on any external server.
◉ Transfer photos and videos between iOS devices (iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch), select an album and tap on "Select All" to transfer all your photos/videos*
◉ Photos are transferred with full resolution including metadata and videos transferred with the highest quality available
◉ Works on Windows, Mac and Linux and it's fast!
Simple Transfer does not use or transfer your files to any external server. It provides a completely private website to be accessed by only computers that are directly connected to your local WiFi network. Your photos and videos cannot be accessed from the Internet.
